translations.idiomatic: The Palace Ward Stewards investigate all unlawful conduct.

sentences.zh: 歲大儺，則監其出入。

translations.literal: At the great year-end exorcism, they supervise entry and exit.
translations.idiomatic: At the great year-end exorcism, they supervise who enters and leaves.

sentences.zh: 掖廷局：令二人，從七品下。

translations.literal: Rear Palace Bureau: two Directors, lower lower seventh rank.
translations.idiomatic: Rear Palace Bureau: two Directors, lower lower seventh rank.

sentences.zh: 丞三人，從八品下。

translations.literal: Three Vice Directors, lower lower eighth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Three Vice Directors, lower lower eighth rank.

sentences.zh: 宮教博士二人，從九品下。

translations.literal: Two Palace Instruction Masters, lower lower ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Two Palace Instruction Masters, lower lower ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 監作四人，從九品下。

translations.literal: Four Works Supervisors, lower lower ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Four Works Supervisors, lower lower ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 令史四人，計史二人，書令史八人。

translations.literal: Four Recorder Clerks; two Accounting Clerks; eight Document Clerks.
translations.idiomatic: Four Recorder Clerks; two Accounting Clerks; eight Document Clerks.

sentences.zh: 掖廷令掌宮禁女工之事。

translations.literal: The Rear Palace Director is in charge of women's work within the palace confines.
translations.idiomatic: The Rear Palace Director oversees women's work within the palace confines.

sentences.zh: 凡宮人名籍，司其除附，公桑養蠶，會其課業。

translations.literal: They maintain the registry of palace women, managing appointments and dismissals; for mulberry fields and silkworm rearing, they tally quotas.
translations.idiomatic: They maintain the registry of palace women, managing appointments and dismissals, and tally quotas for mulberry fields and silkworm rearing.

sentences.zh: 丞掌判局事。

translations.literal: The Vice Directors supervise bureau business.
translations.idiomatic: The Vice Directors supervise bureau business.

sentences.zh: 博士掌教習宮人書算眾藝。

translations.literal: The Masters are in charge of instructing palace women in writing, reckoning, and various arts.
translations.idiomatic: The Masters instruct palace women in writing, reckoning, and various arts.

sentences.zh: 監作掌監當雜作。

translations.literal: The Works Supervisors oversee miscellaneous labor tasks.
translations.idiomatic: The Works Supervisors oversee miscellaneous labor tasks.

sentences.zh: 宮闈局：令二人，從七品下。

translations.literal: Inner Gate Bureau: two Directors, lower lower seventh rank.
translations.idiomatic: Inner Gate Bureau: two Directors, lower lower seventh rank.

sentences.zh: 丞二人，從八品下。

translations.literal: Two Vice Directors, lower lower eighth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Two Vice Directors, lower lower eighth rank.

sentences.zh: 令史三人，書吏六人，內閽人二十人，內掌扇十六人，內給使無常員。

translations.literal: Three Recorder Clerks; six Document Clerks; twenty Inner Gatekeepers; sixteen Inner Fan Bearers; Inner Attendants without fixed numbers.
translations.idiomatic: Three Recorder Clerks; six Document Clerks; twenty Inner Gatekeepers; sixteen Inner Fan Bearers; Inner Attendants without fixed numbers.

sentences.zh: 宮闈局令掌侍奉宮闈，出入管鑰。

translations.literal: The Inner Gate Director is in charge of attending the inner gate, controlling keys for entry and exit.
translations.idiomatic: The Inner Gate Director attends the inner gate and controls the keys for entry and exit.

sentences.zh: 凡大享太廟，帥其屬詣於室，出皇后神主置於輿而登座焉。

translations.literal: For all major offerings at the Grand Ancestral Temple, they lead their subordinates to the shrine room, take out the empress's spirit tablet, place it on the carriage, and mount the seat.
translations.idiomatic: For all major offerings at the Grand Ancestral Temple, they lead their subordinates to the shrine room, take out the empress's spirit tablet, place it on the carriage, and mount the seat.

sentences.zh: 既事，納之。

translations.literal: When the rite is complete, they store it away.
translations.idiomatic: When the rite is complete, they store it away.

sentences.zh: 凡宮人無官品者，稱內給使。

translations.literal: All palace women without official rank are styled Inner Attendants.
translations.idiomatic: Palace women without official rank are styled Inner Attendants.

sentences.zh: 若有官及經解免應敘選者，得令長上，其小給使學生五十人，皆總其名籍，以給其糧廩。

translations.literal: If there are those with office and those who have passed the classics examination and are exempt from candidacy for appointment, they may be made chief attendants. The fifty junior attendant students—all are aggregated in name registers to supply their grain from the storehouse.
translations.idiomatic: Those who hold office, or who having passed the classics examination are exempt from candidacy for appointment, may be appointed chief attendants. The fifty junior attendant students are all entered on a consolidated register so that grain rations from the storehouse may be issued to them.

sentences.zh: 丞掌判局事。

translations.literal: The Assistant Director supervises and decides bureau affairs.
translations.idiomatic: The Assistant Director supervises bureau business.

sentences.zh: 內給使掌諸門進物出納之曆。

translations.literal: Inner attendants manage the ledgers of incoming and outgoing goods through the various gates.
translations.idiomatic: Inner attendants keep the accounts for goods delivered in and out through every gate.

sentences.zh: 奚官局：令二人，正八品下。

translations.literal: Bureau of Servant Officials: two Directors, lower eighth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Bureau of Servant Officials — two Directors, lower eighth rank.

sentences.zh: 丞二人，正九品下。

translations.literal: Two Assistant Directors, lower ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Two Assistant Directors, lower ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 書令史三人，書吏六人，藥童四人。

translations.literal: Three document clerks, six scribes, four medicine boys.
translations.idiomatic: Three document clerks, six scribes, and four medicine boys.

sentences.zh: 奚官令掌奚隸工役、宮官品命。

translations.literal: The Director of Servant Officials manages slave labor, corvée, and palace office ranks and titles.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of Servant Officials oversees bonded labor, corvée assignments, and the ranks and titles of palace offices.

sentences.zh: 丞為之貳。

translations.literal: The Assistant Director is his deputy.
translations.idiomatic: The Assistant Director serves as his deputy.

sentences.zh: 凡宮人有疾病，則供其醫藥，死亡則供其衣服，各視其品命。

translations.literal: Whenever palace women fall ill, medicine is supplied; upon death, burial garments are supplied, each according to rank and title.
translations.idiomatic: When palace women fall ill, the bureau provides medicine; when they die, it provides burial garments, in each case according to rank.

sentences.zh: 仍於隨近寺觀，為之修福。

translations.literal: Moreover, at the nearest temple or monastery, merit is performed on their behalf.
translations.idiomatic: Merit rites are also performed for them at the nearest temple or monastery.

sentences.zh: 雖無品，亦如之。

translations.literal: Even if without rank, the same applies.
translations.idiomatic: The same provisions apply even to those without official rank.

sentences.zh: 凡內命婦五品已上亡，無親戚于墓側，三年內取同姓中男一人，以時主祭。

translations.literal: Whenever inner-appointed wives of fifth rank or above die without relatives at the tomb, within three years one male of the same surname is selected to conduct seasonal sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: When an inner-appointed wife of fifth rank or above dies with no kin at the tomb, within three years a man of the same surname is chosen to preside over the seasonal sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 無同姓，則所司春秋以少牢祭之。

translations.literal: If there is no one of the same surname, the responsible office performs spring and autumn sacrifices with the lesser offering.
translations.idiomatic: If no kinsman of the same surname can be found, the responsible office performs spring and autumn sacrifices using the lesser offering.

sentences.zh: 內僕局：令二人，正八品下。

translations.literal: Bureau of Inner Attendants: two Directors, lower eighth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Bureau of Inner Attendants — two Directors, lower eighth rank.

sentences.zh: 丞二人，正九品下。

translations.literal: Two Assistant Directors, lower ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Two Assistant Directors, lower ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 書令史二人，書吏四人，駕士二百人。

translations.literal: Two document clerks, four scribes, two hundred grooms.
translations.idiomatic: Two document clerks, four scribes, and two hundred grooms.

sentences.zh: 內僕令掌中宮車乘出入導引。

translations.literal: The Director of Inner Attendants manages the empress's carriages for going in and out and their escort.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of Inner Attendants oversees the empress's carriages and escorts her whenever she goes in or out.

sentences.zh: 丞為之貳。

translations.literal: The Assistant Director is his deputy.
translations.idiomatic: The Assistant Director serves as his deputy.

sentences.zh: 凡中宮有出入則令居左，丞居右，而夾引之。

translations.literal: Whenever the empress goes in or out, the Director takes the left, the Assistant the right, and they escort her from both sides.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever the empress goes in or out, the Director walks on her left and the Assistant on her right, escorting her from both sides.

sentences.zh: 凡皇后之車有六，事在《輿服》也。

translations.literal: The empress has six carriages in all; the matter is treated in the 《Rites of Carriages and Robes》.
translations.idiomatic: The empress has six carriages in all; the details are set forth in the 《Rites of Carriages and Robes》.

sentences.zh: 內府局：令二人，正八品下。

translations.literal: Bureau of the Inner Treasury: two Directors, lower eighth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Bureau of the Inner Treasury — two Directors, lower eighth rank.

sentences.zh: 丞二人，正九品下。

translations.literal: Two Assistant Directors, lower ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Two Assistant Directors, lower ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 書令史二人，書吏四人。

translations.literal: Two document clerks, four scribes.
translations.idiomatic: Two document clerks and four scribes.

sentences.zh: 內府令掌中藏寶貨，給納名數。

translations.literal: The Director of the Inner Treasury manages treasures stored within and the roster of disbursements and receipts.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of the Inner Treasury oversees the palace's stored treasures and keeps the records of disbursements and receipts.

sentences.zh: 丞為之貳。

translations.literal: The Assistant Director is his deputy.
translations.idiomatic: The Assistant Director serves as his deputy.

sentences.zh: 凡朝會五品已上，賜絹帛金銀器於殿廷者，並供之。

translations.literal: At court assemblies, for those of fifth rank and above granted silk, cloth, gold, and silver vessels in the hall—all are supplied.
translations.idiomatic: At court assemblies, it supplies the silk, cloth, gold, and silver vessels granted in the hall to officials of fifth rank and above.

sentences.zh: 諸將有功，並蕃酋辭還，亦如之。

translations.literal: Distinguished generals and foreign chieftains taking leave to return home—likewise.
translations.idiomatic: The same applies to meritorious generals and foreign chieftains taking leave to return home.

sentences.zh: 太常寺太常寺古曰秩宗，秦曰奉常，漢高改為太常，梁加「寺」字，後代因之。

translations.literal: Directorate of Ritual. The Directorate of Ritual was anciently called Director of Ranks and Ancestors; under Qin it was called Director of Constant Offerings; Emperor Gaozu of Han changed it to Director of Ritual; Liang added the character "Directorate," and later ages followed this.
translations.idiomatic: Directorate of Ritual. In antiquity the office was called Director of Ranks and Ancestors; under Qin it was the Director of Constant Offerings; Emperor Gaozu of Han renamed it Director of Ritual; the Liang added the word "Directorate," and later dynasties kept the name.

sentences.zh: 卿一員，正三品。

translations.literal: One Minister, third rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Minister, third rank.

sentences.zh: 梁置十二卿，太常卿為一。

translations.literal: Liang established twelve Ministers; the Minister of Ritual was one.
translations.idiomatic: The Liang established twelve Ministers, of whom the Minister of Ritual was one.

sentences.zh: 周、隋品第三。

translations.literal: Under Zhou and Sui, rank was third.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Zhou and Sui, the rank was third.

sentences.zh: 龍朔二年改為奉常，光宅改為司禮卿，神龍復為太常卿也。

translations.literal: In Longshuo year 2 it was changed to Director of Constant Offerings; under Guangzhai it was changed to Minister of Rites; under Shendlong it was restored to Minister of Ritual.
translations.idiomatic: In Longshuo year 2 the title became Director of Constant Offerings; under Guangzhai it became Minister of Rites; under Shendlong it was restored to Minister of Ritual.

sentences.zh: 少卿二人。

translations.literal: Two Vice Ministers.
translations.idiomatic: Two Vice Ministers.

sentences.zh: 正四品。

translations.literal: Fourth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth rank.

sentences.zh: 隋置少卿二人，從四品。

translations.literal: Sui established two Vice Ministers, secondary fourth rank.
translations.idiomatic: The Sui established two Vice Ministers of secondary fourth rank.

sentences.zh: 武德置一人，貞觀加置一員。

translations.literal: Wude established one; Zhenguan added one post.
translations.idiomatic: Under Wude one was established; under Zhenguan a second post was added.

sentences.zh: 太常卿之職，掌邦國禮樂、郊廟、社稷之事，以八署分而理之：一曰郊社，二曰太廟，三曰諸陵，四曰太樂，五曰鼓吹，六曰太醫，七曰太卜，八曰廩犧。

translations.literal: The duty of the Minister of Ritual is to manage the state's rites and music, suburban sacrifices, ancestral temples, and altars of soil and grain, dividing administration among eight bureaus: first, Suburban Sacrifices; second, Grand Ancestral Temple; third, Imperial Tombs; fourth, Grand Music; fifth, Processional Music; sixth, Imperial Physicians; seventh, Grand Divination; eighth, Sacrificial Livestock.
translations.idiomatic: The Minister of Ritual oversees the state's ritual music, suburban sacrifices, ancestral temples, and altars of soil and grain, dividing the work among eight bureaus: Suburban Sacrifices, Grand Ancestral Temple, Imperial Tombs, Grand Music, Processional Music, Imperial Physicians, Grand Divination, and Sacrificial Livestock.

sentences.zh: 總其官屬，行其政令。

translations.literal: He oversees all subordinate officials and executes its orders.
translations.idiomatic: He supervises all subordinate officials and carries out the directorate's orders.

sentences.zh: 少卿為之貳。

translations.literal: The Vice Minister is his deputy.
translations.idiomatic: The Vice Minister serves as his deputy.

sentences.zh: 凡國有大禮，則贊相禮儀。

translations.literal: Whenever the state has a great rite, he assists and directs the ritual observances.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever the state holds a major ceremony, he assists in directing the ritual.

sentences.zh: 有司攝事，則為之亞獻。

translations.literal: If the responsible officials act in proxy, he serves as secondary offerer.
translations.idiomatic: When responsible officials officiate in the ruler's stead, he serves as secondary offerer.

sentences.zh: 率太樂官屬，宿設樂懸，以供其事。

translations.literal: He leads the subordinates of Grand Music, lodging overnight to set up the suspended bells and chimes to supply the rite.
translations.idiomatic: He leads the staff of Grand Music, who lodge overnight to set up the suspended bells and chimes for the ceremony.

sentences.zh: 宴會，亦如之。

translations.literal: At banquets, likewise.
translations.idiomatic: The same applies at banquets.

sentences.zh: 若三公行園陵，則為之副，公服乘輅備鹵簿而奉其禮。

translations.literal: If the Three Excellencies visit the imperial tombs, he serves as their deputy, wearing court robes, riding the state carriage, equipped with the guard of honor, and conducting the rite.
translations.idiomatic: When the Three Excellencies visit the imperial tombs, he serves as their deputy, wearing court robes, riding the state carriage with full guard of honor, and conducting the rite.

sentences.zh: 若大祭祀，則先省牲器。

translations.literal: If there is a great sacrifice, he first inspects the sacrificial victims and vessels.
translations.idiomatic: Before a major sacrifice, he first inspects the victims and ritual vessels.

sentences.zh: 凡太卜占國之大事及祭祀卜日，皆往蒞之于太廟南門之外。

translations.literal: Whenever Grand Divination divines the state's great affairs and the days for sacrifices, he goes to preside outside the south gate of the Grand Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever Grand Divination determines the days for the state's great affairs and for sacrifices, he presides outside the south gate of the Grand Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 凡仲春薦冰及四時品物甘滋新成者，皆薦焉。

translations.literal: Whenever in mid-spring ice is presented and in the four seasons delicacies and newly ripened things are offered, all are presented there.
translations.idiomatic: Mid-spring offerings of ice and seasonal offerings of delicacies and newly ripened produce are all presented there.

sentences.zh: 凡有事於宗廟，少卿帥太祝、齋郎入薦香燈，整拂神幄，出入神主。

translations.literal: Whenever there is business at the ancestral temple, the Vice Minister leads the Grand Invokers and Fast Officers to present incense and lamps, arrange and dust the spirit curtains, and bring spirit tablets in and out.
translations.idiomatic: When rites are performed at the ancestral temple, the Vice Minister leads the Grand Invokers and Fast Officers to present incense and lamps, prepare the spirit curtains, and carry the spirit tablets in and out.

sentences.zh: 將享，則興良醖令實樽罍。

translations.literal: When the offering is about to begin, he has the Master of Good Brew fill the goblets and jars.
translations.idiomatic: Before the offering begins, he has the Master of Good Brew fill the goblets and jars.

sentences.zh: 凡備大享之器服，有四院。

translations.literal: For preparing vessels and robes for the great offering, there are four courtyards.
translations.idiomatic: Preparations for the great offering's vessels and robes are divided among four courtyards.

sentences.zh: 一曰天府院，二曰御衣院，三曰樂懸院，四曰神廚院。

translations.literal: First, the Heavenly Storehouse Courtyard; second, the Imperial Robes Courtyard; third, the Suspended Music Courtyard; fourth, the Spirit Kitchen Courtyard.
translations.idiomatic: They are the Heavenly Storehouse Courtyard, the Imperial Robes Courtyard, the Suspended Music Courtyard, and the Spirit Kitchen Courtyard.

sentences.zh: 丞二人，從五品上。

translations.literal: Two Assistant Directors, upper secondary fifth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Two Assistant Directors, upper secondary fifth rank.

sentences.zh: 主簿二人，從七品上。

translations.literal: Two Chief Clerks, upper secondary seventh rank.
translations.idiomatic: Two Chief Clerks, upper secondary seventh rank.

sentences.zh: 錄事二人，從九品下。

translations.literal: Two Recording Clerks, lower secondary ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Two Recording Clerks, lower secondary ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 府十二人，史二十三人。

translations.literal: Twelve clerks, twenty-three scribes.
translations.idiomatic: Twelve clerks and twenty-three scribes.

sentences.zh: 博士四人，從七品上。

translations.literal: Four Erudites, upper secondary seventh rank.
translations.idiomatic: Four Erudites, upper secondary seventh rank.

sentences.zh: 謁者十人，贊引二十人。

translations.literal: Ten ushers, twenty announcers and guides.
translations.idiomatic: Ten ushers and twenty announcers and guides.

sentences.zh: 太祝六人，正九品上。

translations.literal: Six Grand Invokers, upper ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Six Grand Invokers, upper ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 祝史六人。

translations.literal: Six invoker scribes.
translations.idiomatic: Six invoker scribes.

sentences.zh: 奉禮二人，從九品上。

translations.literal: Two Masters of Ceremonies, upper secondary ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Two Masters of Ceremonies, upper secondary ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 贊者十六人。

translations.literal: Sixteen announcers.
translations.idiomatic: Sixteen announcers.

sentences.zh: 協律郎二人，正八品上。

translations.literal: Two Masters of Harmonizing Pitch, upper eighth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Two Masters of Harmonizing Pitch, upper eighth rank.

sentences.zh: 亭長八人，掌固十二人，太廟齋郎，京、都各一百三十人。

translations.literal: Eight ward chiefs, twelve gatekeepers, Grand Ancestral Temple Fast Officers—one hundred thirty each in the capital and the eastern capital.
translations.idiomatic: Eight ward chiefs, twelve gatekeepers, and Grand Ancestral Temple Fast Officers—one hundred thirty each in Chang'an and Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 太廟門僕，京、都各三十人。

translations.literal: Grand Ancestral Temple gate servants—thirty each in the capital and the eastern capital.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Ancestral Temple gate servants—thirty each in Chang'an and Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 丞掌判寺事。

translations.literal: The Assistant Director supervises and decides directorate affairs.
translations.idiomatic: The Assistant Director supervises directorate business.

sentences.zh: 凡大饗太廟，則修七祀於太廟西門之內。

translations.literal: Whenever there is a great offering at the Grand Ancestral Temple, the seven sacrifices are performed inside the west gate of the Grand Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: At a great offering in the Grand Ancestral Temple, the seven sacrifices are performed inside the temple's west gate.

sentences.zh: 若祫享，則兼修配享功臣之禮。

translations.literal: If it is a he sacrifice, the rite of associated offering for meritorious ministers is also performed.
translations.idiomatic: At a he sacrifice, the rites for associated offerings to meritorious ministers are also performed.

sentences.zh: 主簿掌印，勾檢稽失，省署抄目。

translations.literal: The Chief Clerk manages the seal, checks and audits errors, and reviews copied documents.
translations.idiomatic: The Chief Clerk keeps the seal, audits for errors, and reviews copied documents.

sentences.zh: 錄事掌受事發辰。

translations.literal: The Recording Clerk manages receiving documents and dispatching them on schedule.
translations.idiomatic: The Recording Clerk receives documents and dispatches them on schedule.

sentences.zh: 博士掌五禮之儀式，本先王之法制，適變隨時而損益焉。

translations.literal: The Erudites manage the forms of the five rites, based on the institutions of former kings, adapting and changing with the times to add or subtract.
translations.idiomatic: The Erudites oversee the forms of the five rites, grounded in the institutions of former kings but adjusted as circumstances require.

sentences.zh: 凡大祭祀及有大禮，則與卿導贊其儀。

translations.literal: Whenever there are great sacrifices and great rites, they together with the Minister guide and announce the observances.
translations.idiomatic: At major sacrifices and great ceremonies, they assist the Minister in directing and announcing the ritual.

sentences.zh: 凡公已下擬諡，皆跡其功行，為之褒貶。

translations.literal: Whenever posthumous titles are proposed for dukes and below, their achievements and conduct are traced to praise or blame them.
translations.idiomatic: When posthumous titles are proposed for dukes and below, their deeds and conduct are assessed to determine praise or censure.

sentences.zh: 無爵稱子，養德邱園，聲實明著，則諡曰先生。

translations.literal: Those without noble rank styled Master, cultivating virtue in hill and garden, whose reputation and merit are clearly outstanding, receive the posthumous title Master.
translations.idiomatic: Men without noble rank who styled themselves Master, cultivated virtue in retirement, and won clear renown receive the posthumous title Master.

sentences.zh: 大行大名，小行小名之。

translations.literal: Great conduct receives a great name; lesser conduct receives a lesser name.
translations.idiomatic: Great deeds earn a lofty posthumous name; lesser deeds earn a modest one.

sentences.zh: 古有《周書諡法》，《大戴禮諡法》，漢劉熙《諡法》一卷，晉張靖《諡法》兩卷，又有《廣諡法》一卷，梁沈約總聚古今諡法，凡有一百六十五稱也。

translations.literal: Antiquity had the 《Posthumous Title Methods of the Book of Zhou》, the 《Posthumous Title Methods of the Greater Dai Rites》, Liu Xi's 《Posthumous Title Methods》 of Han in one scroll, Zhang Jing's 《Posthumous Title Methods》 of Jin in two scrolls, and also the 《Expanded Posthumous Title Methods》 in one scroll. Shen Yue of Liang gathered posthumous title methods ancient and modern, totaling one hundred sixty-five designations.
translations.idiomatic: Ancient works included the 《Posthumous Title Methods of the Book of Zhou》, the 《Posthumous Title Methods of the Greater Dai Rites》, Liu Xi's Han-era 《Posthumous Title Methods》 in one scroll, Zhang Jing's Jin-era 《Posthumous Title Methods》 in two scrolls, and the 《Expanded Posthumous Title Methods》 in one scroll. Shen Yue of the Liang compiled posthumous title methods from all ages, totaling one hundred sixty-five designations.

sentences.zh: 若大祭禮，卿省牲器，謁者為之導。

translations.literal: If there is a great sacrificial rite, the Minister inspects victims and vessels, and the ushers serve as guides.
translations.idiomatic: At a major sacrificial rite, the Minister inspects the victims and vessels while the ushers serve as guides.

sentences.zh: 若小祀及公卿大夫有嘉禮，亦命謁者以贊之。

translations.literal: If there are minor sacrifices and auspicious rites for dukes, ministers, and grand masters, ushers are also ordered to announce them.
translations.idiomatic: For minor sacrifices and auspicious rites involving dukes, ministers, and grand masters, ushers are also appointed to announce the proceedings.

sentences.zh: 太祝掌出納神主于太廟之九室，而奉享禘佩給之儀。

translations.literal: The Grand Invokers manage bringing spirit tablets in and out of the nine chambers of the Grand Ancestral Temple and conduct the rites of offering, di, and distribution.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Invokers bring spirit tablets in and out of the nine chambers of the Grand Ancestral Temple and conduct the rites of offering, di sacrifice, and distribution.

sentences.zh: 凡國有大祭祀，凡郊廟之祝版，先進取署，乃送祠所。

translations.literal: Whenever the state has a great sacrifice, for all invocation boards of suburban and temple rites, they are first brought in for signature, then sent to the place of sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever the state holds a major sacrifice, invocation boards for suburban and temple rites are first brought in for signature and then sent to the place of sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 將事，則跪讀祝文，以信於神；

translations.literal: When the rite is about to begin, they kneel and read the invocation text to give assurance to the spirits;
translations.idiomatic: When the rite is about to begin, they kneel and read the invocation to assure the spirits;

sentences.zh: 禮成而焚之。

translations.literal: When the rite is complete, it is burned.
translations.idiomatic: when the rite is complete, the text is burned.

sentences.zh: 凡大祭祀，卿省牲而告充。

translations.literal: At all great sacrifices, the Minister inspects the victims and announces their sufficiency.
translations.idiomatic: At every major sacrifice, the Minister inspects the victims and announces that they are sufficient.

sentences.zh: 凡祭天及日月星辰之玉帛，則焚之；

translations.literal: Whenever jade and silk offered to Heaven and the sun, moon, and stars are sacrificed, they are burned;
translations.idiomatic: Jade and silk offered to Heaven, the sun, moon, and stars are burned;

sentences.zh: 祭地及社稷山嶽，則瘞之；

translations.literal: those offered to Earth, the altars of soil and grain, and mountains are buried;
translations.idiomatic: those offered to Earth, the altars of soil and grain, and mountains are buried in the ground;

sentences.zh: 瀆汙，則沉之。

translations.literal: those for rivers and marshes are sunk.
translations.idiomatic: and those for rivers and marshes are sunk in the water.

sentences.zh: 奉禮郎掌朝會祭祀君臣之版位。

translations.literal: The Masters of Ceremonies manage the positions of ruler and ministers at court assemblies and sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: The Masters of Ceremonies arrange the positions of ruler and ministers at court assemblies and sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 凡樽卣之制，十有四，祭則陳之。

translations.literal: The forms of goblets and jars number fourteen; at sacrifices they are displayed.
translations.idiomatic: There are fourteen types of goblets and jars, which are displayed at sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 祭器之位，簠簋為前，㽅鈃次之，籩豆為後。

translations.literal: The positions of sacrificial vessels: grain trays and bowls come first, meat stands and cauldrons next, and baskets and dishes last.
translations.idiomatic: Sacrificial vessels are arranged with grain trays and bowls in front, meat stands and cauldrons next, and baskets and dishes in the rear.

sentences.zh: 大凡祭祀朝會，在位者拜跪之節，皆贊導之，贊者承傳焉。

translations.literal: In general, at sacrifices and court assemblies, the bowing and kneeling steps of those in position are all announced and guided; the announcers transmit them.
translations.idiomatic: At sacrifices and court assemblies, they announce and guide the bowing and kneeling of those in position, with announcers relaying each step.

sentences.zh: 又設牲榜之位，以成省牲之儀。

translations.literal: They also set the positions of the victim placards to complete the rite of inspecting victims.
translations.idiomatic: They also set out the victim placards to complete the victim-inspection rite.

sentences.zh: 凡春秋二仲，公卿巡陵，則主其威儀鼓吹之節而相禮焉。

translations.literal: Whenever in spring and autumn at the two mid-season months dukes and ministers inspect the tombs, they manage the pomp of guard of honor and processional music and assist in the rite.
translations.idiomatic: In spring and autumn, when dukes and ministers inspect the tombs at the two mid-season months, they manage the guard of honor and processional music and assist in the rite.

sentences.zh: 協律郎掌和六呂六律，辨四時之氣，八風五音之節。

translations.literal: The Masters of Harmonizing Pitch manage harmonizing the six lü and six pitch pipes, distinguishing the qi of the four seasons and the measures of the eight winds and five tones.
translations.idiomatic: The Masters of Harmonizing Pitch harmonize the six lü and six pitch pipes, distinguishing the qi of the four seasons and the measures of the eight winds and five tones.

sentences.zh: 凡太樂，則監試之，為之課限。

translations.literal: For all Grand Music, they supervise testing and set quotas.
translations.idiomatic: For all Grand Music performances, they supervise testing and set performance quotas.

sentences.zh: 若大祭祀饗宴奏於廷，則升堂執麾以為之節制，舉麾工鼓柷而後樂作，偃麾戛敔而後止。

translations.literal: If at a great sacrifice or feast music is performed in the hall, they ascend the hall holding the baton to regulate it: raising the baton, the workers strike the wooden clapper and then music begins; lowering the baton and striking the wooden stopper, it then stops.
translations.idiomatic: When music is performed in the hall at a major sacrifice or feast, they ascend the hall with a baton to regulate the performance: raising the baton, the musicians strike the wooden clapper and the music begins; lowering the baton and striking the wooden stopper, the music stops.

sentences.zh: 兩京郊社署：令各一人，從七品下。

translations.literal: Suburban Sacrifices Bureaus of the two capitals: one Director each, lower secondary seventh rank.
translations.idiomatic: Suburban Sacrifices Bureaus of the two capitals — one Director each, lower secondary seventh rank.

sentences.zh: 丞一人，從八品上。

translations.literal: One Assistant Director, upper secondary eighth rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Assistant Director, upper secondary eighth rank.

sentences.zh: 府二人，史四人，典事三人，掌固五人，門僕八人，齋郎一百一十人。

translations.literal: Two clerks, four scribes, three record keepers, five gatekeepers, eight gate servants, one hundred ten Fast Officers.
translations.idiomatic: Two clerks, four scribes, three record keepers, five gatekeepers, eight gate servants, and one hundred ten Fast Officers.

sentences.zh: 郊社令掌五郊社稷明堂之位，祠祀祈禱之禮。

translations.literal: The Director of Suburban Sacrifices manages the positions of the five suburban altars, altars of soil and grain, and Bright Hall, and the rites of sacrifice and prayer.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of Suburban Sacrifices oversees the five suburban altars, the altars of soil and grain, and the Bright Hall, and conducts the rites of sacrifice and prayer.

sentences.zh: 丞為之貳。

translations.literal: The Assistant Director is his deputy.
translations.idiomatic: The Assistant Director serves as his deputy.

sentences.zh: 凡大祭祀，則設神坐於壇上而別其位，立燎壇而先積柴。

translations.literal: Whenever there is a great sacrifice, spirit seats are set on the altar mound and their positions distinguished; a burning mound is erected and firewood piled first.
translations.idiomatic: At a major sacrifice, spirit seats are placed on the altar mound in their proper positions, a burning mound is erected, and firewood is piled in advance.

sentences.zh: 凡有合朔之變，則置五兵於太社，以硃絲縈之以俟變，過時而罷之。

translations.literal: Whenever there is an eclipse at new or full moon, five weapons are placed at the Grand Altar of Soil and Grain, bound with cinnabar silk to await the change; when the time passes, they are removed.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever a new- or full-moon eclipse is expected, five weapons are placed at the Grand Altar of Soil and Grain and bound with cinnabar silk to await the event; they are removed once the time has passed.

sentences.zh: 諸陵署：令一人，從五品上。

translations.literal: Imperial Tombs Bureau: one Director, upper secondary fifth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial Tombs Bureau — one Director, upper secondary fifth rank.

sentences.zh: 錄事一人，府二人，史四人，主衣四人，主輦四人，主藥四人，典事三人，掌固二人。

translations.literal: One recording clerk, two clerks, four scribes, four robe keepers, four carriage keepers, four medicine keepers, three record keepers, two gatekeepers.
translations.idiomatic: One recording clerk, two clerks, four scribes, four robe keepers, four carriage keepers, four medicine keepers, three record keepers, and two gatekeepers.

sentences.zh: 陵戶，乾，橋、昭四百人，獻、定、恭三百人。

translations.literal: Tomb households: for Qian, Qiao, and Zhao tombs, four hundred; for Xian, Ding, and Gong tombs, three hundred.
translations.idiomatic: Tomb households numbered four hundred for the tombs of Qian, Qiao, and Zhao, and three hundred for those of Xian, Ding, and Gong.

sentences.zh: 陵令掌先帝山陵，率戶守衛之。

translations.literal: The Tomb Director manages the mountain tombs of former emperors and leads the households in guarding them.
translations.idiomatic: The Tomb Director oversees the mountain tombs of former emperors and leads the tomb households in guarding them.

sentences.zh: 丞為之貳。

translations.literal: The Assistant Director is his deputy.
translations.idiomatic: The Assistant Director serves as his deputy.

sentences.zh: 凡朔望、元正、冬至，皆修享于諸陵。

translations.literal: Whenever on the first and fifteenth of the month, New Year's Day, and the winter solstice, offerings are performed at all tombs.
translations.idiomatic: On the first and fifteenth of each month, New Year's Day, and the winter solstice, offerings are performed at all tombs.

sentences.zh: 凡功臣密戚陪葬者聽之，以文武分為左右列。

translations.literal: Meritorious ministers and close kin permitted to be buried with the tomb are allowed; civil and military are divided into left and right rows.
translations.idiomatic: Meritorious ministers and close kin may be permitted burial alongside the tomb, arranged in left and right rows by civil and military status.

sentences.zh: 諸太子陵令各一人，從八品下。

translations.literal: Directors of crown prince tombs, one each, lower secondary eighth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Each crown prince's tomb has one Director of lower secondary eighth rank.

sentences.zh: 丞一人。

translations.literal: One Assistant Director.
translations.idiomatic: One Assistant Director.

sentences.zh: 從九品下。

translations.literal: Lower secondary ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Lower secondary ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 太樂署：令一人，從七品下。

translations.literal: Grand Music Bureau: one Director, lower secondary seventh rank.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Music Bureau — one Director, lower secondary seventh rank.

sentences.zh: 丞一人，從八品下。

translations.literal: One Assistant Director, lower secondary eighth rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Assistant Director, lower secondary eighth rank.

sentences.zh: 府三人，史六人。

translations.literal: Three clerks, six scribes.
translations.idiomatic: Three clerks and six scribes.

sentences.zh: 樂正八人，從九品下。

translations.literal: Eight music masters, lower secondary ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Eight music masters, lower secondary ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 典事八人，掌固八人，文武二舞郎一百四十人。

translations.literal: Eight record keepers, eight gatekeepers, one hundred forty civil and military dance officers.
translations.idiomatic: Eight record keepers, eight gatekeepers, and one hundred forty civil and military dance officers.

sentences.zh: 太樂令調合鐘律，以供邦國之祭祀享宴。

translations.literal: The Director of Grand Music harmonizes bells and pitch pipes to supply the state's sacrifices and feasts.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of Grand Music harmonizes bells and pitch pipes for the state's sacrifices and banquets.

sentences.zh: 丞為之貳。

translations.literal: The Assistant Director is his deputy.
translations.idiomatic: The Assistant Director serves as his deputy.

sentences.zh: 凡天子宮懸鐘磬，凡三十六虡，鎛鐘十二，編鐘二二，編磬十二，共為三十六架。

translations.literal: The Son of Heaven's palace suspended bells and chimes: thirty-six frames in all, twelve large bells, twenty-four serial bells, twelve serial chimes, totaling thirty-six sets.
translations.idiomatic: The Son of Heaven's palace music includes thirty-six suspended frames: twelve large bells, twenty-four serial bells, and twelve serial chimes, for thirty-six sets in all.

sentences.zh: 東方西方，磬虡起北，鐘虡次之。

translations.literal: East and west: chime frames start from the north, bell frames come next.
translations.idiomatic: On the east and west, chime frames are placed starting from the north, with bell frames next.

sentences.zh: 南方北方，磬虡起西，鐘虡次之。

translations.literal: South and north: chime frames start from the west, bell frames come next.
translations.idiomatic: On the south and north, chime frames are placed starting from the west, with bell frames next.

sentences.zh: 鎛鐘在編鐘之間，各依辰位。

translations.literal: Large bells are placed among the serial bells, each according to its celestial position.
translations.idiomatic: Large bells are placed among the serial bells, each positioned according to its celestial station.

sentences.zh: 四隅建鼓，左柷右敔。

translations.literal: At the four corners stand drums; on the left the wooden clapper, on the right the wooden stopper.
translations.idiomatic: Drums stand at the four corners, with the wooden clapper on the left and the wooden stopper on the right.

sentences.zh: 又設巢、竽、笛、管、篪、塤、系於編鐘之下。

translations.literal: Also set out are nest zithers, yu mouth organs, flutes, pipes, chi flutes, and xun ocarinas, attached beneath the serial bells.
translations.idiomatic: Nest zithers, yu mouth organs, flutes, pipes, chi flutes, and xun ocarinas are also placed beneath the serial bells.

sentences.zh: 偶歌琴、瑟、箏、築，系於編磬之下。

translations.literal: Paired are zithers, se lutes, zheng zithers, and zhu zithers for song, attached beneath the serial chimes.
translations.idiomatic: Zithers, se lutes, zheng zithers, and zhu zithers for accompanying song are placed beneath the serial chimes.

sentences.zh: 其在殿廷前，則加鼓吹十二案，於建鼓之外，羽葆之鼓、大鼓、金鐓、歌簫、笳置於其上。

translations.literal: When in front of the hall court, twelve processional music stands are added; beyond the standing drums, feathered-canopy drums, great drums, bronze gongs, song panpipes, and horns are placed upon them.
translations.idiomatic: Before the hall court, twelve processional music stands are added; beyond the standing drums, feathered-canopy drums, great drums, bronze gongs, song panpipes, and horns are placed on them.

sentences.zh: 又設登歌鐘、節鼓、瑟、琴、箏、笳於堂上，笙、和、簫、篪於堂下。

translations.literal: Also set out are ascending-song bells, rhythm drums, se lutes, zithers, zheng zithers, and horns in the hall above; sheng mouth organs, he pipes, panpipes, and chi flutes in the hall below.
translations.idiomatic: Ascending-song bells, rhythm drums, se lutes, zithers, zheng zithers, and horns are placed in the upper hall; sheng mouth organs, he pipes, panpipes, and chi flutes in the lower hall.

sentences.zh: 太子之廷，陳軒懸，去其南面鎛鐘、編鐘編磬各三，凡九壒，設於辰、丑、申之位。

translations.literal: In the crown prince's court, the elevated suspension is displayed; removing from the south three large bells, three serial bells, and three serial chimes, nine sets in all are placed at the chen, chou, and shen positions.
translations.idiomatic: In the crown prince's court, the elevated suspension is displayed with three large bells, three serial bells, and three serial chimes removed from the south, nine sets in all placed at the chen, chou, and shen positions.

sentences.zh: 三建鼓亦如之。

translations.literal: Three standing drums are likewise.
translations.idiomatic: Three standing drums are arranged likewise.

sentences.zh: 凡宮懸之作，則奏文武舞，事在《音樂志》也。

translations.literal: Whenever palace suspended music is performed, the civil and military dances are played; the matter is treated in the 《Treatise on Music》.
translations.idiomatic: When palace suspended music is performed, the civil and military dances are played; the details are set forth in the 《Treatise on Music》.

sentences.zh: 凡大宴會，則設十部伎。

translations.literal: At all great banquets, the ten-section entertainments are set out.
translations.idiomatic: At major banquets, the ten-section entertainments are performed.

sentences.zh: 凡大祭祀、朝會用樂，辨其曲度章服，而分始終之次。

translations.literal: For all great sacrifices and court assemblies using music, the tunes, measures, and vestments are distinguished, and the order of beginning and ending is divided.
translations.idiomatic: For major sacrifices and court assemblies, music is arranged by distinguishing tunes, measures, and vestments and setting the order of opening and closing.

sentences.zh: 在事於太廟，每室酌獻各用舞。

translations.literal: When rites are performed at the Grand Ancestral Temple, each chamber's libation offering uses its own dance.
translations.idiomatic: When rites are performed at the Grand Ancestral Temple, each chamber's libation offering has its own dance.

sentences.zh: 事具《音樂志》。

translations.literal: The details are fully given in the 《Treatise on Music》.
translations.idiomatic: Full particulars are given in the 《Treatise on Music》.

sentences.zh: 凡祀昊天上帝及五方《大明》、《夜明》之樂，皆六成，祭皇地祇神州社稷之樂，皆八成，享宗廟之樂，皆九成。

translations.literal: For sacrifices to August Heaven and the music of the five directions, 《Great Brightness》 and 《Night Brightness》, all are six sections; for sacrifices to August Earth, the Divine Land, and altars of soil and grain, all are eight sections; for offerings at the ancestral temple, all are nine sections.
translations.idiomatic: Music for sacrifices to August Heaven and the five directions, 《Great Brightness》 and 《Night Brightness》, has six sections; music for sacrifices to August Earth, the Divine Land, and altars of soil and grain has eight sections; music for ancestral temple offerings has nine sections.

sentences.zh: 其餘祭祀，三成而已。

translations.literal: For the remaining sacrifices, three sections only.
translations.idiomatic: All other sacrifices use only three sections.

sentences.zh: 五音有成數，觀其數而用之也。

translations.literal: The five tones have fixed numbers; observing the numbers, they are applied.
translations.idiomatic: The five tones have fixed numerical values, and music is arranged according to those numbers.

sentences.zh: 凡習樂，立師以教。

translations.literal: For all music study, masters are established to teach.
translations.idiomatic: For music training, masters are appointed to teach.

sentences.zh: 每歲考其師之課業，為上中下三等，申禮部。

translations.literal: Each year the masters' coursework is examined and graded upper, middle, and lower, and reported to the Ministry of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: Each year the masters' teaching is examined and graded upper, middle, or lower, and reported to the Ministry of Rites.

sentences.zh: 十年大校之，量優劣而黜陟焉。

translations.literal: Every ten years a great review is held, measuring merit and demerit to promote or dismiss.
translations.idiomatic: Every ten years a major review is held, and promotions and dismissals are made according to merit.

sentences.zh: 凡樂人及音聲人應教習，皆著簿籍，核其名數，分番上下。

translations.literal: All musicians and vocalists subject to instruction are entered in registers, their names and numbers verified, and shifts divided for rotation.
translations.idiomatic: All musicians and vocalists under instruction are entered in registers, their names and numbers verified, and assigned to rotating shifts.

sentences.zh: 鼓吹署：令一人，從七品下。

translations.literal: Processional Music Bureau: one Director, lower secondary seventh rank.
translations.idiomatic: Processional Music Bureau — one Director, lower secondary seventh rank.

sentences.zh: 丞三人，從八品下。

translations.literal: Three Assistant Directors, lower secondary eighth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Three Assistant Directors, lower secondary eighth rank.

sentences.zh: 府三人，史六人。

translations.literal: Three clerks, six scribes.
translations.idiomatic: Three clerks and six scribes.

sentences.zh: 樂正四人，從九品下。

translations.literal: Four music masters, lower secondary ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Four music masters, lower secondary ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 典事四人，掌固四人。

translations.literal: Four record keepers, four gatekeepers.
translations.idiomatic: Four record keepers and four gatekeepers.

sentences.zh: 鼓吹令掌鼓吹施用調習之節，以備鹵簿之儀。

translations.literal: The Director of Processional Music manages the measures for deploying, applying, and rehearsing processional music to supply the guard of honor observances.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of Processional Music oversees the deployment, use, and rehearsal of processional music for the guard of honor.

sentences.zh: 丞為之貳。

translations.literal: The Assistant Director is his deputy.
translations.idiomatic: The Assistant Director serves as his deputy.

sentences.zh: 凡大駕行幸，鹵簿則分前後二部以統之。

translations.literal: Whenever the great carriage travels on tour, the guard of honor is divided into front and rear two sections to command it.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor travels on tour, the guard of honor is divided into front and rear sections.

sentences.zh: 法駕則三分減一，小駕則減大駕之半。

translations.literal: The regulated carriage reduces by one-third; the lesser carriage reduces by half of the great carriage.
translations.idiomatic: The regulated carriage uses two-thirds of the great carriage's guard; the lesser carriage uses half.

sentences.zh: 皇太后、皇后出，則如小駕之例。

translations.literal: When the Empress Dowager or Empress goes out, it follows the example of the lesser carriage.
translations.idiomatic: When the Empress Dowager or Empress goes out, the arrangement follows that of the lesser carriage.

sentences.zh: 皇太子之鼓吹，亦有前後二部。

translations.literal: The crown prince's processional music also has front and rear two sections.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince's processional music also has front and rear sections.

sentences.zh: 親王已下各有差。

translations.literal: Imperial princes and below each have differences.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial princes and those below them have graduated reductions.

sentences.zh: 凡大駕行幸，有夜警晨嚴之制。

translations.literal: Whenever the great carriage travels on tour, there is the system of night watch and morning salute.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor travels on tour, there is a system of night watch and morning salute.

sentences.zh: 大駕夜警十二部，晨嚴三通。

translations.literal: The great carriage: twelve sections for night watch, three rounds for morning salute.
translations.idiomatic: For the great carriage, night watch uses twelve sections and morning salute three rounds.

sentences.zh: 太子諸王公卿已下，警嚴有差。

translations.literal: The crown prince, princes, dukes, ministers, and below—watch and salute have differences.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince, princes, dukes, ministers, and those below them have graduated watch and salute arrangements.

sentences.zh: 凡合朔之變，則率工人設五鼓於太社。

translations.literal: Whenever there is an eclipse at new or full moon, workers are led to set five drums at the Grand Altar of Soil and Grain.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever a new- or full-moon eclipse is expected, workers are led to set five drums at the Grand Altar of Soil and Grain.

sentences.zh: 太儺，則帥鼓角以助侲子唱之。

translations.literal: At the great exorcism, drums and horns are led to assist the demon-quellers in their chanting.
translations.idiomatic: At the great exorcism rite, drums and horns are led to accompany the demon-quellers' chanting.

sentences.zh: 大醫署：令二人，從七品下。

translations.literal: Imperial Physicians Bureau: two Directors, lower secondary seventh rank.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial Physicians Bureau — two Directors, lower secondary seventh rank.

sentences.zh: 丞二人，從八品下。

translations.literal: Two Assistant Directors, lower secondary eighth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Two Assistant Directors, lower secondary eighth rank.

sentences.zh: 府二人，史四人，主藥八人，藥童二十四人。

translations.literal: Two clerks, four scribes, eight medicine keepers, twenty-four medicine boys.
translations.idiomatic: Two clerks, four scribes, eight medicine keepers, and twenty-four medicine boys.

sentences.zh: 醫監四人，從八品下。

translations.literal: Four medical supervisors, lower secondary eighth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Four medical supervisors, lower secondary eighth rank.

sentences.zh: 醫正八人，從九品下。

translations.literal: Eight medical masters, lower secondary ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Eight medical masters, lower secondary ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 藥園師二人，藥園生八人，掌固四人。

translations.literal: Two herb-garden masters, eight herb-garden students, four gatekeepers.
translations.idiomatic: Two herb-garden masters, eight herb-garden students, and four gatekeepers.

sentences.zh: 太醫令掌醫療之法。

translations.literal: The Director of Imperial Physicians manages the methods of medical treatment.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of Imperial Physicians oversees medical treatment.

sentences.zh: 丞為之貳。

translations.literal: The Assistant Director is his deputy.
translations.idiomatic: The Assistant Director serves as his deputy.

sentences.zh: 其屬有四，曰：醫師、針師、按摩師、禁咒師。

translations.literal: Its subordinates are four, namely: physicians, acupuncturists, massage therapists, and incantation specialists.
translations.idiomatic: It has four branches: physicians, acupuncturists, massage therapists, and incantation specialists.

sentences.zh: 皆有博士以教之。

translations.literal: All have erudites to teach them.
translations.idiomatic: Each branch has erudites who teach its students.

sentences.zh: 其考試登用，如國子之法。

translations.literal: Their examination and appointment follow the methods of the Directorate of Education.
translations.idiomatic: Examination and appointment follow the methods used by the Directorate of Education.

sentences.zh: 凡醫師、醫工、醫正療人疾病，以其全多少而書之以為考課。

translations.literal: Whenever physicians, medical workers, and medical masters treat people's illnesses, the number cured is recorded for performance review.
translations.idiomatic: When physicians, medical workers, and medical masters treat patients, the number of cures is recorded for performance review.

sentences.zh: 藥園師，以時種蒔收采。

translations.literal: Herb-garden masters plant, cultivate, harvest, and gather according to season.
translations.idiomatic: Herb-garden masters plant, cultivate, and harvest according to the seasons.

sentences.zh: 諸藥醫博士一人，正八品上。

translations.literal: One Erudite of Medicine, upper eighth rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Erudite of Medicine, upper eighth rank.

sentences.zh: 助教一人，從九品下。

translations.literal: One Assistant Instructor, lower secondary ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Assistant Instructor, lower secondary ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 醫師二十人，醫工一百人，醫生四十人，典藥二人。

translations.literal: Twenty physicians, one hundred medical workers, forty medical students, two medicine keepers.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty physicians, one hundred medical workers, forty medical students, and two medicine keepers.

sentences.zh: 博士掌以醫術教授諸生。

translations.literal: The Erudite manages teaching the students medical arts.
translations.idiomatic: The Erudite teaches medical arts to the students.

sentences.zh: 醫術，謂習《本草》，《甲乙脈經》。

translations.literal: Medical arts means studying the 《Materia Medica》 and the 《Classic of the Pulse in A and B》.
translations.idiomatic: Medical arts means studying the 《Materia Medica》 and the 《Classic of the Pulse in A and B》.

sentences.zh: 分而為業，一曰體療，二曰瘡腫，三曰少小，四曰耳目口齒，五曰角法也。

translations.literal: Divided into specialties: first, general therapy; second, sores and swellings; third, pediatrics; fourth, ears, eyes, mouth, and teeth; fifth, cupping.
translations.idiomatic: Training is divided into five specialties: general therapy, sores and swellings, pediatrics, ears, eyes, mouth, and teeth, and cupping.

sentences.zh: 針博士一人，從八品下。

translations.literal: One Erudite of Acupuncture, lower secondary eighth rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Erudite of Acupuncture, lower secondary eighth rank.

sentences.zh: 針助教一人，從九品下。

translations.literal: One Assistant Instructor of Acupuncture, lower secondary ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Assistant Instructor of Acupuncture, lower secondary ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 針師十人，針工二十人，針生二十人。

translations.literal: Ten acupuncturists, twenty acupuncture workers, twenty acupuncture students.
translations.idiomatic: Ten acupuncturists, twenty acupuncture workers, and twenty acupuncture students.

sentences.zh: 針博士掌教針生以經脈孔穴，使識浮沉澀滑之候，又以九針為補瀉之法。

translations.literal: The Erudite of Acupuncture manages teaching acupuncture students the meridians and acupoints, enabling them to recognize the signs of floating, sinking, rough, and smooth pulses, and also the nine needles as methods of tonification and drainage.
translations.idiomatic: The Erudite of Acupuncture teaches students the meridians and acupoints, how to read floating, sinking, rough, and smooth pulses, and the nine needles as methods of tonification and drainage.

sentences.zh: 其針名有九，應病用之也。

translations.literal: The needle names are nine; they are applied according to the illness.
translations.idiomatic: There are nine named needles, each applied according to the illness.

sentences.zh: 按摩博士一人，從九品下。

translations.literal: One Erudite of Massage, lower secondary ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Erudite of Massage, lower secondary ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 按摩師四人，按摩工十六人，按摩生十五人。

translations.literal: Four massage therapists, sixteen massage workers, fifteen massage students.
translations.idiomatic: Four massage therapists, sixteen massage workers, and fifteen massage students.

sentences.zh: 按摩博士掌教按摩生消息導引之法。

translations.literal: The Erudite of Massage manages teaching massage students the methods of breathing regulation and guided movement.
translations.idiomatic: The Erudite of Massage teaches students the methods of breathing regulation and guided movement.

sentences.zh: 咒禁博士一人，從九品下。

translations.literal: One Erudite of Incantation, lower secondary ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Erudite of Incantation, lower secondary ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 咒禁師二人，咒禁工八人，咒禁生十人。

translations.literal: Two incantation specialists, eight incantation workers, ten incantation students.
translations.idiomatic: Two incantation specialists, eight incantation workers, and ten incantation students.

sentences.zh: 咒禁博士掌教咒禁生以咒禁，除邪魅之為厲者。

translations.literal: The Erudite of Incantation manages teaching incantation students incantations to expel evil spirits that cause pestilence.
translations.idiomatic: The Erudite of Incantation teaches students incantations to drive off evil spirits that cause pestilence.

sentences.zh: 太卜署：令一人，從八品下。

translations.literal: Grand Divination Bureau: one Director, lower secondary eighth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Divination Bureau — one Director, lower secondary eighth rank.

sentences.zh: 丞一人，正九品。

translations.literal: One Assistant Director, ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Assistant Director, ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 卜正二人，從九品下。

translations.literal: Two divination masters, lower secondary ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Two divination masters, lower secondary ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 卜博士二人。

translations.literal: Two Erudites of Divination.
translations.idiomatic: Two Erudites of Divination.

sentences.zh: 從九品下。

translations.literal: Lower secondary ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Lower secondary ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 太卜令掌卜筮之法。

translations.literal: The Director of Grand Divination manages the methods of divination by tortoise shell and milfoil.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of Grand Divination oversees divination by tortoise shell and milfoil.

sentences.zh: 丞為之貳。

translations.literal: The Assistant Director is his deputy.
translations.idiomatic: The Assistant Director serves as his deputy.

sentences.zh: 其法有四：一龜，二五兆，三易，四式。

translations.literal: Its methods are four: first, tortoise shell; second, five omens; third, Changes; fourth, Shi.
translations.idiomatic: There are four methods: tortoise-shell divination, five omens, the Changes, and the Shi method.

sentences.zh: 皆辨其象數，通其消息，所以定吉凶焉。

translations.literal: All distinguish their images and numbers, penetrate their waxing and waning, and thereby determine fortune and misfortune.
translations.idiomatic: All distinguish images and numbers, read their waxing and waning, and thereby determine fortune and misfortune.

sentences.zh: 凡國有祭祀，則率卜正、占者，卜日于太廟南門之外。

translations.literal: Whenever the state has a sacrifice, divination masters and diviners are led to divine the day outside the south gate of the Grand Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever the state holds a sacrifice, divination masters and diviners are led to determine the day outside the south gate of the Grand Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 歲季冬之晦，帥侲子入宮中堂贈大儺。

translations.literal: At the last day of late winter each year, demon-quellers are led into the palace central hall to perform the great exorcism of sending away.
translations.idiomatic: On the last day of late winter each year, demon-quellers are led into the palace central hall to perform the great exorcism rite.

sentences.zh: 贈，送也，堂中舞侲子，以送不祥也。

translations.literal: Zeng means to send away; in the hall demon-quellers dance to send away ill omens.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng means to send away: in the hall the demon-quellers dance to drive off ill omens.

sentences.zh: 廩犧署：令一人，正八品下。

translations.literal: Sacrificial Livestock Bureau: one Director, lower eighth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Sacrificial Livestock Bureau — one Director, lower eighth rank.

sentences.zh: 丞一人。

translations.literal: One Assistant Director.
translations.idiomatic: One Assistant Director.

sentences.zh: 正九品。

translations.literal: Ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 廩犧令掌薦犧牲及粢盛之事。

translations.literal: The Director of Sacrificial Livestock manages presenting sacrificial victims and grain offerings.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of Sacrificial Livestock oversees the presentation of sacrificial victims and grain offerings.

sentences.zh: 丞為之貳。

translations.literal: The Assistant Director is his deputy.
translations.idiomatic: The Assistant Director serves as his deputy.

sentences.zh: 凡三祀之牲牢，各有名數。

translations.literal: For all three sacrificial rites, the victims and pens each have fixed names and numbers.
translations.idiomatic: For the three sacrificial rites, victims and pens each have prescribed names and numbers.

sentences.zh: 大祭祀，則與太祝以牲就榜位，太常卿省牲，則北面告腯，乃牽牲以授太官。

translations.literal: At a great sacrifice, together with the Grand Invoker they bring the victim to the placard position; when the Minister of Ritual inspects the victim, facing north he announces its fatness, then leads the victim to hand it to the Grand Provisioner.
translations.idiomatic: At a major sacrifice, together with the Grand Invoker they bring the victim to the placard; when the Minister of Ritual inspects it, facing north he announces its condition, then leads the victim to the Grand Provisioner.

sentences.zh: 汾祠署：令一人，從七品下。

translations.literal: Fen Shrine Bureau: one Director, lower secondary seventh rank.
translations.idiomatic: Fen Shrine Bureau — one Director, lower secondary seventh rank.

sentences.zh: 丞一人。

translations.literal: One Assistant Director.
translations.idiomatic: One Assistant Director.

sentences.zh: 從八品上。

translations.literal: Upper secondary eighth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Upper secondary eighth rank.

sentences.zh: 汾祠令、丞，掌神祀、享祭、灑掃之制。

translations.literal: The Director and Assistant Director of the Fen Shrine manage the regulations for spirit worship, offerings, and sweeping.
translations.idiomatic: The Director and Assistant Director of the Fen Shrine oversee regulations for spirit worship, offerings, and maintenance.

sentences.zh: 兩京齊太公廟署：令各一人，從七品下。

translations.literal: Duke of Qi Temple Bureaus of the two capitals: one Director each, lower secondary seventh rank.
translations.idiomatic: Duke of Qi Temple Bureaus of the two capitals — one Director each, lower secondary seventh rank.

sentences.zh: 丞各一人，從八品上。

translations.literal: One Assistant Director each, upper secondary eighth rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Assistant Director each, upper secondary eighth rank.

sentences.zh: 令、丞掌開合、灑掃及春秋仲釋尊之禮。

translations.literal: The Director and Assistant Director manage opening and closing, sweeping, and the rites of mid-spring and mid-autumn libation offerings.
translations.idiomatic: The Director and Assistant Director oversee opening and closing, maintenance, and the mid-spring and mid-autumn libation rites.

sentences.zh: 光祿寺光祿寺秦曰郎中令，漢曰光祿勳，掌宮殿門戶。

translations.literal: Directorate of Imperial Entertainments. Under Qin it was called Director of Palace Attendants; under Han, Commissioner of Imperial Entertainments, managing palace gates and doorways.
translations.idiomatic: Directorate of Imperial Entertainments. Under Qin the office was called Director of Palace Attendants; under Han it became Commissioner of Imperial Entertainments, overseeing palace gates and doorways.

sentences.zh: 梁置十二卿，加「寺」字，除「勳」字，曰光祿卿，掌膳食，後因之。

translations.literal: Liang established twelve Ministers, added the character "Directorate," removed the character "Commissioner," calling it Minister of Imperial Entertainments, managing meals; later ages followed this.
translations.idiomatic: The Liang established twelve Ministers, added "Directorate," dropped "Commissioner," and named the office Minister of Imperial Entertainments with charge over meals; later dynasties kept the arrangement.

sentences.zh: 品第三。

translations.literal: Rank third.
translations.idiomatic: Rank third.

sentences.zh: 龍朔改為司膳寺正卿，光宅改為司膳寺卿，神龍復為光祿寺也。

translations.literal: Longshuo changed it to Chief Minister of the Directorate of Provisions; Guangzhai changed it to Minister of the Directorate of Provisions; Shendlong restored it to the Directorate of Imperial Entertainments.
translations.idiomatic: Under Longshuo it became Chief Minister of the Directorate of Provisions; under Guangzhai, Minister of the Directorate of Provisions; under Shendlong it was restored to the Directorate of Imperial Entertainments.

sentences.zh: 卿一員，從三品。

translations.literal: One Minister, secondary third rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Minister, secondary third rank.

sentences.zh: 少卿二人。

translations.literal: Two Vice Ministers.
translations.idiomatic: Two Vice Ministers.

sentences.zh: 從四品上。

translations.literal: Upper secondary fourth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Upper secondary fourth rank.

sentences.zh: 卿之職，掌邦國酒醴、膳羞之事，總太官、珍羞、良醖、掌醢之屬，修其儲備，謹其出納。

translations.literal: The Minister's duty is to manage the state's wine, spirits, and delicacies, overseeing the subordinates of Grand Provisioner, Delicacies, Good Brew, and Pickled Meats, maintaining their stores and carefully controlling disbursements and receipts.
translations.idiomatic: The Minister oversees the state's wine, spirits, and delicacies, supervising Grand Provisioner, Delicacies, Good Brew, and Pickled Meats, maintaining stores and carefully controlling disbursements and receipts.

sentences.zh: 少卿為之貳。

translations.literal: The Vice Minister is his deputy.
translations.idiomatic: The Vice Minister serves as his deputy.

sentences.zh: 國有大祭祀，則省牲獲，視濯滌。

translations.literal: When the state has a great sacrifice, victims and harvest offerings are inspected and washing and cleansing are overseen.
translations.idiomatic: At a state major sacrifice, he inspects victims and harvest offerings and oversees washing and cleansing.

sentences.zh: 若三公攝祭，則為之終獻。

translations.literal: If the Three Excellencies officiate in proxy, he serves as final offerer.
translations.idiomatic: When the Three Excellencies officiate in the ruler's stead, he serves as final offerer.

sentences.zh: 朝會宴享，則節其等差，量其豐約以供焉。

translations.literal: At court assemblies and banquets, he regulates the gradations and measures abundance or restraint in supplying them.
translations.idiomatic: At court assemblies and banquets, he regulates gradations of rank and supplies provisions according to abundance or restraint.

sentences.zh: 丞二人，從六品上。

translations.literal: Two Assistant Directors, upper secondary sixth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Two Assistant Directors, upper secondary sixth rank.

sentences.zh: 主簿二人，從七品上。

translations.literal: Two Chief Clerks, upper secondary seventh rank.
translations.idiomatic: Two Chief Clerks, upper secondary seventh rank.

sentences.zh: 錄事二人，從九品上。

translations.literal: Two Recording Clerks, upper secondary ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Two Recording Clerks, upper secondary ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 府十二人，史二十一人，亭長六人，掌固六人。

translations.literal: Twelve clerks, twenty-one scribes, six ward chiefs, six gatekeepers.
translations.idiomatic: Twelve clerks, twenty-one scribes, six ward chiefs, and six gatekeepers.

sentences.zh: 丞掌判寺事。

translations.literal: The Assistant Director supervises and decides directorate affairs.
translations.idiomatic: The Assistant Director supervises directorate business.

sentences.zh: 主簿掌印，勾檢稽失。

translations.literal: The Chief Clerk manages the seal and checks and audits errors.
translations.idiomatic: The Chief Clerk keeps the seal and audits for errors.

sentences.zh: 錄事掌受事發辰。

translations.literal: The Recording Clerk manages receiving documents and dispatching them on schedule.
translations.idiomatic: The Recording Clerk receives documents and dispatches them on schedule.

sentences.zh: 太官署：令二人，從七品下。

translations.literal: Grand Provisioner Bureau: two Directors, lower secondary seventh rank.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Provisioner Bureau — two Directors, lower secondary seventh rank.

sentences.zh: 丞四人，從八品下。

translations.literal: Four Assistant Directors, lower secondary eighth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Four Assistant Directors, lower secondary eighth rank.

sentences.zh: 府四人，史人。

translations.literal: Four clerks, scribes.
translations.idiomatic: Four clerks and scribes.

sentences.zh: 監膳十人，從九品下。

translations.literal: Ten meal supervisors, lower secondary ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Ten meal supervisors, lower secondary ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 主膳十五人，供膳二千四百人，掌固四人。

translations.literal: Fifteen meal masters, two thousand four hundred meal servers, four gatekeepers.
translations.idiomatic: Fifteen meal masters, two thousand four hundred meal servers, and four gatekeepers.

sentences.zh: 太官令掌供膳食之事。

translations.literal: The Director of the Grand Provisioner manages supplying meals.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of the Grand Provisioner oversees the supply of meals.

sentences.zh: 丞為之貳。

translations.literal: The Assistant Director is his deputy.
translations.idiomatic: The Assistant Director serves as his deputy.

sentences.zh: 凡祭之日，與卿詣廚省牲鑊，取明水于陰鑒，取明火于陽燧，帥宰人以鑾刀割牲，取其毛血，實之於豆，遂烹牲焉。

translations.literal: On the day of sacrifice, together with the Minister he goes to the kitchen to inspect victims and cauldrons, draws clear water from the yin mirror, draws bright fire from the yang fire-starter, leads butchers to cut the victim with the bell knife, takes its hair and blood, fills them in the vessel, and then cooks the victim.
translations.idiomatic: On sacrifice day, together with the Minister he inspects victims and cauldrons in the kitchen, draws clear water from the yin mirror and bright fire from the yang fire-starter, leads butchers to cut the victim with the bell knife, collects hair and blood in vessels, and cooks the victim.

sentences.zh: 又師進饌者實簠簋，設於饌幕之內。

translations.literal: Also the master who presents the food fills the grain trays and bowls and sets them inside the food curtain.
translations.idiomatic: The master who presents the food fills the grain trays and bowls and sets them inside the food curtain.

sentences.zh: 凡朝會宴享，九品已上並供其膳食。

translations.literal: At all court assemblies and banquets, those of ninth rank and above are all supplied meals.
translations.idiomatic: At court assemblies and banquets, meals are supplied to all officials of ninth rank and above.

sentences.zh: 凡供奉祭祀致齋之官，則視其品秩為之差降。

translations.literal: For all officials attending sacrifices and observing fasts, meals are graded according to rank.
translations.idiomatic: For officials attending sacrifices and observing fasts, meals are graded according to rank.

sentences.zh: 國子監釋奠，百官觀禮，亦如之。

translations.literal: At the Directorate of Education's libation offering, when all officials observe the rite, likewise.
translations.idiomatic: The same applies at the Directorate of Education's libation offering, when all officials observe the rite.

sentences.zh: 凡突衛當上，及命婦朝參宴會者，亦如之。

translations.literal: For all palace guards on duty and appointed wives attending court and banquets, likewise.
translations.idiomatic: The same applies to palace guards on duty and appointed wives attending court and banquets.

sentences.zh: 珍羞署：令一人，正八品下。

translations.literal: Delicacies Bureau: one Director, lower eighth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Delicacies Bureau — one Director, lower eighth rank.

sentences.zh: 丞二人，正九品下。

translations.literal: Two Assistant Directors, lower ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Two Assistant Directors, lower ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 府三人，史六人，典書八人，餳匠五人，掌固四人。

translations.literal: Three clerks, six scribes, eight record keepers, five confectioners, four gatekeepers.
translations.idiomatic: Three clerks, six scribes, eight record keepers, five confectioners, and four gatekeepers.

sentences.zh: 令掌庶羞之事，丞為之貳，以實籩豆。

translations.literal: The Director manages various delicacies; the Assistant Director is his deputy, filling the baskets and dishes.
translations.idiomatic: The Director oversees various delicacies; the Assistant Director serves as his deputy and fills the baskets and dishes.

sentences.zh: 陸產之品，曰榛栗脯修，水物之類，曰魚鹽菱芡。

translations.literal: Land products include hazelnuts, chestnuts, dried meat, and cured strips; water products include fish, salt, water caltrop, and gorgon fruit.
translations.idiomatic: Land products include hazelnuts, chestnuts, dried meat, and cured strips; water products include fish, salt, water caltrop, and gorgon fruit.

sentences.zh: 辨其名數，會其出入，以供祭祀朝會賓客之禮也。

translations.literal: Their names and numbers are distinguished, disbursements and receipts reconciled, to supply the rites of sacrifice, court assembly, and guest reception.
translations.idiomatic: Their names and numbers are distinguished and disbursements reconciled to supply sacrifices, court assemblies, and guest receptions.

sentences.zh: 良醖署：令二人，正八品下。

translations.literal: Good Brew Bureau: two Directors, lower eighth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Good Brew Bureau — two Directors, lower eighth rank.

sentences.zh: 丞二人，正九品下。

translations.literal: Two Assistant Directors, lower ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Two Assistant Directors, lower ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 府三人，史六人。

translations.literal: Three clerks, six scribes.
translations.idiomatic: Three clerks and six scribes.

sentences.zh: 監事二人，從九品下。

translations.literal: Two supervisors, lower secondary ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Two supervisors, lower secondary ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 掌醖三十人，酒匠十三人，奉觶一百二十人，掌固四人。

translations.literal: Thirty brew keepers, thirteen wine craftsmen, one hundred twenty cup bearers, four gatekeepers.
translations.idiomatic: Thirty brew keepers, thirteen wine craftsmen, one hundred twenty cup bearers, and four gatekeepers.

sentences.zh: 令掌供奉邦國祭祀五齊三酒之事。

translations.literal: The Director manages supplying the five grades of brew and three types of wine for state sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: The Director oversees the supply of the five grades of brew and three types of wine for state sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 丞為之貳。

translations.literal: The Assistant Director is his deputy.
translations.idiomatic: The Assistant Director serves as his deputy.

sentences.zh: 五齊三酒，義見《周官》。

translations.literal: The five grades of brew and three types of wine—their meaning is given in the 《Offices of Zhou》.
translations.idiomatic: The meaning of the five grades of brew and three types of wine is set forth in the 《Offices of Zhou》.

sentences.zh: 郊祀之日，帥其屬以實樽罍。

translations.literal: On the day of suburban sacrifice, he leads his subordinates to fill the goblets and jars.
translations.idiomatic: On suburban sacrifice day, he leads his staff to fill the goblets and jars.

sentences.zh: 若享太廟，供其鬱鬯之酒，以實六彝。

translations.literal: If offering at the Grand Ancestral Temple, he supplies the aromatic wine to fill the six ritual vessels.
translations.idiomatic: At offerings in the Grand Ancestral Temple, he supplies the aromatic wine to fill the six ritual vessels.

sentences.zh: 若應進者，則供春暴、秋清、酴醾、桑落等酒。

translations.literal: If tribute is due, he supplies spring sun-dried, autumn clarified, fermented flower, mulberry-fall, and other wines.
translations.idiomatic: When tribute wines are due, he supplies spring sun-dried, autumn clarified, fermented flower, mulberry-fall, and other wines.

sentences.zh: 掌醢署：令一人，正八品下。

translations.literal: Pickled Meats Bureau: one Director, lower eighth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Pickled Meats Bureau — one Director, lower eighth rank.

sentences.zh: 丞二人，正九品下。

translations.literal: Two Assistant Directors, lower ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Two Assistant Directors, lower ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 府二人，史四人，主醢十人。

translations.literal: Two clerks, four scribes, ten pickle keepers.
translations.idiomatic: Two clerks, four scribes, and ten pickle keepers.

sentences.zh: 令掌供醯醢之屬，而辨其名物。

translations.literal: The Director manages supplying vinegars and pickled meats and distinguishes their names and items.
translations.idiomatic: The Director supplies vinegars and pickled meats and distinguishes their names and types.

sentences.zh: 丞為之貳。

translations.literal: The Assistant Director is his deputy.
translations.idiomatic: The Assistant Director serves as his deputy.

sentences.zh: 凡鹿、兔、羊、魚等四醢。

translations.literal: There are four pickled meats: deer, rabbit, sheep, and fish.
translations.idiomatic: There are four types of pickled meat: deer, rabbit, sheep, and fish.

sentences.zh: 凡祭神祇，享宗廟，用菹醢以實豆。

translations.literal: For sacrificing to spirits and offering at the ancestral temple, pickled vegetables and meats are used to fill the dishes.
translations.idiomatic: For sacrifices to spirits and offerings at the ancestral temple, pickled vegetables and meats fill the dishes.

sentences.zh: 宴賓客，會百官，醢醬以和羹。

translations.literal: When feasting guests and gathering all officials, pickled meats and sauces harmonize the broth.
translations.idiomatic: When feasting guests and gathering officials, pickled meats and sauces are used to season the broth.

sentences.zh: 衛尉寺衛尉寺秦置衛尉，掌宮門衛屯兵，屬官有公車司馬、衛士、旅賁三令。

translations.literal: Directorate of the Palace Guard. Under Qin the Palace Guard was established, managing palace gate guards and garrison troops; subordinate offices included Directors of Imperial Carriages, Guards, and Rapid Tiger Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Directorate of the Palace Guard. Qin established the Palace Guard to manage palace gate guards and garrison troops; subordinate offices included Directors of Imperial Carriages, Guards, and Rapid Tiger Guard.

sentences.zh: 梁置十二卿，衛尉加「寺」字，官加「卿」字。

translations.literal: Liang established twelve Ministers; to Palace Guard was added the character "Directorate," and to the office the character "Minister."
translations.idiomatic: The Liang established twelve Ministers, adding "Directorate" to Palace Guard and "Minister" to the office title.

sentences.zh: 龍朔改為司衛寺，咸亨復也。

translations.literal: Longshuo changed it to the Directorate of Guardians; Xianheng restored it.
translations.idiomatic: Under Longshuo it became the Directorate of Guardians; under Xianheng the former name was restored.

sentences.zh: 卿一員，從三品。

translations.literal: One Minister, secondary third rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Minister, secondary third rank.

sentences.zh: 少卿二人。

translations.literal: Two Vice Ministers.
translations.idiomatic: Two Vice Ministers.

sentences.zh: 從四品上。

translations.literal: Upper secondary fourth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Upper secondary fourth rank.

sentences.zh: 卿之職，掌邦國器械文物之事，總武庫、武器、守宮三署之官屬。

translations.literal: The Minister's duty is to manage the state's implements, weapons, and ceremonial objects, overseeing the subordinates of the three bureaus of Armory, Weapons, and Palace Guard.
translations.idiomatic: The Minister oversees the state's implements, weapons, and ceremonial objects, supervising the Armory, Weapons, and Palace Guard bureaus.

sentences.zh: 少卿為之貳。

translations.literal: The Vice Minister is his deputy.
translations.idiomatic: The Vice Minister serves as his deputy.

sentences.zh: 凡天下兵器入京師者，皆籍其名數而藏之。

translations.literal: All weapons from throughout the realm entering the capital are registered by name and number and stored.
translations.idiomatic: All weapons from throughout the realm brought into the capital are registered by name and number and stored.

sentences.zh: 凡大祭祀大朝會，則供其羽儀、節鉞、金鼓、帷帟、茵席之屬。

translations.literal: At all great sacrifices and great court assemblies, feathered banners, ceremonial axes, bronze drums, curtains, mats, and the like are supplied.
translations.idiomatic: At major sacrifices and great court assemblies, it supplies feathered banners, ceremonial axes, bronze drums, curtains, mats, and the like.

sentences.zh: 丞二人，從六品上。

translations.literal: Two Assistant Directors, upper secondary sixth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Two Assistant Directors, upper secondary sixth rank.

sentences.zh: 主簿二人，從七品上。

translations.literal: Two Chief Clerks, upper secondary seventh rank.
translations.idiomatic: Two Chief Clerks, upper secondary seventh rank.

sentences.zh: 錄事一人，從九品上。

translations.literal: One Recording Clerk, upper secondary ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Recording Clerk, upper secondary ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 府六人，史十一人，亭長四人，掌固六人。

translations.literal: Six clerks, eleven scribes, four ward chiefs, six gatekeepers.
translations.idiomatic: Six clerks, eleven scribes, four ward chiefs, and six gatekeepers.

sentences.zh: 丞掌判寺事，辨器械出納之數。

translations.literal: The Assistant Director supervises directorate affairs and distinguishes the numbers of implements disbursed and received.
translations.idiomatic: The Assistant Director supervises directorate business and tracks the numbers of implements disbursed and received.

sentences.zh: 主簿掌印，勾檢稽失。

translations.literal: The Chief Clerk manages the seal and checks and audits errors.
translations.idiomatic: The Chief Clerk keeps the seal and audits for errors.

sentences.zh: 錄事掌受事發辰。

translations.literal: The Recording Clerk manages receiving documents and dispatching them on schedule.
translations.idiomatic: The Recording Clerk receives documents and dispatches them on schedule.

sentences.zh: 武庫：令、兩京各一人，從六品下。

translations.literal: Armory: one Director each in the two capitals, lower secondary sixth rank.
