translations.idiomatic: Armory — one Director each in the two capitals, lower secondary sixth rank.

sentences.zh: 丞二人，從八品下。

translations.literal: Two Assistant Directors, lower secondary eighth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Two Assistant Directors, lower secondary eighth rank.

sentences.zh: 府二人，史六人，監事一人，正九品上。

translations.literal: Two clerks, six scribes, one supervisor, upper ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Two clerks, six scribes, and one supervisor of upper ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 典事二人，掌固五人。

translations.literal: Two record keepers, five gatekeepers.
translations.idiomatic: Two record keepers and five gatekeepers.

sentences.zh: 令掌藏邦國之兵仗、器械，辨其名數，以備國用。

translations.literal: The Director manages storing the state's weapons and implements, distinguishing their names and numbers, to supply state needs.
translations.idiomatic: The Director stores the state's weapons and implements, distinguishing their names and numbers for state use.

sentences.zh: 丞為之貳。

translations.literal: The Assistant Director is his deputy.
translations.idiomatic: The Assistant Director serves as his deputy.

sentences.zh: 凡親征及大田巡狩，以羝羊、猳豬、雄雞釁鼓。

translations.literal: Whenever the ruler campaigns in person or conducts the great field hunt, a ram, a monkey-pig, and a rooster are used to smear the drums.
translations.idiomatic: When the ruler campaigns in person or conducts the great field hunt, a ram, a monkey-pig, and a rooster are used to smear the drums.

sentences.zh: 若太子親征及大將出師，則用猳肫。

translations.literal: If the crown prince campaigns in person or a great general leads an army out, a monkey-pig is used.
translations.idiomatic: When the crown prince campaigns in person or a great general leads an army out, a monkey-pig is used.

sentences.zh: 凡有赦，則先建金雞，兼置鼓于宮城門之右。

translations.literal: Whenever there is an amnesty, a golden rooster is first erected and a drum is also placed to the right of the palace gate.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever an amnesty is proclaimed, a golden rooster is erected first and a drum is placed to the right of the palace gate.

sentences.zh: 視大理及府縣囚徒至，則撾其鼓。

translations.literal: When prisoners from the Court of Judicial Review and prefectures and counties arrive, the drum is struck.
translations.idiomatic: When prisoners from the Court of Judicial Review and the prefectures and counties arrive, the drum is struck.

sentences.zh: 武器署：令一人，正八品下。

translations.literal: Weapons Bureau: one Director, lower eighth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Weapons Bureau — one Director, lower eighth rank.

sentences.zh: 丞二人，從九品下。

translations.literal: Two Assistant Directors, lower secondary ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Two Assistant Directors, lower secondary ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 府二人，史六人，監事一人，從九品下。

translations.literal: Two clerks, six scribes, one supervisor, lower secondary ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Two clerks, six scribes, and one supervisor of lower secondary ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 典事二人，掌固四人。

translations.literal: Two record keepers, four gatekeepers.
translations.idiomatic: Two record keepers and four gatekeepers.

sentences.zh: 令掌在外戎器，辨其名物，會其出入。

translations.literal: The Director manages ceremonial weapons kept outside, distinguishing their names and items and reconciling disbursements and receipts.
translations.idiomatic: The Director oversees ceremonial weapons kept outside, distinguishing their names and types and reconciling disbursements and receipts.

sentences.zh: 丞為之貳。

translations.literal: The Assistant Director is his deputy.
translations.idiomatic: The Assistant Director serves as his deputy.

sentences.zh: 凡大祭祀大朝會及巡幸，則納於武庫，供其鹵簿。

translations.literal: At all great sacrifices, great court assemblies, and imperial tours, items are deposited in the Armory to supply the guard of honor.
translations.idiomatic: At major sacrifices, great court assemblies, and imperial tours, items are deposited in the Armory to supply the guard of honor.

sentences.zh: 若王公百官婚葬之禮，應給鹵簿，亦供之。

translations.literal: If princes, dukes, and all officials require guard of honor for wedding or funeral rites, these are also supplied.
translations.idiomatic: Guard of honor is also supplied when princes, dukes, and officials require it for wedding or funeral rites.

sentences.zh: 守宮署：令一人，正八品下。

translations.literal: Palace Equipment Bureau: one Director, lower eighth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Palace Equipment Bureau — one Director, lower eighth rank.

sentences.zh: 丞二人，正九品下。

translations.literal: Two Assistant Directors, lower ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Two Assistant Directors, lower ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 府二人，史四人，監事二人，掌設六人，幕士一千六百人。

translations.literal: Two clerks, four scribes, two supervisors, six equipment keepers, one thousand six hundred tent attendants.
translations.idiomatic: Two clerks, four scribes, two supervisors, six equipment keepers, and one thousand six hundred tent attendants.

sentences.zh: 令掌邦國供帳之屬，辨其名物，會其出入。

translations.literal: The Director manages the state's tents and furnishings, distinguishing their names and items and reconciling disbursements and receipts.
translations.idiomatic: The Director oversees the state's tents and furnishings, distinguishing their names and types and reconciling disbursements and receipts.

sentences.zh: 丞為之貳。

translations.literal: The Assistant Director is his deputy.
translations.idiomatic: The Assistant Director serves as his deputy.

sentences.zh: 凡大祭祀大朝會及巡幸，則設王公百官位於正殿南門外。

translations.literal: At all great sacrifices, great court assemblies, and imperial tours, positions for princes, dukes, and all officials are set outside the south gate of the main hall.
translations.idiomatic: At major sacrifices, great court assemblies, and imperial tours, positions for princes, dukes, and all officials are arranged outside the south gate of the main hall.

sentences.zh: 宗正寺宗正寺《星經》有宗正星，在帝座之東南。

translations.literal: Directorate of the Imperial Clan. The Directorate of the Imperial Clan: the 《Classic of Stars》 has the Star of the Imperial Clan, southeast of the Emperor's Seat.
translations.idiomatic: Directorate of the Imperial Clan. The 《Classic of Stars》 records the Star of the Imperial Clan southeast of the Emperor's Seat.

sentences.zh: 秦置宗正，掌宗屬。

translations.literal: Qin established the Director of the Imperial Clan, managing the imperial kindred.
translations.idiomatic: Qin established the Director of the Imperial Clan to manage the imperial kindred.

sentences.zh: 梁置十二卿，宗正為一，署加「寺」字。

translations.literal: Liang established twelve Ministers; Director of the Imperial Clan was one, and "Directorate" was added to the office.
translations.idiomatic: The Liang established twelve Ministers, of whom the Director of the Imperial Clan was one; "Directorate" was added to the title.

sentences.zh: 隋品第二。

translations.literal: Under Sui, rank was second.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Sui, the rank was second.

sentences.zh: 光宅改為司屬，神龍復之也。

translations.literal: Guangzhai changed it to Director of Kindred; Shendlong restored it.
translations.idiomatic: Under Guangzhai it became Director of Kindred; under Shendlong the former name was restored.

sentences.zh: 卿一員，從三品上。

translations.literal: One Minister, upper secondary third rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Minister, upper secondary third rank.

sentences.zh: 少卿二員。

translations.literal: Two Vice Ministers.
translations.idiomatic: Two Vice Ministers.

sentences.zh: 從四品上。

translations.literal: Upper secondary fourth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Upper secondary fourth rank.

sentences.zh: 丞二人，從六品上。

translations.literal: Two Assistant Directors, upper secondary sixth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Two Assistant Directors, upper secondary sixth rank.

sentences.zh: 主簿一人，從七品上。

translations.literal: One Chief Clerk, upper secondary seventh rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Chief Clerk, upper secondary seventh rank.

sentences.zh: 錄事一人，從九品上。

translations.literal: One Recording Clerk, upper secondary ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Recording Clerk, upper secondary ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 府五人，史九人，亭長四人，掌固四人。

translations.literal: Five clerks, nine scribes, four ward chiefs, four gatekeepers.
translations.idiomatic: Five clerks, nine scribes, four ward chiefs, and four gatekeepers.

sentences.zh: 卿之職，掌九族六親之屬籍，以別昭穆之序，並領崇玄署。

translations.literal: The Minister's duty is to manage the registers of the nine clans and six kin, to distinguish the order of senior and junior branches, and also to oversee the Bureau of High Mysteries.
translations.idiomatic: The Minister maintains registers of the nine clans and six kin to distinguish senior and junior branches, and also oversees the Bureau of High Mysteries.

sentences.zh: 少卿為之貳。

translations.literal: The Vice Minister is his deputy.
translations.idiomatic: The Vice Minister serves as his deputy.

sentences.zh: 九廟之子孫，繼統為宗，餘曰族。

translations.literal: Descendants of the nine temples who succeed to the line are called the clan; the rest are called the kindred.
translations.idiomatic: Descendants of the nine temples who succeed to the line form the clan; the rest are the kindred.

sentences.zh: 凡大祭祀及冊命朝會之禮，皇親諸親應陪位預會者，則為之簿書，以申司封。

translations.literal: For all great sacrifices and investiture and court assembly rites, when imperial kin and other kin should attend in supporting positions, registers are made and submitted to the Office of Enfeoffment.
translations.idiomatic: For major sacrifices and investiture and court assembly rites, registers are made of imperial kin and other kin who should attend in supporting positions and submitted to the Office of Enfeoffment.

sentences.zh: 若皇親為三公子孫應襲封者，亦如之。

translations.literal: If imperial kin are descendants of the Three Dukes who should inherit enfeoffment, likewise.
translations.idiomatic: The same applies when imperial kin are descendants of the Three Dukes eligible to inherit enfeoffment.

sentences.zh: 丞掌判寺事。

translations.literal: The Assistant Director supervises and decides directorate affairs.
translations.idiomatic: The Assistant Director supervises directorate business.

sentences.zh: 主簿掌印及勾檢稽失。

translations.literal: The Chief Clerk manages the seal and checks and audits errors.
translations.idiomatic: The Chief Clerk keeps the seal and audits for errors.

sentences.zh: 錄事掌受事發辰。

translations.literal: The Recording Clerk manages receiving documents and dispatching them on schedule.
translations.idiomatic: The Recording Clerk receives documents and dispatches them on schedule.

sentences.zh: 崇玄署：令一人，正八品下。

translations.literal: Bureau of High Mysteries: one Director, lower eighth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Bureau of High Mysteries — one Director, lower eighth rank.

sentences.zh: 丞一人，正九品下。

translations.literal: One Assistant Director, lower ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Assistant Director, lower ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 府二人，史三人，典事六人，掌固二人。

translations.literal: Two clerks, three scribes, six record keepers, two gatekeepers.
translations.idiomatic: Two clerks, three scribes, six record keepers, and two gatekeepers.

sentences.zh: 令掌京都諸觀之名數、道士之帳籍，與其齋醮之事。

translations.literal: The Director manages the names and numbers of all Daoist temples in the capital, the registers of Daoist priests, and their fasting and ritual observances.
translations.idiomatic: The Director oversees the names and numbers of Daoist temples in the capital, registers of Daoist priests, and their fasting and ritual observances.

sentences.zh: 丞為之貳。

translations.literal: The Assistant Director is his deputy.
translations.idiomatic: The Assistant Director serves as his deputy.

sentences.zh: 太僕寺太僕寺太僕，古官。

translations.literal: Directorate of the Imperial Stud. Grand Provisioner for Horses—an ancient office.
translations.idiomatic: Directorate of the Imperial Stud. Grand Provisioner for Horses was an ancient office.

sentences.zh: 梁置十二卿，署加「寺」字，後因之。

translations.literal: Liang established twelve Ministers and added the character "Directorate"; later ages followed this.
translations.idiomatic: The Liang established twelve Ministers and added "Directorate" to the title; later dynasties kept the name.

sentences.zh: 龍朔改為司馭寺，光宅為司僕寺，神龍復也。

translations.literal: Longshuo changed it to the Directorate of Charioteers; Guangzhai to the Directorate of Servants; Shendlong restored it.
translations.idiomatic: Under Longshuo it became the Directorate of Charioteers; under Guangzhai, the Directorate of Servants; under Shendlong the former name was restored.

sentences.zh: 卿一員。

translations.literal: One Minister.
translations.idiomatic: One Minister.

sentences.zh: 從三品。

translations.literal: Secondary third rank.
translations.idiomatic: Secondary third rank.

sentences.zh: 古有太僕正，即其名也。

translations.literal: Antiquity had a Grand Provisioner-in-Chief; that was its name.
translations.idiomatic: In antiquity the office was called Grand Provisioner-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 後無正字，唯名太僕。

translations.literal: Later the character "Chief" was dropped, and it was called only Grand Provisioner for Horses.
translations.idiomatic: Later the word "Chief" was dropped, leaving only Grand Provisioner for Horses.

sentences.zh: 梁置為列卿，隋品第三。

translations.literal: Liang established it among the ranked Ministers; under Sui, rank was third.
translations.idiomatic: The Liang made it one of the ranked Ministers; under the Sui the rank was third.

sentences.zh: 龍朔為司馭正卿，光宅曰司僕卿，神龍復也。

translations.literal: Longshuo made it Chief Minister of Charioteers; Guangzhai called it Minister of Servants; Shendlong restored it.
translations.idiomatic: Under Longshuo it became Chief Minister of Charioteers; under Guangzhai, Minister of Servants; under Shendlong the former name was restored.

sentences.zh: 少卿二人。

translations.literal: Two Vice Ministers.
translations.idiomatic: Two Vice Ministers.

sentences.zh: 從四品上。

translations.literal: Upper secondary fourth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Upper secondary fourth rank.

sentences.zh: 卿之職，掌邦國廄牧、車輿之政令，總乘黃、典車之屬。

translations.literal: The Minister's duty is to manage the state's stables, pastures, and carriage regulations, overseeing the subordinates of Yellow Carriages and Carriage Records.
translations.idiomatic: The Minister oversees the state's stables, pastures, and carriage regulations, supervising Yellow Carriages and Carriage Records.

sentences.zh: 凡監牧羊馬所通籍帳，每歲則受而會之，以上尚書駕部，以議其官吏之考課。

translations.literal: For all registered accounts of sheep and horses from the pasture supervisors, each year they are received and reconciled and submitted to the Carriage Section of the Ministry of Revenue to determine officials' performance review.
translations.idiomatic: Each year registered accounts of sheep and horses from pasture supervisors are received, reconciled, and submitted to the Carriage Section of the Ministry of Revenue for officials' performance review.

sentences.zh: 凡四仲之月，祭馬祖、馬步、先牧、馬社。

translations.literal: In all four mid-season months, sacrifices are made to the Horse Ancestor, Horse Pace, Former Pasture, and Horse Altar.
translations.idiomatic: In all four mid-season months, sacrifices are made to the Horse Ancestor, Horse Pace, Former Pasture, and Horse Altar.

sentences.zh: 丞四人，從六品上。

translations.literal: Four Assistant Directors, upper secondary sixth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Four Assistant Directors, upper secondary sixth rank.

sentences.zh: 主簿二人，從七品上。

translations.literal: Two Chief Clerks, upper secondary seventh rank.
translations.idiomatic: Two Chief Clerks, upper secondary seventh rank.

sentences.zh: 錄事二人，從九品上。

translations.literal: Two Recording Clerks, upper secondary ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Two Recording Clerks, upper secondary ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 府十七人。

translations.literal: Seventeen clerks.
translations.idiomatic: Seventeen clerks.

sentences.zh: 史三十四人，獸醫六百人，獸醫博士四人，學生一百人，亭長四人，掌固六人。

translations.literal: Thirty-four scribes, six hundred veterinarians, four erudites of veterinary medicine, one hundred students, four ward chiefs, six gatekeepers.
translations.idiomatic: Thirty-four scribes, six hundred veterinarians, four erudites of veterinary medicine, one hundred students, four ward chiefs, and six gatekeepers.

sentences.zh: 丞掌判寺事。

translations.literal: The Assistant Director supervises and decides directorate affairs.
translations.idiomatic: The Assistant Director supervises directorate business.

sentences.zh: 主簿掌印，勾檢稽失，省署抄目。

translations.literal: The Chief Clerk manages the seal, checks and audits errors, and reviews copied documents.
translations.idiomatic: The Chief Clerk keeps the seal, audits for errors, and reviews copied documents.

sentences.zh: 錄事掌受事發辰。

translations.literal: The Recording Clerk manages receiving documents and dispatching them on schedule.
translations.idiomatic: The Recording Clerk receives documents and dispatches them on schedule.

sentences.zh: 乘黃署：令一人，從七品下。

translations.literal: Yellow Carriages Bureau: one Director, lower secondary seventh rank.
translations.idiomatic: Yellow Carriages Bureau — one Director, lower secondary seventh rank.

sentences.zh: 丞一人，從八品下。

translations.literal: One Assistant Director, lower secondary eighth rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Assistant Director, lower secondary eighth rank.

sentences.zh: 府一人，史二人，典事八人，駕士一百四十人，羊車小吏十四人，掌固六人。

translations.literal: One clerk, two scribes, eight record keepers, one hundred forty grooms, fourteen sheep-carriage attendants, six gatekeepers.
translations.idiomatic: One clerk, two scribes, eight record keepers, one hundred forty grooms, fourteen sheep-carriage attendants, and six gatekeepers.

sentences.zh: 令掌天子車輅，辨其名數與馴馭之法。

translations.literal: The Director manages the Son of Heaven's carriages, distinguishing their names, numbers, and methods of training and driving.
translations.idiomatic: The Director oversees the Son of Heaven's carriages, distinguishing their names, numbers, and methods of training and driving.

sentences.zh: 丞為之貳。

translations.literal: The Assistant Director is his deputy.
translations.idiomatic: The Assistant Director serves as his deputy.

sentences.zh: 凡乘輿五輅，事具《輿服志》也。

translations.literal: The imperial carriage has five state carriages; the matter is fully given in the 《Treatise on Carriages and Vestments》.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial carriage includes five state carriages; full particulars are given in the 《Treatise on Carriages and Vestments》.

sentences.zh: 皆有副車，又有十二車，曰指南車、曰記裏鼓車、白鷺車、鑾旗車、辟惡車、皮軒車、耕根車、安車、四望車、羊車、黃鉞車、豹尾車，其車飾見《輿服志》也。

translations.literal: All have escort carriages; there are also twelve carriages, namely: the south-pointing carriage, the distance-recording drum carriage, the white egret carriage, the imperial banner carriage, the evil-averting carriage, the leather-canopy carriage, the plowing-root carriage, the secure carriage, the four-view carriage, the sheep carriage, the yellow axe carriage, and the leopard-tail carriage; their carriage ornaments are given in the 《Treatise on Carriages and Vestments》.
translations.idiomatic: Each has an escort carriage, and there are twelve additional carriages: the south-pointing carriage, distance-recording drum carriage, white egret carriage, imperial banner carriage, evil-averting carriage, leather-canopy carriage, plowing-root carriage, secure carriage, four-view carriage, sheep carriage, yellow axe carriage, and leopard-tail carriage; their ornaments are described in the 《Treatise on Carriages and Vestments》.

sentences.zh: 屬車一十有二。

translations.literal: Follower carriages number twelve.
translations.idiomatic: There are twelve follower carriages.

sentences.zh: 古者屬車八十一乘，皇朝置十二乘也。

translations.literal: In antiquity follower carriages numbered eighty-one; the dynasty established twelve.
translations.idiomatic: In antiquity there were eighty-one follower carriages; the dynasty established twelve.

sentences.zh: 乘輿有大駕、法駕、小駕，車服各有名數之差。

translations.literal: The imperial carriage has great, regulated, and lesser processions; carriages and vestments each have differences in prescribed names and numbers.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial procession has great, regulated, and lesser forms; carriages and vestments each have prescribed gradations.

sentences.zh: 若有大禮，則以所御之輅進內。

translations.literal: If there is a great rite, the carriage used is brought inside.
translations.idiomatic: When a major rite is held, the carriage used is brought inside the palace.

sentences.zh: 既事，則受而藏之。

translations.literal: When the rite is complete, it is received and stored.
translations.idiomatic: When the rite is complete, it is received and stored away.

sentences.zh: 凡將有事，先期四十日，尚乘供馬如輅色，率駕士預調習指南等十二車。

translations.literal: Whenever a rite is about to take place, forty days in advance the Yellow Carriages Bureau supplies horses matching the carriage colors and leads grooms to rehearse the twelve carriages including the south-pointing carriage.
translations.idiomatic: Forty days before a rite, the Yellow Carriages Bureau supplies horses matching the carriage colors and leads grooms to rehearse the twelve carriages including the south-pointing carriage.

sentences.zh: 典廄署：令二人，從七品下。

translations.literal: Imperial Stud Bureau: two Directors, lower secondary seventh rank.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial Stud Bureau — two Directors, lower secondary seventh rank.

sentences.zh: 丞四人，從八品下。

translations.idiomatic: All pasture supervisors oversee breeding and tax affairs for group pastures.

sentences.zh: 凡馬五千匹為上監，三千匹已上為中監，一千匹已上為下監，凡馬之群，有牧長尉。

translations.literal: Five thousand horses constitute an upper supervisor; three thousand or more a middle supervisor; one thousand or more a lower supervisor; for each horse herd there are pasture chiefs and wardens.
translations.idiomatic: Five thousand horses qualify for an upper supervisor, three thousand or more for a middle supervisor, and one thousand or more for a lower supervisor; each horse herd has pasture chiefs and wardens.

sentences.zh: 凡馬，有左、右監，以別其粗良，以數紀名，著之簿籍。

translations.literal: For all horses, there are left and right supervisors to distinguish coarse from fine, numbers record names, and they are entered in registers.
translations.idiomatic: Horses have left and right supervisors to distinguish coarse from fine stock; numbers record their names and they are entered in registers.

sentences.zh: 細馬稱左，粗馬稱右。

translations.literal: Fine horses are called left; coarse horses are called right.
translations.idiomatic: Fine horses are designated left; coarse horses are designated right.

sentences.zh: 凡諸群牧，立南北東西四使以分統之，其馬皆印。

translations.literal: For all group pastures, north, south, east, and west four commissioners are established to divide command; all horses are branded.
translations.idiomatic: North, south, east, and west commissioners are established to oversee group pastures, and all horses are branded.

sentences.zh: 每年終，監牧使巡按孳數，以功過相除，為之考課。

translations.literal: At year's end, pasture commissioners inspect breeding numbers, offset merit against fault, and conduct performance review.
translations.idiomatic: At year's end, pasture commissioners inspect breeding numbers, offset merit against fault, and conduct performance reviews.

translations.idiomatic: One recording clerk, three clerks, six scribes, four record keepers, and two gatekeepers.

sentences.zh: 每歲與典牧分月以供之。

translations.idiomatic: The Assistant Director serves as his deputy.

sentences.zh: 凡羊毛及雜畜毛皮角，皆具數申有司。

translations.idiomatic: All sheep wool and miscellaneous livestock hair, hides, and horns are counted and reported to the responsible offices.

sentences.zh: 大理寺大理寺古謂掌刑為士，又曰理。

translations.literal: Court of Judicial Review. The Court of Judicial Review: antiquity called managing punishment "minister," also called "adjudication."
translations.idiomatic: Court of Judicial Review. In antiquity managing punishment was called "minister," also called "adjudication."

sentences.zh: 漢景帝加「大」字，取天官貴人之牢曰大理之義。

translations.literal: Emperor Jing of Han added the character "Grand," taking the meaning that the prison of the Heavenly Office's noble is called Grand Adjudication.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Jing of Han added "Grand," taking the meaning that the prison of the Heavenly Office's noble was called Grand Adjudication.

sentences.zh: 後漢後，改為廷尉，魏復為大理。

translations.literal: The Southern dynasties again called it Court Commandant; Liang renamed it Minister of Autumn; Northern Qi and Sui made it Grand Adjudication and added the character "Court."

translations.idiomatic: The Assistant Directors divide and adjudicate court business.

translations.idiomatic: The Chief Clerk keeps the seal, reviews copied documents, and audits for errors.

translations.literal: The Recording Clerk manages receiving documents and dispatching them on schedule.
translations.idiomatic: The Recording Clerk receives documents and dispatches them on schedule.

sentences.zh: 鴻臚寺鴻臚寺周曰大行人，秦曰典客，漢景帝曰大行，武帝曰大鴻臚。

translations.idiomatic: Directorate of State Ceremonial. Under Zhou it was Grand Master of Guests; under Qin, Director of Guests; under Emperor Jing of Han, Grand Master of Guests; under Emperor Wu, Grand Master of State Ceremonial.

translations.idiomatic: The Liang established twelve Ministers; State Ceremonial was the Winter Minister; "Grand" was dropped and the office became a directorate.

sentences.zh: 後周曰賓部，隋曰鴻臚寺。

translations.idiomatic: Later Zhou called it the Guest Section; the Sui called it the Directorate of State Ceremonial.

translations.idiomatic: Under Longshuo it became the Directorate of Common Script; under Guangzhai, the Directorate of Guests; under Shendlong the former name was restored.

translations.idiomatic: One Minister, secondary third rank.

translations.literal: Two Vice Ministers.
translations.idiomatic: Two Vice Ministers.

sentences.zh: 從四品上。

translations.literal: Upper secondary fourth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Upper secondary fourth rank.

sentences.zh: 卿之職，掌賓客及凶儀之事，領典客、司儀二署，以率其官屬，供其職務。

translations.literal: The Minister's duty is to manage guests and inauspicious rites, overseeing the two bureaus of Guest Reception and Ceremonial Protocol to lead subordinates and supply their duties.
translations.idiomatic: The Minister oversees guests and inauspicious rites, supervising the Guest Reception and Ceremonial Protocol bureaus to lead staff and fulfill their duties.

translations.idiomatic: The Vice Minister serves as his deputy.

translations.idiomatic: When chieftains from the four directions and foreign peoples come to court, their ranks are distinguished and they are treated as guests.

translations.literal: Whenever sons of the Two Kings and foreign chieftains inherit office and rank, legitimacy and illegitimacy are distinguished and suitability examined in detail.

translations.literal: For all temple and monastery three leaders throughout the realm and great virtues in the capital, those of lofty virtue esteemed by the multitude are selected and submitted to the Sacrificial Affairs Section of the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: Temple and monastery leaders throughout the realm and great virtues in the capital are selected from those of lofty virtue esteemed by the community and submitted to the Sacrificial Affairs Section of the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 皇帝太子為五服之親及大臣發哀臨沛，則贊相焉。

translations.literal: When the emperor or crown prince attends mourning for kin within the five degrees or for great ministers, he assists and directs.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor or crown prince attends mourning for kin within the five degrees of mourning or for great ministers, he assists in directing the rites.

sentences.zh: 凡詔葬大臣，一品則卿護其喪事，二品則少卿，三品丞一人往。

translations.literal: For all imperially ordered burials of ministers, first rank—the Minister escorts the funeral; second rank—the Vice Minister; third rank—one Assistant Director goes.
translations.idiomatic: For imperially ordered burials of ministers, the Minister escorts first-rank funerals, the Vice Minister second-rank funerals, and one Assistant Director third-rank funerals.

sentences.zh: 皆命司儀，以示禮制。

translations.literal: All are ordered by Ceremonial Protocol to display the ritual system.
translations.idiomatic: Ceremonial Protocol is ordered to display the ritual system in each case.

translations.idiomatic: Two Assistant Directors, upper secondary sixth rank.

translations.literal: Each garrison farm supervisor manages its farm crops.
translations.idiomatic: Each garrison farm supervisor manages its crops.

sentences.zh: 丞為之貳。

translations.literal: The Assistant Director is his deputy.
translations.idiomatic: The Assistant Director serves as his deputy.

sentences.zh: 凡每年定課有差。

translations.literal: Each year fixed quotas have gradations.
translations.idiomatic: Fixed annual quotas vary by farm.

sentences.zh: 九成宮總監：監一人，從五品下。

translations.literal: Jiucheng Palace Chief Supervisor: one supervisor, lower secondary fifth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Jiucheng Palace Chief Supervisor — one supervisor, lower secondary fifth rank.

sentences.zh: 副監一人，從六品下，丞一人，從七品下。

translations.literal: One Vice Supervisor, lower secondary sixth rank; one Assistant Director, lower secondary seventh rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Vice Supervisor of lower secondary sixth rank; one Assistant Director of lower secondary seventh rank.

sentences.zh: 主簿一人，從九品下。

translations.literal: One Chief Clerk, lower secondary ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Chief Clerk, lower secondary ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 錄事一人，府三人，史五人。

translations.literal: One recording clerk, three clerks, five scribes.
translations.idiomatic: One recording clerk, three clerks, and five scribes.

sentences.zh: 宮監掌檢校宮樹，供進煉餌之事。

translations.literal: The Palace Supervisor manages inspecting palace trees and supplying refined medicines.
translations.idiomatic: The Palace Supervisor inspects palace trees and supplies refined medicines.

sentences.zh: 副監為之貳。

translations.literal: The Vice Supervisor is his deputy.
translations.idiomatic: The Vice Supervisor serves as his deputy.

sentences.zh: 太府寺太府寺《周官》有太府下士，掌財賦。

translations.literal: Directorate of the Imperial Treasury. The Directorate of the Imperial Treasury: the 《Offices of Zhou》 has Grand Treasury Lower Servants managing wealth and taxes.
translations.idiomatic: Directorate of the Imperial Treasury. The 《Offices of Zhou》 records Grand Treasury Lower Servants who managed wealth and taxes.

sentences.zh: 秦、漢已後，財賦屬司農少府。

translations.literal: After Qin and Han, wealth and taxes belonged to the Director of Agriculture and Privy Treasury.
translations.idiomatic: After Qin and Han, wealth and taxes belonged to the Director of Agriculture and the Privy Treasury.

sentences.zh: 梁始置太府卿，掌帑藏。

translations.literal: Liang first established the Minister of the Imperial Treasury, managing the vault and stores.
translations.idiomatic: The Liang first established the Minister of the Imperial Treasury to manage the vault and stores.

sentences.zh: 龍朔改為外府，光宅改為司府，神龍復為太府寺也。

translations.literal: Longshuo changed it to Outer Treasury; Guangzhai to Director of Treasury; Shendlong restored it to the Directorate of the Imperial Treasury.
translations.idiomatic: Under Longshuo it became the Outer Treasury; under Guangzhai, the Directorate of Treasury; under Shendlong it was restored to the Directorate of the Imperial Treasury.

sentences.zh: 卿一員，從三品。

translations.literal: One Minister, secondary third rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Minister, secondary third rank.

sentences.zh: 即後周太府中大夫。

translations.literal: That is, the Middle Grandee of the Imperial Treasury of Later Zhou.
translations.idiomatic: This corresponds to the Middle Grandee of the Imperial Treasury under Later Zhou.

sentences.zh: 少卿二員。

translations.literal: Two Vice Ministers.
translations.idiomatic: Two Vice Ministers.

sentences.zh: 從四品上。

translations.literal: Upper secondary fourth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Upper secondary fourth rank.

sentences.zh: 卿掌邦國財貨，總京師四市、平准、左右藏、常平八署之官屬，舉其綱目，修其職務。

translations.literal: The Minister manages the state's wealth and goods, overseeing the subordinates of the eight bureaus of the capital's four markets, Equalization, Left and Right Treasuries, and Ever-Normal Granaries, setting forth their categories and fulfilling their duties.
translations.idiomatic: The Minister oversees the state's wealth and goods, supervising the capital's four markets, Equalization, Left and Right Treasuries, and Ever-Normal Granaries, setting forth their categories and fulfilling their duties.

sentences.zh: 少卿為之貳。

translations.literal: The Vice Minister is his deputy.
translations.idiomatic: The Vice Minister serves as his deputy.

sentences.zh: 以二法平物。

translations.literal: By two methods goods are equalized.
translations.idiomatic: Goods are equalized by two methods.

sentences.zh: 一曰度量，二曰權衡。

translations.literal: First, measures; second, weights and balances.
translations.idiomatic: They are measures and weights and balances.

sentences.zh: 凡四方之貢賦，百官之俸秩，謹其出納，而為之節制焉。

translations.literal: For all tribute and taxes from the four directions and salaries of all officials, disbursements and receipts are carefully controlled and regulated.
translations.idiomatic: Tribute and taxes from the four directions and salaries of all officials are carefully controlled and regulated.

sentences.zh: 凡祭祀，則供其幣。

translations.literal: At all sacrifices, ritual silks are supplied.
translations.idiomatic: At sacrifices, ritual silks are supplied.

sentences.zh: 丞四人，從六品上。

translations.literal: Four Assistant Directors, upper secondary sixth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Four Assistant Directors, upper secondary sixth rank.

sentences.zh: 主簿二人，從七品上。

translations.literal: Two Chief Clerks, upper secondary seventh rank.
translations.idiomatic: Two Chief Clerks, upper secondary seventh rank.

sentences.zh: 錄事二人，從九品上。

translations.literal: Two Recording Clerks, upper secondary ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Two Recording Clerks, upper secondary ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 府十五人，史五十人，計史四人，亭長七人，掌固七人。

translations.literal: Fifteen clerks, fifty scribes, four accounting scribes, seven ward chiefs, seven gatekeepers.
translations.idiomatic: Fifteen clerks, fifty scribes, four accounting scribes, seven ward chiefs, and seven gatekeepers.

sentences.zh: 丞掌判寺事。

translations.literal: The Assistant Director supervises and decides directorate affairs.
translations.idiomatic: The Assistant Director supervises directorate business.

sentences.zh: 凡正、至大朝所貢方物，應陳於殿廷者，受而進之。

translations.literal: For all regional products offered at the winter and summer solstice great court assemblies that should be displayed in the hall court, they are received and presented.
translations.idiomatic: Regional products offered at the winter and summer solstice great court assemblies that should be displayed in the hall court are received and presented.

sentences.zh: 兩京都市署：京師有東西兩市，東都有南北兩市。

translations.literal: Capital Market Bureaus of the two capitals: the capital has east and west markets; the eastern capital has south and north markets.
translations.idiomatic: Capital Market Bureaus of the two capitals — the capital has east and west markets; the eastern capital has south and north markets.

sentences.zh: 令一人，從六品上。

translations.literal: One Director, upper secondary sixth rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Director, upper secondary sixth rank.

sentences.zh: 丞各二人，正八品上。

translations.literal: Two Assistant Directors each, upper eighth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Two Assistant Directors each, upper eighth rank.

sentences.zh: 錄事一人，府三人，史七人，典事三人，掌固一人。

translations.literal: One recording clerk, three clerks, seven scribes, three record keepers, one gatekeeper.
translations.idiomatic: One recording clerk, three clerks, seven scribes, three record keepers, and one gatekeeper.

sentences.zh: 京、都市令掌百族交易之事。

translations.literal: The Capital Market Director manages the transactions of all trades.
translations.idiomatic: The Capital Market Director oversees transactions of all trades.

sentences.zh: 丞為之貳。

translations.literal: The Assistant Director is his deputy.
translations.idiomatic: The Assistant Director serves as his deputy.

sentences.zh: 凡建標立候，陳肆辨物，以二物平市，謂秤以格，鬥以概。

translations.literal: Signs are erected and markers set, stalls arranged and goods distinguished; by two instruments the market is equalized—scales by the steelyard, measures by the bushel.
translations.idiomatic: Signs are erected and stalls arranged; the market is equalized by two instruments — scales by the steelyard and measures by the bushel.

sentences.zh: 以三賈均市。

translations.literal: By three prices the market is balanced.
translations.idiomatic: The market is balanced by three price levels.

sentences.zh: 賈有上、中、下之差。

translations.literal: Prices have upper, middle, and lower gradations.
translations.idiomatic: Prices have upper, middle, and lower gradations.

sentences.zh: 平准署：令二人，從七品下。

translations.literal: Equalization Bureau: two Directors, lower secondary seventh rank.
translations.idiomatic: Equalization Bureau — two Directors, lower secondary seventh rank.

sentences.zh: 丞四人，從八品下。

translations.literal: Four Assistant Directors, lower secondary eighth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Four Assistant Directors, lower secondary eighth rank.

sentences.zh: 錄事一人，府六人，史十三人，監事二人，從九品下。

translations.literal: One recording clerk, six clerks, thirteen scribes, two supervisors, lower secondary ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: One recording clerk, six clerks, thirteen scribes, and two supervisors of lower secondary ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 典事二人，價人十人，掌固十人。

translations.literal: Two record keepers, ten price officers, ten gatekeepers.
translations.idiomatic: Two record keepers, ten price officers, and ten gatekeepers.

sentences.zh: 平准令掌供官市易之事。

translations.literal: The Director of Equalization manages supplying official market exchange.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of Equalization oversees official market exchange.

sentences.zh: 丞為之貳。

translations.literal: The Assistant Director is his deputy.
translations.idiomatic: The Assistant Director serves as his deputy.

sentences.zh: 凡百司不任用之物，則以時出貨。

translations.literal: Whenever all offices have unused goods, they are sold off in season.
translations.idiomatic: Unused goods from all offices are sold off in season.

sentences.zh: 其沒官物，亦如之。

translations.literal: Confiscated official goods are likewise.
translations.idiomatic: Confiscated official goods are handled likewise.

sentences.zh: 左藏署：左右藏令，晉始有之，後代因之。

translations.literal: Left Treasury Bureau: Left and Right Treasury Directors were first established under Jin; later ages followed this.
translations.idiomatic: Left Treasury Bureau — Left and Right Treasury Directors were first established under the Jin; later dynasties kept the arrangement.

sentences.zh: 皇家左藏，有東庫、西庫、朝堂庫。

translations.literal: The imperial Left Treasury has East Storehouse, West Storehouse, and Hall Court Storehouse.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial Left Treasury includes the East Storehouse, West Storehouse, and Hall Court Storehouse.

sentences.zh: 又有東都庫。

translations.literal: There is also the Eastern Capital Storehouse.
translations.idiomatic: There is also the Eastern Capital Storehouse.

sentences.zh: 各木契一，與太府主簿合也。

translations.literal: Each has one wooden tally, matched with the Chief Clerk of the Imperial Treasury.
translations.idiomatic: Each has one wooden tally matched against the Chief Clerk of the Imperial Treasury.

sentences.zh: 令三人，從七品下。

translations.literal: Three Directors, lower secondary seventh rank.
translations.idiomatic: Three Directors, lower secondary seventh rank.

sentences.zh: 丞五人，從八品下。

translations.literal: Five Assistant Directors, lower secondary eighth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Five Assistant Directors, lower secondary eighth rank.

sentences.zh: 府九人，史十八人，監事九人，從九品下。

translations.literal: Nine clerks, eighteen scribes, nine supervisors, lower secondary ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Nine clerks, eighteen scribes, and nine supervisors of lower secondary ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 典事一人，掌固八人。

translations.literal: One record keeper, eight gatekeepers.
translations.idiomatic: One record keeper and eight gatekeepers.

sentences.zh: 左藏令掌邦國庫藏。

translations.literal: The Director of the Left Treasury manages the state's storehouses.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of the Left Treasury oversees the state's storehouses.

sentences.zh: 丞為之貳。

translations.literal: The Assistant Director is his deputy.
translations.idiomatic: The Assistant Director serves as his deputy.

sentences.zh: 凡天下賦調，先于輸場簡其合尺度斤兩者，卿及御史監閱，然後納於庫藏，皆題以州縣年月，所以別粗良，辨新舊。

translations.literal: All land tax and corvée from throughout the realm are first at the delivery yard screened for conformity to measures, scales, and weights; the Minister and censors supervise inspection, then they are received into storehouses, all labeled with prefecture, county, year, and month to distinguish coarse from fine and new from old.
translations.idiomatic: All land tax and corvée from throughout the realm are screened at the delivery yard for conformity to measures, scales, and weights; the Minister and censors supervise inspection before goods enter storehouses, each labeled with prefecture, county, year, and month to distinguish coarse from fine and new from old.

sentences.zh: 凡出給，先勘木契，然後錄其名數，請人姓名，署印送監門，乃聽出。

translations.literal: For all disbursement, wooden tallies are first checked, then names and numbers are recorded, the requester's name signed and sealed and sent to the Gate Supervisor, and only then release is permitted.
translations.idiomatic: For disbursement, wooden tallies are checked first, then names and numbers are recorded, the requester's name is signed and sealed and sent to the Gate Supervisor, and only then release is permitted.

sentences.zh: 若外給者，以墨印印之。

translations.literal: If for external disbursement, it is stamped with an ink seal.
translations.idiomatic: External disbursements are stamped with an ink seal.

sentences.zh: 凡藏院之內，禁人燃火，及無故入院者。

translations.literal: Within all storehouse courtyards, people are forbidden to kindle fire or enter without cause.
translations.idiomatic: Within storehouse courtyards, kindling fire and entering without cause are forbidden.

sentences.zh: 晝則外四面常持仗為之防守，夜則擊柝，而分更以巡警之。

translations.literal: By day armed guards on all four outer sides defend it; by night clappers are struck and shifts patrol.
translations.idiomatic: By day armed guards on all four sides defend it; by night clappers are struck and patrol shifts rotate.

sentences.zh: 右藏署：令二人，正八品上。

translations.literal: Right Treasury Bureau: two Directors, upper eighth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Right Treasury Bureau — two Directors, upper eighth rank.

sentences.zh: 丞三人，正九品上。

translations.literal: Three Assistant Directors, upper ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Three Assistant Directors, upper ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 府五人，史十人，監事四人，從九品下。

translations.literal: Five clerks, ten scribes, four supervisors, lower secondary ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Five clerks, ten scribes, and four supervisors of lower secondary ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 典事七人，掌固十人。

translations.literal: Seven record keepers, ten gatekeepers.
translations.idiomatic: Seven record keepers and ten gatekeepers.

sentences.zh: 右藏令掌國寶貨。

translations.literal: The Director of the Right Treasury manages the state's treasures and goods.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of the Right Treasury oversees the state's treasures and goods.

sentences.zh: 丞為之貳。

translations.literal: The Assistant Director is his deputy.
translations.idiomatic: The Assistant Director serves as his deputy.

sentences.zh: 凡四方所獻金玉、珠貝、玩好之物，皆藏之。

translations.literal: All gold, jade, pearls, shells, and curios offered from the four directions are stored.
translations.idiomatic: Gold, jade, pearls, shells, and curios offered from the four directions are all stored.

sentences.zh: 出納禁令，如左藏。

translations.literal: Disbursement and receipt prohibitions are as for the Left Treasury.
translations.idiomatic: Disbursement and receipt rules follow those of the Left Treasury.

sentences.zh: 常平署：漢宣帝時，始置常平倉，以平歲之凶穰。

translations.literal: Ever-Normal Granary Bureau: under Emperor Xuan of Han, the Ever-Normal Granary was first established to balance years of famine and plenty.
translations.idiomatic: Ever-Normal Granary Bureau — under Emperor Xuan of Han the Ever-Normal Granary was first established to balance years of famine and plenty.

sentences.zh: 後漢改為常滿倉，晉曰常平，後魏曰邸閣倉。

translations.literal: Later Han changed it to Ever-Full Granary; Jin called it Ever-Normal; Later Wei called it Lodge Storehouse.
translations.idiomatic: Later Han renamed it the Ever-Full Granary; the Jin called it Ever-Normal; Later Wei called it the Lodge Storehouse.

sentences.zh: 隋于衛州置黎陽倉，洛州置河陽倉，陝州置常平倉，華州置廣運倉，轉相委輸，漕關東之粟，以給京師。

translations.literal: Sui established Liyang Granary in Weizhou, Heyang Granary in Luozhou, Ever-Normal Granary in Shazhou, and Guangyun Granary in Huazhou, transferring and relaying grain, transporting grain from east of the pass to supply the capital.
translations.idiomatic: The Sui established Liyang Granary in Weizhou, Heyang Granary in Luozhou, Ever-Normal Granary in Shazhou, and Guangyun Granary in Huazhou, relaying grain and transporting grain from east of the pass to supply the capital.

sentences.zh: 國家垂拱初，兩京置常平署，天下州府亦置之。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Chuigong of the dynasty, Ever-Normal bureaus were established in the two capitals, and prefectures throughout the realm also established them.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Chuigong era, Ever-Normal bureaus were established in the two capitals and in prefectures throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 令一人，從七品下。

translations.literal: One Director, lower secondary seventh rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Director, lower secondary seventh rank.

sentences.zh: 丞二人，從八品下。

translations.literal: Two Assistant Directors, lower secondary eighth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Two Assistant Directors, lower secondary eighth rank.

sentences.zh: 府四人，史八人，監事五人，從九品下。

translations.literal: Four clerks, eight scribes, five supervisors, lower secondary ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Four clerks, eight scribes, and five supervisors of lower secondary ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 典事五人，掌固六人。

translations.literal: Five record keepers, six gatekeepers.
translations.idiomatic: Five record keepers and six gatekeepers.

sentences.zh: 常平令掌倉儲之事。

translations.literal: The Director of Ever-Normal manages granary storage affairs.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of Ever-Normal oversees granary storage.

sentences.zh: 丞為之貳也。

translations.literal: The Assistant Director is his deputy.
translations.idiomatic: The Assistant Director serves as his deputy.

sentences.zh: 國子監國子監國子之義，見《周官》。

translations.literal: Directorate of Education. The meaning of "imperial sons" is given in the 《Offices of Zhou》.
translations.idiomatic: Directorate of Education. The meaning of "imperial sons" is set forth in the 《Offices of Zhou》.

sentences.zh: 晉武始立國子學。

translations.literal: Emperor Wu of Jin first established the Imperial Sons Academy.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wu of the Jin first established the Imperial Sons Academy.

sentences.zh: 北齊曰國子寺，隋初曰學，後改為寺，大業三年改為監。

translations.literal: Northern Qi called it the Imperial Sons Directorate; early Sui called it an academy, later changed to directorate; Daye year 3 changed it to a supervisorate.
translations.idiomatic: Northern Qi called it the Imperial Sons Directorate; early Sui called it an academy, later a directorate; in Daye year 3 it became a supervisorate.

sentences.zh: 龍朔曰大司成，光宅曰成均，神龍復為國子監也。

translations.literal: Longshuo called it Grand Director of Completion; Guangzhai called it Completion Balance; Shendlong restored it to the Directorate of Education.
translations.idiomatic: Under Longshuo it became Grand Director of Completion; under Guangzhai, Completion Balance; under Shendlong it was restored to the Directorate of Education.

sentences.zh: 祭酒一員，從三品。

translations.literal: One Libationer, secondary third rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Libationer, secondary third rank.

sentences.zh: 《周官》曰師氏、保氏。

translations.literal: The 《Offices of Zhou》 says Master and Guardian.
translations.idiomatic: The 《Offices of Zhou》 names the offices Master and Guardian.

sentences.zh: 漢始置祭酒博士，歷代因之。

translations.literal: Han first established the Libationer Erudite; later ages followed this.
translations.idiomatic: Han first established the Libationer Erudite; later dynasties kept the title.

sentences.zh: 隋祭酒，品第三。

translations.literal: Under Sui the Libationer was rank third.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Sui the Libationer held third rank.

sentences.zh: 龍朔、光宅，隨曹改易。

translations.literal: Longshuo and Guangzhai changed with the bureau.
translations.idiomatic: Under Longshuo and Guangzhai the title changed with the bureau.

sentences.zh: 司業二員。

translations.literal: Two Vice Directors.
translations.idiomatic: Two Vice Directors.

sentences.zh: 從四品下。

translations.literal: Lower secondary fourth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Lower secondary fourth rank.

sentences.zh: 隋大業三年，始置司業一人，從四品。

translations.literal: Sui Daye year 3 first established one Vice Director, secondary fourth rank.
translations.idiomatic: In Sui Daye year 3 one Vice Director of secondary fourth rank was first established.

sentences.zh: 官名隨曹改易。

translations.literal: The office title changed with the bureau.
translations.idiomatic: The office title changed with the bureau.

sentences.zh: 祭酒、司業之職，掌邦國儒學訓導之政令，有六學。

translations.literal: The duties of the Libationer and Vice Director are to manage the state's Confucian learning and instruction orders; there are six academies.
translations.idiomatic: The Libationer and Vice Director oversee the state's Confucian learning and instruction; there are six academies.

sentences.zh: 一國子學、二太學、三四門、四律學、五書學、六算學也。

translations.literal: First, Imperial Sons Academy; second, Grand Academy; third, Four Gates; fourth, Law Academy; fifth, Calligraphy Academy; sixth, Mathematics Academy.
translations.idiomatic: They are the Imperial Sons Academy, Grand Academy, Four Gates, Law Academy, Calligraphy Academy, and Mathematics Academy.

sentences.zh: 凡春秋二分之月，上丁釋奠于孔宣父，祭乙太牢，樂用登歌軒懸。

translations.literal: In the two equinox months of spring and autumn, on the upper ding day a libation offering is made to Confucius; the great offering is used, music employs ascending song and elevated suspension.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring and autumn equinox months, on the upper ding day a libation offering is made to Confucius with the great offering; music uses ascending song and elevated suspension.

sentences.zh: 祭酒為初獻，司業為亞獻。

translations.literal: The Libationer serves as first offerer; the Vice Director as secondary offerer.
translations.idiomatic: The Libationer serves as first offerer and the Vice Director as secondary offerer.

sentences.zh: 凡教授之經，以《周易》、《尚書》、《周禮》、《儀禮》、《禮記》、《毛詩》、《春秋左氏傳》、《公羊傳》、《穀梁傳》各為一經，《孝經》、《論語》兼習之。

translations.literal: For all classics taught, the 《Book of Changes》, 《Book of Documents》, 《Rites of Zhou》, 《Rites of Etiquette》, 《Record of Rites》, 《Mao Version of the Odes》, 《Spring and Autumn Annals with Zuo Commentary》, 《Gongyang Commentary》, and 《Guliang Commentary》 each count as one classic; the 《Classic of Filial Piety》 and 《Analects》 are studied concurrently.
translations.idiomatic: The classics taught are the 《Book of Changes》, 《Book of Documents》, 《Rites of Zhou》, 《Rites of Etiquette》, 《Record of Rites》, 《Mao Version of the Odes》, 《Spring and Autumn Annals with Zuo Commentary》, 《Gongyang Commentary》, and 《Guliang Commentary》, each as one classic, with the 《Classic of Filial Piety》 and 《Analects》 studied concurrently.

sentences.zh: 每歲終，考其學官訓導功業之多少，為之殿最。

translations.literal: At each year's end, the teaching officials' instructional achievements are examined and ranked best and worst.
translations.idiomatic: At year's end the teaching officials' instructional achievements are examined and ranked.

sentences.zh: 丞一人，從六品下。

translations.literal: One Assistant Director, lower secondary sixth rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Assistant Director, lower secondary sixth rank.

sentences.zh: 主簿一人，從七品下。

translations.literal: One Chief Clerk, lower secondary seventh rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Chief Clerk, lower secondary seventh rank.

sentences.zh: 錄事一人，從九品下。

translations.literal: One Recording Clerk, lower secondary ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Recording Clerk, lower secondary ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 府七人，史十三人，亭長六人，掌固八人。

translations.literal: Seven clerks, thirteen scribes, six ward chiefs, eight gatekeepers.
translations.idiomatic: Seven clerks, thirteen scribes, six ward chiefs, and eight gatekeepers.

sentences.zh: 丞掌判監事。

translations.literal: The Assistant Director supervises and decides supervisorate affairs.
translations.idiomatic: The Assistant Director supervises supervisorate business.

sentences.zh: 凡六學生每歲有業成上於監者，以其業與祭酒、司業試所習業，上尚書禮部。

translations.literal: Whenever students of the six academies each year complete their studies and report to the supervisorate, their work is tested with the Libationer and Vice Director on what they have studied and submitted to the Ministry of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: When students of the six academies complete their studies each year, their work is tested by the Libationer and Vice Director and submitted to the Ministry of Rites.

sentences.zh: 國子博士二人，正五品上。

translations.literal: Two Erudites of the Imperial Sons Academy, upper fifth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Two Erudites of the Imperial Sons Academy, upper fifth rank.

sentences.zh: 助教二人，從六品上。

translations.literal: Two Assistant Instructors, upper secondary sixth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Two Assistant Instructors, upper secondary sixth rank.

sentences.zh: 學生三百人，典學四人，廟幹二人，掌固四人。

translations.literal: Three hundred students, four academy clerks, two temple stewards, four gatekeepers.
translations.idiomatic: Three hundred students, four academy clerks, two temple stewards, and four gatekeepers.

sentences.zh: 博士掌教文武官三品已上、國公子孫，二品已上曾孫為生者。

translations.literal: The Erudites manage teaching sons and grandsons of civil and military officials of third rank and above, and great-grandsons of second rank and above who are students.
translations.idiomatic: The Erudites teach sons and grandsons of civil and military officials of third rank and above, and great-grandsons of second rank and above enrolled as students.

sentences.zh: 生初入，置束帛一篚，酒一壺，修一案。

translations.literal: When a student first enters, one basket of silk, one jar of wine, and one bundle of dried meat are presented.
translations.idiomatic: When a student first enters, one basket of silk, one jar of wine, and one bundle of dried meat are presented.

sentences.zh: 每歲生有能通兩經已上求出仕者，則上於監。

translations.literal: Each year students who can master two classics or more and seek office are reported to the supervisorate.
translations.idiomatic: Each year students who master two or more classics and seek office are reported to the supervisorate.

sentences.zh: 堪秀才進士者，亦如之。

translations.literal: Those qualified for Xiucai or Jinshi degrees are likewise.
translations.idiomatic: Those qualified for Xiucai or Jinshi degrees are handled likewise.

sentences.zh: 典學掌抄錄課業。

translations.literal: The academy clerks manage copying and recording coursework.
translations.idiomatic: The academy clerks copy and record coursework.

sentences.zh: 廟幹掌灑掃學廟。

translations.literal: The temple stewards manage sweeping the academy temple.
translations.idiomatic: The temple stewards sweep and maintain the academy temple.

sentences.zh: 太學博士三人，正六品上。

translations.literal: Three Erudites of the Grand Academy, upper sixth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Three Erudites of the Grand Academy, upper sixth rank.

sentences.zh: 助教三人，從七品上。

translations.literal: Three Assistant Instructors, upper secondary seventh rank.
translations.idiomatic: Three Assistant Instructors, upper secondary seventh rank.

sentences.zh: 學生五百人。

translations.literal: Five hundred students.
translations.idiomatic: Five hundred students.

sentences.zh: 太學博士掌教文武五品已上及郡縣公子孫，從三品曾孫之為生者。

translations.literal: The Erudites of the Grand Academy manage teaching civil and military officials of fifth rank and above and sons and grandsons of prefecture and county officials, and great-great-grandsons of secondary third rank who are students.
translations.idiomatic: The Erudites of the Grand Academy teach civil and military officials of fifth rank and above, sons and grandsons of prefecture and county officials, and great-great-grandsons of secondary third rank enrolled as students.

sentences.zh: 教法並如國子。

translations.literal: Teaching methods are all as for the Imperial Sons Academy.
translations.idiomatic: Teaching methods follow those of the Imperial Sons Academy.

sentences.zh: 四門博士三人，正七品上。

translations.literal: Three Erudites of the Four Gates, upper seventh rank.
translations.idiomatic: Three Erudites of the Four Gates, upper seventh rank.

sentences.zh: 助教三人，從八品上。

translations.literal: Three Assistant Instructors, upper secondary eighth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Three Assistant Instructors, upper secondary eighth rank.

sentences.zh: 四門博士掌教文武七品已上及侯伯子男子之為生者，若庶人子為俊士生者，教法如太學。

translations.literal: The Erudites of the Four Gates manage teaching civil and military officials of seventh rank and above and marquises, earls, viscounts, and barons who are students; if commoners' sons are outstanding scholar students, teaching methods are as for the Grand Academy.
translations.idiomatic: The Erudites of the Four Gates teach civil and military officials of seventh rank and above and marquises, earls, viscounts, and barons enrolled as students; commoners' sons enrolled as outstanding scholars follow Grand Academy methods.

sentences.zh: 學生五百人。

translations.literal: Five hundred students.
translations.idiomatic: Five hundred students.

sentences.zh: 直講四人，掌佐博士助教之職。

translations.literal: Four Direct Lecturers manage assisting the Erudites and Assistant Instructors.
translations.idiomatic: Four Direct Lecturers assist the Erudites and Assistant Instructors.

sentences.zh: 大成二十人。

translations.literal: Twenty Great Completers.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty Great Completers.

sentences.zh: 通四經業成，上于尚書吏部，試登第者，加階放選也。

translations.literal: Those who complete mastery of four classics report to the Personnel Section of the Ministry of Revenue; those who pass the examination receive added rank and appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Those who complete mastery of four classics report to the Personnel Section of the Ministry of Revenue; those who pass the examination receive added rank and appointment.

sentences.zh: 律學博士一人，從八品下。

translations.literal: One Erudite of the Law Academy, lower secondary eighth rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Erudite of the Law Academy, lower secondary eighth rank.

sentences.zh: 太宗置。

translations.literal: Established by Emperor Taizong.
translations.idiomatic: Established by Emperor Taizong.

sentences.zh: 助教一人，從九品上。

translations.literal: One Assistant Instructor, upper secondary ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Assistant Instructor, upper secondary ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 學生五十人。

translations.literal: Fifty students.
translations.idiomatic: Fifty students.

sentences.zh: 博士掌教文武官八品已下及庶人子為生者。

translations.literal: The Erudite manages teaching civil and military officials of eighth rank and below and commoners' sons who are students.
translations.idiomatic: The Erudite teaches civil and military officials of eighth rank and below and commoners' sons enrolled as students.

sentences.zh: 以律令為專業，格式法例亦兼習之。

translations.literal: Statutes and orders are the specialty; formats, laws, and precedents are also studied concurrently.
translations.idiomatic: Statutes and orders are the specialty, with formats, laws, and precedents studied concurrently.

sentences.zh: 書學博士二人，從九品下。

translations.literal: Two Erudites of the Calligraphy Academy, lower secondary ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Two Erudites of the Calligraphy Academy, lower secondary ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 學生三十人。

translations.literal: Thirty students.
translations.idiomatic: Thirty students.

sentences.zh: 博士掌教文武八品已下及庶人之子為生者。

translations.literal: The Erudites manage teaching civil and military officials of eighth rank and below and commoners' sons who are students.
translations.idiomatic: The Erudites teach civil and military officials of eighth rank and below and commoners' sons enrolled as students.

sentences.zh: 以《石經》、《說文》、《字林》為專業，余字書兼習之。

translations.literal: The 《Stone Classics》, 《Shuowen》, and 《Zilin》 are the specialty; other character books are also studied concurrently.
translations.idiomatic: The 《Stone Classics》, 《Shuowen》, and 《Zilin》 are the specialty, with other character books studied concurrently.

sentences.zh: 算學博士二人，從九品下。

translations.literal: Two Erudites of the Mathematics Academy, lower secondary ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Two Erudites of the Mathematics Academy, lower secondary ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 學生三十人。

translations.literal: Thirty students.
translations.idiomatic: Thirty students.

sentences.zh: 博士掌教文武官八品已下及庶人之子為生者。

translations.literal: The Erudites manage teaching civil and military officials of eighth rank and below and commoners' sons who are students.
translations.idiomatic: The Erudites teach civil and military officials of eighth rank and below and commoners' sons enrolled as students.

sentences.zh: 二分其經，以為之業。

translations.literal: The classics are divided in two to form their specialty.
translations.idiomatic: The classics are divided into two specialties.

sentences.zh: 習《九章》、《海島》、《孫子》、《五曹》、《張邱建》、《夏侯陽》、《周髀》十五人，習《綴術》、《緝古》十五人。

translations.literal: Fifteen study the 《Nine Chapters》, 《Sea Island》, 《Master Sun》, 《Five Offices》, 《Zhang Qiujian》, 《Xiahou Yang》, and 《Zhou Bi》; fifteen study the 《Continued Methods》 and 《Collected Antiquity》.
translations.idiomatic: Fifteen students study the 《Nine Chapters》, 《Sea Island》, 《Master Sun》, 《Five Offices》, 《Zhang Qiujian》, 《Xiahou Yang》, and 《Zhou Bi》; fifteen study the 《Continued Methods》 and 《Collected Antiquity》.

sentences.zh: 其《紀遺》、《三等數》亦兼習之。

translations.literal: The 《Records of Remaining Methods》 and 《Three Grades of Numbers》 are also studied concurrently.
translations.idiomatic: The 《Records of Remaining Methods》 and 《Three Grades of Numbers》 are also studied concurrently.

sentences.zh: 《五經》博士各一人。

translations.literal: One Erudite of each of the Five Classics.
translations.idiomatic: One Erudite for each of the Five Classics.

sentences.zh: 五品下。

translations.literal: Lower fifth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Lower fifth rank.

sentences.zh: 舊無《五經》學科，自貞元五年一月敕特置《三禮》《開元禮》科，長慶二年二月，始置《三傳》《三史》科，後又置《五經》博士。

translations.literal: Formerly there was no Five Classics examination subject; from a Zhenyuan year 5, first-month edict the Three Rites and Kaiyuan Rites subjects were specially established; in Changqing year 2, second month, the Three Commentaries and Three Histories subjects were first established; later Erudites of the Five Classics were also established.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly there was no Five Classics examination subject; a Zhenyuan year 5 edict established the Three Rites and Kaiyuan Rites subjects; in Changqing year 2 the Three Commentaries and Three Histories subjects were established; later Erudites of the Five Classics were added.

sentences.zh: 檢年月，未獲也。

translations.literal: Checking year and month, not yet obtained.
translations.idiomatic: The exact date has not yet been verified.

sentences.zh: 廣文館博士二人。

translations.literal: Two Erudites of the Broad Learning Hall.
translations.idiomatic: Two Erudites of the Broad Learning Hall.

sentences.zh: 正六品上。

translations.literal: Upper sixth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Upper sixth rank.

sentences.zh: 天寶九載置，試附監修進士業者。

translations.literal: Established in Tianbao year 9 to test those attached to the supervisorate preparing for the Jinshi examination.
translations.idiomatic: Established in Tianbao year 9 to test students attached to the supervisorate preparing for the Jinshi examination.

sentences.zh: 置助教一人，至德後廢也。

translations.literal: One Assistant Instructor was established; after Zhide it was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: One Assistant Instructor was established; the post was abolished after the Zhide era.

sentences.zh: 少府監少府監秦置少府，掌山澤之稅。

translations.literal: Directorate of the Privy Treasury. Under Qin the Privy Treasury was established, managing taxes on mountains and marshes.
translations.idiomatic: Directorate of the Privy Treasury. Qin established the Privy Treasury to manage taxes on mountains and marshes.

sentences.zh: 漢掌內府珍貨。

translations.literal: Under Han it managed precious goods of the inner treasury.
translations.idiomatic: Under Han it managed precious goods of the inner treasury.

sentences.zh: 梁始為卿。

translations.literal: Liang first made it a Minister.
translations.idiomatic: The Liang first made it a Ministerial office.

sentences.zh: 歷代或置或省。

translations.literal: Through the ages it was sometimes established and sometimes abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Through the ages it was sometimes established and sometimes abolished.

sentences.zh: 隋大業五年，始分太府置少府監。

translations.literal: Sui Daye year 5 first separated it from the Imperial Treasury and established the Directorate of the Privy Treasury.
translations.idiomatic: In Sui Daye year 5 it was separated from the Imperial Treasury and established as the Directorate of the Privy Treasury.

sentences.zh: 龍朔改為內府，光宅改為尚方，神龍復為少府監。

translations.literal: Longshuo changed it to Inner Treasury; Guangzhai to Imperial Workshop; Shendlong restored it to the Directorate of the Privy Treasury.
translations.idiomatic: Under Longshuo it became the Inner Treasury; under Guangzhai, the Imperial Workshop; under Shendlong it was restored to the Directorate of the Privy Treasury.

sentences.zh: 監一員，從三品。

translations.literal: One Superintendent, secondary third rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Superintendent, secondary third rank.

sentences.zh: 秦、漢有少府，梁始為卿，隋改為監，從三品，少監，從四品。

translations.literal: Qin and Han had the Privy Treasury; Liang first made it a Minister; Sui changed it to Superintendent, secondary third rank; Vice Superintendent, secondary fourth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Qin and Han had the Privy Treasury; the Liang made it a Minister; the Sui renamed it Superintendent of secondary third rank, with a Vice Superintendent of secondary fourth rank.

sentences.zh: 煬帝改為令，武德復為監，龍朔、光宅，隨曹改易之。

translations.literal: Emperor Yang changed it to Director; Wude restored it to Superintendent; Longshuo and Guangzhai changed with the bureau.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Yang renamed it Director; Wude restored Superintendent; under Longshuo and Guangzhai the title changed with the bureau.

sentences.zh: 少監二員。

translations.literal: Two Vice Superintendents.
translations.idiomatic: Two Vice Superintendents.

sentences.zh: 從四品下。

translations.literal: Lower secondary fourth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Lower secondary fourth rank.

sentences.zh: 監之職，掌供百工伎巧之事，總中尚、左尚、右尚、織染、掌冶五署之官屬，庀其工徒，謹其繕作。

translations.literal: The Superintendent's duty is to supply the work of all craftsmen and artisans, overseeing the subordinates of the five bureaus of Inner Works, Left Works, Right Works, Dyeing and Weaving, and Metalworking, organizing workers and apprentices and carefully controlling manufacture.
translations.idiomatic: The Superintendent supplies the work of all craftsmen and artisans, supervising Inner Works, Left Works, Right Works, Dyeing and Weaving, and Metalworking, organizing workers and carefully controlling manufacture.

sentences.zh: 少監為之貳。

translations.literal: The Vice Superintendent is his deputy.
translations.idiomatic: The Vice Superintendent serves as his deputy.

sentences.zh: 凡天子之服御，百官之儀制，展采備物，皆率其屬以供之。

translations.literal: For all the Son of Heaven's robes and accoutrements, all officials' ceremonial regalia, displayed colors and prepared objects—all are supplied by leading subordinates.
translations.idiomatic: The Son of Heaven's robes and accoutrements, officials' ceremonial regalia, and displayed colors and prepared objects are all supplied by leading subordinates.

sentences.zh: 丞四人，從六品下。

translations.literal: Four Assistant Directors, lower secondary sixth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Four Assistant Directors, lower secondary sixth rank.

sentences.zh: 主簿二人，從七品下。

translations.literal: Two Chief Clerks, lower secondary seventh rank.
translations.idiomatic: Two Chief Clerks, lower secondary seventh rank.

sentences.zh: 錄事二人，從九品上。

translations.literal: Two Recording Clerks, upper secondary ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Two Recording Clerks, upper secondary ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 府二十七人，史十七人，計史三人，亭長八人，掌固四人。

translations.literal: Twenty-seven clerks, seventeen scribes, three accounting scribes, eight ward chiefs, four gatekeepers.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty-seven clerks, seventeen scribes, three accounting scribes, eight ward chiefs, and four gatekeepers.

sentences.zh: 丞掌判監事。

translations.literal: The Assistant Director supervises and decides supervisorate affairs.
translations.idiomatic: The Assistant Director supervises supervisorate business.

sentences.zh: 凡五署所修之物，則申尚書省，下所司，以供給焉。

translations.literal: For all objects manufactured by the five bureaus, report is made to the Department of State Affairs and sent down to the responsible offices for supply.
translations.idiomatic: Objects manufactured by the five bureaus are reported to the Department of State Affairs and sent to the responsible offices for supply.

sentences.zh: 中尚署：令一人，從六品下。

translations.literal: Inner Works Bureau: one Director, lower secondary sixth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Inner Works Bureau — one Director, lower secondary sixth rank.

sentences.zh: 丞四人，從八品下。

translations.literal: Four Assistant Directors, lower secondary eighth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Four Assistant Directors, lower secondary eighth rank.

sentences.zh: 府九人，史十八人，監作四人，典事四人，掌固四人。

translations.literal: Nine clerks, eighteen scribes, four production supervisors, four record keepers, four gatekeepers.
translations.idiomatic: Nine clerks, eighteen scribes, four production supervisors, four record keepers, and four gatekeepers.

sentences.zh: 中尚令，掌供郊祀之圭璧、器玩之物。

translations.literal: The Director of Inner Works manages supplying jade scepters and disks, vessels, and curios for suburban sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of Inner Works supplies jade scepters and disks, vessels, and curios for suburban sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 中宮服飾，雕文錯彩之制，皆供之。

translations.literal: Empress palace robes and ornaments, carved patterns and mixed colors—all are supplied.
translations.idiomatic: Empress palace robes and ornaments with carved patterns and mixed colors are all supplied.

sentences.zh: 丞為之貳。

translations.literal: The Assistant Director is his deputy.
translations.idiomatic: The Assistant Director serves as his deputy.

sentences.zh: 其所用金玉齒革毛羽之屬，任土以時，而供送之。

translations.literal: Gold, jade, ivory, leather, fur, and feather materials used are supplied according to local products and season.
translations.idiomatic: Gold, jade, ivory, leather, fur, and feather materials are supplied according to local products and season.

sentences.zh: 左尚署：令一人，正七品下。

translations.literal: Left Works Bureau: one Director, lower seventh rank.
translations.idiomatic: Left Works Bureau — one Director, lower seventh rank.

sentences.zh: 丞五人，從七品下。

translations.literal: Five Assistant Directors, lower secondary seventh rank.
translations.idiomatic: Five Assistant Directors, lower secondary seventh rank.

sentences.zh: 監作六人，從九品下。

translations.literal: Six production supervisors, lower secondary ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Six production supervisors, lower secondary ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 典事十八人，掌固四人。

translations.literal: Eighteen record keepers, four gatekeepers.
translations.idiomatic: Eighteen record keepers and four gatekeepers.

sentences.zh: 左尚令掌供天子之五輅、五副、七輦、三輿、十有二車、大小方圓華蓋一百五十有六，諸翟尾扇及小傘翰，辨其名數，而頒其制度。

translations.literal: The Director of Left Works manages supplying the Son of Heaven's five state carriages, five escorts, seven palanquins, three litters, twelve carriages, one hundred fifty-six large and small square and round canopy umbrellas, various pheasant-tail fans and small parasols, distinguishing their names and numbers and issuing their regulations.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of Left Works supplies the Son of Heaven's five state carriages, five escorts, seven palanquins, three litters, twelve carriages, one hundred fifty-six canopy umbrellas, pheasant-tail fans and small parasols, distinguishing their names and numbers and issuing regulations.

sentences.zh: 丞為之貳。

translations.literal: The Assistant Director is his deputy.
translations.idiomatic: The Assistant Director serves as his deputy.

sentences.zh: 右尚署：令一人，正七品下。

translations.literal: Right Works Bureau: one Director, lower seventh rank.
translations.idiomatic: Right Works Bureau — one Director, lower seventh rank.

sentences.zh: 丞四人，從八品下。

translations.literal: Four Assistant Directors, lower secondary eighth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Four Assistant Directors, lower secondary eighth rank.

sentences.zh: 監作六人，從九品下。

translations.literal: Six production supervisors, lower secondary ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Six production supervisors, lower secondary ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 典事十三人，掌固十人。

translations.literal: Thirteen record keepers, ten gatekeepers.
translations.idiomatic: Thirteen record keepers and ten gatekeepers.

sentences.zh: 右尚署令供天子十有二閑馬之鞍轡及五品三部之帳，備其材革，而修其制度。

translations.literal: The Director of Right Works supplies saddles and bridles for the Son of Heaven's twelve stable horses and tents of the three departments of fifth rank, preparing leather materials and maintaining regulations.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of Right Works supplies saddles and bridles for the Son of Heaven's twelve stable horses and fifth-rank departmental tents, preparing leather materials and maintaining regulations.

sentences.zh: 丞為之貳。

translations.literal: The Assistant Director is his deputy.
translations.idiomatic: The Assistant Director serves as his deputy.

sentences.zh: 凡刀劍、斧鉞、甲胄、紙筆、茵席、履舄之物，靡不畢供。

translations.literal: All swords, axes, halberds, armor, paper, brushes, mats, shoes, and slippers—nothing is not fully supplied.
translations.idiomatic: Swords, axes, halberds, armor, paper, brushes, mats, shoes, and slippers are all supplied.

sentences.zh: 具用綾絹、金玉、毛革等，所出方土，以時支送。

translations.literal: Silks, gauzes, gold, jade, fur, and leather used are dispatched in season from their regions of origin.
translations.idiomatic: Silks, gauzes, gold, jade, fur, and leather are dispatched in season from their regions of origin.

sentences.zh: 織染署：令一人，正八品上。

translations.literal: Dyeing and Weaving Bureau: one Director, upper eighth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Dyeing and Weaving Bureau — one Director, upper eighth rank.

sentences.zh: 丞二人，正九品上。

translations.literal: Two Assistant Directors, upper ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Two Assistant Directors, upper ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 監作六人，從九品下。

translations.literal: Six production supervisors, lower secondary ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Six production supervisors, lower secondary ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 典事十一人，掌固五人。

translations.literal: Eleven record keepers, five gatekeepers.
translations.idiomatic: Eleven record keepers and five gatekeepers.

sentences.zh: 織染令掌供天子太子群臣之冠冕，辨其制度，而供其職。

translations.literal: The Director of Dyeing and Weaving manages supplying caps and robes of the Son of Heaven, crown prince, and all ministers, distinguishing regulations and supplying their duties.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of Dyeing and Weaving supplies caps and robes for the Son of Heaven, crown prince, and all ministers, distinguishing regulations and fulfilling their needs.

sentences.zh: 丞為之貳。

translations.literal: The Assistant Director is his deputy.
translations.idiomatic: The Assistant Director serves as his deputy.

sentences.zh: 掌冶署：令一人，正八品上。

translations.literal: Metalworking Bureau: one Director, upper eighth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Metalworking Bureau — one Director, upper eighth rank.

sentences.zh: 丞一人，正九品上。

translations.literal: One Assistant Director, upper ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Assistant Director, upper ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 監作四人，從九品下。

translations.literal: Four production supervisors, lower secondary ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Four production supervisors, lower secondary ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 掌冶令掌熔鑄銅鐵器物。

translations.literal: The Director of Metalworking manages smelting and casting copper and iron objects.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of Metalworking smelts and casts copper and iron objects.

sentences.zh: 丞為之貳。

translations.literal: The Assistant Director is his deputy.
translations.idiomatic: The Assistant Director serves as his deputy.

sentences.zh: 凡天下出銅鐵州府，聽人私采，官收其稅。

translations.literal: In all prefectures producing copper and iron throughout the realm, private mining is permitted and the government collects tax.
translations.idiomatic: In prefectures producing copper and iron throughout the realm, private mining is permitted and the government collects tax.

sentences.zh: 若白鑞，則官市之。

translations.literal: If white tin, the government purchases it.
translations.idiomatic: White tin is purchased by the government.

sentences.zh: 其西北諸州，禁人無置鐵冶及采鐵。

translations.literal: In the northwestern prefectures, people are forbidden to establish iron smelters or mine iron.
translations.idiomatic: In northwestern prefectures, establishing iron smelters or mining iron is forbidden.

sentences.zh: 若器用所須，具名移於所由官供之。

translations.literal: If utensils are needed, names are fully listed and sent to the responsible office for supply.
translations.idiomatic: When utensils are needed, a full list is sent to the responsible office for supply.

sentences.zh: 諸冶：監一人，正七品下。

translations.literal: Various smelteries: one supervisor each, lower seventh rank.
translations.idiomatic: Various smelteries — one supervisor each, lower seventh rank.

sentences.zh: 丞二人，從八品下。

translations.literal: Two Assistant Directors, lower secondary eighth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Two Assistant Directors, lower secondary eighth rank.

sentences.zh: 錄事一人，府一人，史二人，監作四人，從九品下。

translations.literal: One recording clerk, one clerk, two scribes, four production supervisors, lower secondary ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: One recording clerk, one clerk, two scribes, and four production supervisors of lower secondary ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 典事二人，掌固四人。

translations.literal: Two record keepers, four gatekeepers.
translations.idiomatic: Two record keepers and four gatekeepers.

sentences.zh: 諸冶監掌鑄銅鐵之事。

translations.literal: Smeltery supervisors manage casting copper and iron.
translations.idiomatic: Smeltery supervisors oversee casting copper and iron.

sentences.zh: 北都軍器監一人，正四品上。

translations.literal: Northern Capital Armaments Supervisor: one supervisor, upper fourth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Northern Capital Armaments Supervisor — one supervisor, upper fourth rank.

translations.idiomatic: One Vice Supervisor, upper fifth rank.

translations.idiomatic: Two Assistant Directors, upper seventh rank.

translations.idiomatic: One Chief Clerk, upper eighth rank.
