translations.literal: One Recording Clerk, upper secondary ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Recording Clerk, upper secondary ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 府十人，史十八人，典事四人，亭長二人，掌固四人。

translations.literal: Ten clerks, eighteen scribes, four record keepers, two ward chiefs, four gatekeepers.
translations.idiomatic: Ten clerks, eighteen scribes, four record keepers, two ward chiefs, and four gatekeepers.

sentences.zh: 軍器監掌繕造甲弩，以時納於武庫。

translations.literal: The Armaments Supervisor manages manufacturing armor and crossbows and delivering them to the Armory on schedule.
translations.idiomatic: The Armaments Supervisor manufactures armor and crossbows and delivers them to the Armory on schedule.

sentences.zh: 甲坊署：令一人，正八品下。

translations.idiomatic: Armor Workshop Bureau — one Director, lower eighth rank.

translations.literal: One Assistant Director, lower ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Assistant Director, lower ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 府二人，史五人，監作二人，從九品下。

translations.idiomatic: Two clerks, five scribes, and two production supervisors of lower secondary ninth rank.

translations.literal: Two record keepers.
translations.idiomatic: Two record keepers.

sentences.zh: 弩坊署：令一人，正八品下。

translations.literal: Crossbow Workshop Bureau: one Director, lower eighth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Crossbow Workshop Bureau — one Director, lower eighth rank.

sentences.zh: 丞一人，正九品下。

translations.idiomatic: One Assistant Director, lower ninth rank.

translations.idiomatic: Two clerks, five scribes, and two production supervisors of lower secondary ninth rank.

translations.idiomatic: Two record keepers.

sentences.zh: 諸鑄錢監：絳州三十爐，揚、宣、鄂、蔚四州各十爐，益鄧、郴三州各五爐，洋州三爐，定州一爐也。

translations.literal: Various coin-casting supervisors: Jiangzhou thirty furnaces; Yang, Xuan, E, and Yu prefectures ten furnaces each; Yi, Deng, and Chen prefectures five furnaces each; Yangzhou three furnaces; Dingzhou one furnace.
translations.idiomatic: Various coin-casting supervisors: Jiangzhou had thirty furnaces; Yang, Xuan, E, and Yu prefectures ten each; Yi, Deng, and Chen prefectures five each; Yangzhou three; and Dingzhou one.

sentences.zh: 諸鑄錢監以所在州府都督刺史判之。

translations.literal: All coin-casting supervisors are adjudicated by the area commander or prefectural governor of their prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: All coin-casting supervisors are overseen by the area commander or prefectural governor of their prefecture.

sentences.zh: 副監一人，上佐判之。

translations.literal: One Vice Supervisor, adjudicated by the senior aide.
translations.idiomatic: One Vice Supervisor, overseen by the senior aide.

sentences.zh: 丞一人，判司判之。

translations.literal: One Assistant Director, adjudicated by the adjudication section.
translations.idiomatic: One Assistant Director, overseen by the adjudication section.

sentences.zh: 監事一人，或參軍或縣尉知之。

translations.literal: One supervisor, known by either a staff officer or county captain.
translations.idiomatic: One supervisor, held by either a staff officer or county captain.

sentences.zh: 錄事、府、史，士人為之。

translations.literal: Recording clerks, clerks, and scribes are filled by literati.
translations.idiomatic: Recording clerks, clerks, and scribes are filled by literati.

sentences.zh: 諸互市：監各一人，從六品下。

translations.literal: Various frontier markets: one supervisor each, lower secondary sixth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Various frontier markets — one supervisor each, lower secondary sixth rank.

sentences.zh: 丞一人。

translations.literal: One Assistant Director.
translations.idiomatic: One Assistant Director.

sentences.zh: 正八品下。

translations.literal: Lower eighth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Lower eighth rank.

sentences.zh: 諸互市監掌諸蕃交易馬駝驢牛之事。

translations.literal: Frontier market supervisors manage the exchange of horses, camels, donkeys, and cattle with foreign peoples.
translations.idiomatic: Frontier market supervisors oversee trade in horses, camels, donkeys, and cattle with foreign peoples.

sentences.zh: 將作監將作監秦置將作，掌營繕宮室，歷代不改。

translations.literal: Directorate of Palace Construction. Under Qin the Director of Construction was established, managing construction and repair of palace buildings; through the ages this was unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: Directorate of Palace Construction. Qin established the Director of Construction to manage construction and repair of palace buildings; later dynasties kept the arrangement.

sentences.zh: 隋為將作寺，龍朔改為繕工監，光宅改為營繕監，神龍復為將作監也。

translations.literal: Sui made it the Directorate of Construction; Longshuo changed it to the Construction Works Supervisorate; Guangzhai to the Building and Repair Supervisorate; Shendlong restored it to the Directorate of Palace Construction.
translations.idiomatic: The Sui named it the Directorate of Construction; under Longshuo it became the Construction Works Supervisorate; under Guangzhai, the Building and Repair Supervisorate; under Shendlong it was restored to the Directorate of Palace Construction.

sentences.zh: 大匠一員，從三品。

translations.literal: One Chief Artisan, secondary third rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Chief Artisan, secondary third rank.

sentences.zh: 大匠之名，漢景帝置。

translations.literal: The name Chief Artisan was established by Emperor Jing of Han.
translations.idiomatic: The title Chief Artisan was established by Emperor Jing of Han.

sentences.zh: 梁置十二卿，將作為一卿。

translations.literal: Liang established twelve Ministers; Director of Construction was one.
translations.idiomatic: The Liang established twelve Ministers, of whom the Director of Construction was one.

sentences.zh: 後周曰匠師中大夫。

translations.literal: Later Zhou called it Middle Grandee of Master Artisans.
translations.idiomatic: Later Zhou called it Middle Grandee of Master Artisans.

sentences.zh: 隋初為將作寺，置大匠一人，又改為監，以大匠為監。

translations.literal: Early Sui made it the Directorate of Construction, establishing one Chief Artisan; later changed to supervisorate, making the Chief Artisan the superintendent.
translations.idiomatic: Early Sui made it the Directorate of Construction with one Chief Artisan; later it became a supervisorate headed by the Chief Artisan.

sentences.zh: 煬帝改為令，武德改為大匠。

translations.literal: Emperor Yang changed it to Director; Wude changed it to Chief Artisan.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Yang renamed it Director; Wude restored Chief Artisan.

sentences.zh: 龍朔、光宅，隨曹改易也。

translations.literal: Longshuo and Guangzhai changed with the bureau.
translations.idiomatic: Under Longshuo and Guangzhai the title changed with the bureau.

sentences.zh: 少匠二員。

translations.literal: Two Vice Artisans.
translations.idiomatic: Two Vice Artisans.

sentences.zh: 從四品下。

translations.literal: Lower secondary fourth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Lower secondary fourth rank.

sentences.zh: 大匠掌供邦國修建土木工匠之政令，總四署、三監、百工之官屬，以供其職事。

translations.literal: The Chief Artisan manages supplying the state's construction and civil engineering artisan orders, overseeing the subordinates of four bureaus, three supervisors, and various craftsmen to fulfill their duties.
translations.idiomatic: The Chief Artisan oversees the state's construction and civil engineering artisan orders, supervising four bureaus, three supervisors, and various craftsmen to fulfill their duties.

sentences.zh: 凡兩京宮殿、宗廟、城郭、諸臺省監寺廨宇樓臺橋道，謂之內外作，皆委焉。

translations.literal: All palace buildings, ancestral temples, city walls, offices of bureaus and directorates, halls, towers, bridges, and roads of the two capitals, called inner and outer works, are entrusted to it.
translations.idiomatic: Palace buildings, ancestral temples, city walls, bureau and directorate offices, halls, towers, bridges, and roads of the two capitals — called inner and outer works — are all entrusted to it.

sentences.zh: 丞四人，從六品下。

translations.literal: Four Assistant Directors, lower secondary sixth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Four Assistant Directors, lower secondary sixth rank.

sentences.zh: 主簿二人，從七品下。

translations.literal: Two Chief Clerks, lower secondary seventh rank.
translations.idiomatic: Two Chief Clerks, lower secondary seventh rank.

translations.literal: Two Recording Clerks, lower secondary ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Two Recording Clerks, lower secondary ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 府十四人，史二十八人，計史三人，亭長四人，掌固六人。

translations.literal: Fourteen clerks, twenty-eight scribes, three accounting scribes, four ward chiefs, six gatekeepers.
translations.idiomatic: Fourteen clerks, twenty-eight scribes, three accounting scribes, four ward chiefs, and six gatekeepers.

sentences.zh: 左校署：令二人，從八品下。

translations.idiomatic: Left Workshop Bureau — two Directors, lower secondary eighth rank.

translations.idiomatic: Four Assistant Directors, lower ninth rank.

translations.literal: Six clerks, twelve scribes, ten production supervisors.
translations.idiomatic: Six clerks, twelve scribes, and ten production supervisors.

sentences.zh: 從九品下。

translations.literal: Lower secondary ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Lower secondary ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 左校令掌供營構梓匠。

translations.literal: The Director of the Left Workshop manages supplying construction carpenters.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of the Left Workshop supplies construction carpenters.

sentences.zh: 凡宮室樂懸簨弶，兵仗器械，喪葬所須，皆供之。

translations.literal: For all palace rooms, suspended music, banner poles, weapons and implements, and funeral needs—all are supplied.
translations.idiomatic: Palace rooms, suspended music, banner poles, weapons and implements, and funeral needs are all supplied.

sentences.zh: 右校署：令二人，從八品下。

translations.literal: Right Workshop Bureau: two Directors, lower secondary eighth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Right Workshop Bureau — two Directors, lower secondary eighth rank.

sentences.zh: 丞三人，正九品下。

translations.literal: Three Assistant Directors, lower ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Three Assistant Directors, lower ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 府五人，史十人，監作十人，從九品下。

translations.literal: Five clerks, ten scribes, ten production supervisors, lower secondary ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Five clerks, ten scribes, and ten production supervisors of lower secondary ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 典事十四人。

translations.literal: Fourteen record keepers.
translations.idiomatic: Fourteen record keepers.

sentences.zh: 右校令掌供版築、塗泥、丹頠之事。

translations.literal: The Director of the Right Workshop manages supplying rammed earth, plastering, and cinnabar forehead marking.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of the Right Workshop supplies rammed earth, plastering, and cinnabar forehead marking.

sentences.zh: 中校署：令一人，從八品下。

translations.literal: Middle Workshop Bureau: one Director, lower secondary eighth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Middle Workshop Bureau — one Director, lower secondary eighth rank.

sentences.zh: 丞三人，正九品下。

translations.literal: Three Assistant Directors, lower ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Three Assistant Directors, lower ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 府三人，史六人，監事四人，從九品下。

translations.literal: Three clerks, six scribes, four supervisors, lower secondary ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Three clerks, six scribes, and four supervisors of lower secondary ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 典事八人，掌固二人。

translations.literal: Eight record keepers, two gatekeepers.
translations.idiomatic: Eight record keepers and two gatekeepers.

sentences.zh: 中校令掌供舟車兵仗、廄牧雜作器用之事。

translations.literal: The Director of the Middle Workshop manages supplying boats, carriages, weapons, stable and pasture miscellaneous manufactures and utensils.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of the Middle Workshop supplies boats, carriages, weapons, and stable and pasture manufactures and utensils.

sentences.zh: 凡行幸陳設供三梁竿柱，閑廄供銼碓行槽，祭祀供葛竹塹等。

translations.literal: For imperial tours, three-beam poles are supplied; for idle stables, grinding mills and traveling troughs; for sacrifices, bamboo fences and the like.
translations.idiomatic: For imperial tours it supplies three-beam poles; for idle stables, grinding mills and traveling troughs; for sacrifices, bamboo fences and the like.

sentences.zh: 甄官署：令一人，從八品下。

translations.literal: Stone and Pottery Bureau: one Director, lower secondary eighth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Stone and Pottery Bureau — one Director, lower secondary eighth rank.

translations.idiomatic: Two Assistant Directors, lower ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 府五人，史十人，監作四人，從九品下。

translations.literal: Five clerks, ten scribes, four production supervisors, lower secondary ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Five clerks, ten scribes, and four production supervisors of lower secondary ninth rank.

translations.literal: Eighteen record keepers.
translations.idiomatic: Eighteen record keepers.

sentences.zh: 甄官令掌供琢石陶土之事。

translations.literal: The Director of Stone and Pottery manages supplying stone carving and pottery work.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of Stone and Pottery supplies stone carving and pottery work.

sentences.zh: 凡石磬碑碣、石人獸馬、碾磑磚瓦、瓶缶之器、喪葬明器，皆供之。

translations.literal: Stone chimes, steles, stone figures of men and beasts and horses, millstones, bricks and tiles, jars and pots, and funeral mingqi—all are supplied.
translations.idiomatic: Stone chimes, steles, stone figures of men, beasts, and horses, millstones, bricks and tiles, jars and pots, and funeral mingqi are all supplied.

sentences.zh: 百工、就谷、庫谷、斜谷、太陰、伊陽等監：百工監在陳倉，就谷監在王屋，庫穀監在鄠縣，太陰監在陸渾，伊陽監在伊陽，皆在出材之所。

translations.literal: Various Craft, Jiugu, Kugu, Xiegu, Taiyin, and Yiyang supervisors: the Craft Supervisor is at Chencang, Jiugu at Wangwu, Kugu at Huxian, Taiyin at Luhun, Yiyang at Yiyang—all at timber-producing places.
translations.idiomatic: Various Craft, Jiugu, Kugu, Xiegu, Taiyin, and Yiyang supervisors: the Craft Supervisor at Chencang, Jiugu at Wangwu, Kugu at Huxian, Taiyin at Luhun, and Yiyang at Yiyang — all at timber-producing sites.

sentences.zh: 監各一人，從七品下。

translations.literal: One supervisor each, lower secondary seventh rank.
translations.idiomatic: One supervisor each, lower secondary seventh rank.

sentences.zh: 丞一人，正八品下。

translations.literal: One Assistant Director, lower eighth rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Assistant Director, lower eighth rank.

sentences.zh: 府各一人，史三人，典事各二十一人，錄事各一人，監事四人。

translations.literal: One clerk each, three scribes each, twenty-one record keepers each, one recording clerk each, four supervisors.
translations.idiomatic: One clerk each, three scribes each, twenty-one record keepers each, one recording clerk each, and four supervisors.

sentences.zh: 從九品下。

translations.literal: Lower secondary ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Lower secondary ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 百工等監掌採伐材木。

translations.literal: Craft and other supervisors manage felling timber.
translations.idiomatic: Craft and other supervisors oversee felling timber.

sentences.zh: 都水監都水監：使者二人，正五品上。

translations.literal: Directorate of Waterways. Two Commissioners, upper fifth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Directorate of Waterways — two Commissioners, upper fifth rank.

sentences.zh: 漢官有都水長，屬主爵，掌諸池沼，後改為使者，後漢改為河堤謁者。

translations.literal: Han offices had a Director of Waterways, subordinate to the Director of Nobility, managing all ponds and marshes; later changed to Commissioner; Later Han changed to River Embankment Usher.
translations.idiomatic: Han offices had a Director of Waterways under the Director of Nobility, managing ponds and marshes; later the title became Commissioner; Later Han renamed it River Embankment Usher.

sentences.zh: 晉復置都水臺，立使者一人，掌舟楫之事。

translations.literal: Jin restored the Waterways Terrace, establishing one Commissioner to manage boats and oars.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin restored the Waterways Terrace with one Commissioner to manage boats and shipping.

sentences.zh: 梁改為太舟卿，北齊亦曰都水臺。

translations.literal: Liang changed it to Minister of Great Boats; Northern Qi also called it the Waterways Terrace.
translations.idiomatic: The Liang renamed it Minister of Great Boats; Northern Qi also called it the Waterways Terrace.

sentences.zh: 隋改為都水監，大業復為使者，尋又為監，復改監為令，品第三。

translations.literal: Sui changed it to the Directorate of Waterways; Daye restored Commissioner; soon again supervisorate; again changed superintendent to Director, rank third.
translations.idiomatic: The Sui renamed it the Directorate of Waterways; Daye restored Commissioner; it soon became a supervisorate again, then Director, rank third.

sentences.zh: 武德復為監，貞觀改為使者，從六品。

translations.literal: Wude restored supervisorate; Zhenguan changed to Commissioner, secondary sixth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Wude restored the supervisorate; Zhenguan renamed it Commissioner of secondary sixth rank.

sentences.zh: 龍朔改為司津監，光宅為水衛都尉，神龍復為使者，正五品上，仍隸將作監。

translations.literal: Longshuo changed it to the Ferry Supervisorate; Guangzhai to Water Guard Commandant; Shendlong restored Commissioner, upper fifth rank, still subordinate to the Directorate of Palace Construction.
translations.idiomatic: Under Longshuo it became the Ferry Supervisorate; under Guangzhai, Water Guard Commandant; under Shendlong Commissioner of upper fifth rank was restored, still subordinate to the Directorate of Palace Construction.

sentences.zh: 丞二人，從七品上。

translations.literal: Two Assistant Directors, upper secondary seventh rank.
translations.idiomatic: Two Assistant Directors, upper secondary seventh rank.

sentences.zh: 主簿二人，從八品下。

translations.literal: Two Chief Clerks, lower secondary eighth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Two Chief Clerks, lower secondary eighth rank.

sentences.zh: 錄事一人，府五人，史十人，掌固三人。

translations.literal: One recording clerk, five clerks, ten scribes, three gatekeepers.
translations.idiomatic: One recording clerk, five clerks, ten scribes, and three gatekeepers.

sentences.zh: 使者掌川澤津梁之政令，總舟楫、河渠二署之官屬，凡虞衡之採捕，渠堰陂池之壞決，水田斗門灌溉，皆行其政令。

translations.literal: The Commissioners manage orders for rivers, marshes, ferries, and bridges, overseeing the subordinates of the two bureaus of Boats and River Channels; for all forestry and fishing, breaches of canals, dikes, and ponds, and irrigation of paddy fields and sluice gates—all execute their orders.
translations.idiomatic: The Commissioners oversee orders for rivers, marshes, ferries, and bridges, supervising the Boats and River Channels bureaus; forestry and fishing, breaches of canals, dikes, and ponds, and paddy-field irrigation all follow their orders.

sentences.zh: 舟楫署：令一人，正八品下。

translations.literal: Boats Bureau: one Director, lower eighth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Boats Bureau — one Director, lower eighth rank.

sentences.zh: 丞二人。

translations.literal: Two Assistant Directors.
translations.idiomatic: Two Assistant Directors.

sentences.zh: 正九品下。

translations.literal: Lower ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Lower ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 舟楫署令掌公私舟船運漕之事。

translations.literal: The Director of the Boats Bureau manages public and private boat transport and grain transport.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of the Boats Bureau oversees public and private boat transport and grain transport.

sentences.zh: 河渠署：令一人，正八品下。

translations.literal: River Channels Bureau: one Director, lower eighth rank.
translations.idiomatic: River Channels Bureau — one Director, lower eighth rank.

sentences.zh: 丞一人，正九品上。

translations.literal: One Assistant Director, upper ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Assistant Director, upper ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 府三人，史六人。

translations.literal: Three clerks, six scribes.
translations.idiomatic: Three clerks and six scribes.

sentences.zh: 河堤謁者六人，掌修補堤堰漁釣之事。

translations.literal: Six River Embankment Ushers manage repairing dikes and dams and fishing.
translations.idiomatic: Six River Embankment Ushers repair dikes and dams and oversee fishing.

sentences.zh: 典事三人，掌固四人，長上漁師十人，短番漁師一百二十人，明資漁師一百二十人。

translations.literal: Three record keepers, four gatekeepers, ten senior fishing masters, one hundred twenty short-shift fishing masters, one hundred twenty salaried fishing masters.
translations.idiomatic: Three record keepers, four gatekeepers, ten senior fishing masters, one hundred twenty short-shift fishing masters, and one hundred twenty salaried fishing masters.

sentences.zh: 河渠令掌供川澤魚醢之事。

translations.literal: The Director of River Channels manages supplying fish and pickled fish from rivers and marshes.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of River Channels supplies fish and pickled fish from rivers and marshes.

sentences.zh: 祭祀則供魚醢。

translations.literal: At sacrifices, pickled fish is supplied.
translations.idiomatic: At sacrifices, pickled fish is supplied.

sentences.zh: 諸司供給魚及冬藏者，每歲支錢二十萬，送都水，命河渠以時價市供之。

translations.literal: For all offices supplying fish and winter storage, two hundred thousand cash is disbursed each year, sent to the Directorate of Waterways, ordering River Channels to purchase and supply at seasonal prices.
translations.idiomatic: For offices supplying fish and winter storage, two hundred thousand cash is disbursed each year to the Directorate of Waterways, which orders River Channels to purchase and supply at seasonal prices.

sentences.zh: 諸津：令一人，正九品上。

translations.literal: Various ferries: one Director each, upper ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Various ferries — one Director each, upper ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 丞一人。

translations.literal: One Assistant Director.
translations.idiomatic: One Assistant Director.

sentences.zh: 從九品下。

translations.literal: Lower secondary ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Lower secondary ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 津令各掌其津濟渡舟梁之事。

translations.literal: Ferry Directors each manage their ferry crossings, boats, and bridges.
translations.idiomatic: Ferry Directors each manage their ferry crossings, boats, and bridges.

sentences.zh: 武官左、右衛周制：軍萬二千五百人。

translations.literal: Military offices, Left and Right Guard. Zhou system: an army numbered twelve thousand five hundred.
translations.idiomatic: Military offices — Left and Right Guard. Under the Zhou system, an army numbered twelve thousand five hundred.

sentences.zh: 天子六軍，大國三軍，次國二軍，小國一軍。

translations.literal: The Son of Heaven had six armies; a great state three armies; a secondary state two armies; a small state one army.
translations.idiomatic: The Son of Heaven had six armies; a great state three; a secondary state two; a small state one.

sentences.zh: 軍將皆命卿。

translations.literal: Army commanders were all appointed ministers.
translations.idiomatic: Army commanders were all appointed ministers.

sentences.zh: 至秦、漢，始置衛將軍，後漢、魏因之。

translations.literal: By Qin and Han, Guard Generals were first established; Later Han and Wei followed this.
translations.idiomatic: Qin and Han first established Guard Generals; Later Han and Wei kept the title.

sentences.zh: 晉武帝始置左、右、中三衛將軍。

translations.literal: Emperor Wu of Jin first established Left, Right, and Central Guard Generals.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wu of the Jin first established Left, Right, and Central Guard Generals.

sentences.zh: 至隋始置左右衛、左右武衛、左右候、左右領軍、左右率府。

translations.literal: By Sui, Left and Right Guard, Left and Right Martial Guard, Left and Right Patrol, Left and Right Army Command, and Left and Right Commandant offices were first established.
translations.idiomatic: The Sui first established the Left and Right Guard, Left and Right Martial Guard, Left and Right Patrol, Left and Right Army Command, and Left and Right Commandant offices.

sentences.zh: 各有大將軍一人，謂十二衛大將軍也。

translations.literal: Each had one Grand General — called the Twelve Guard Grand Generals.
translations.idiomatic: Each had one Grand General; these were known as the Twelve Guard Grand Generals.

sentences.zh: 國家因之。

translations.literal: The state followed this.
translations.idiomatic: Our dynasty kept the arrangement.

sentences.zh: 大將軍各一員，正三品。

translations.literal: One Grand General each, third rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Grand General each, third rank.

sentences.zh: 將軍各二員。

translations.literal: Two Generals each.
translations.idiomatic: Two Generals each.

sentences.zh: 從三品。

translations.literal: Secondary third rank.
translations.idiomatic: Secondary third rank.

sentences.zh: 左右衛將軍之職，掌統領宮廷警衛之法，以督其屬之隊仗，而總諸曹之職務。

translations.literal: The duty of the Left and Right Guard Generals is to manage the methods of palace guard security, supervise the formations and arms of their subordinates, and oversee the duties of all sections.
translations.idiomatic: The Left and Right Guard Generals oversee palace security regulations, supervise their subordinates' formations and arms, and coordinate the duties of all staff sections.

sentences.zh: 凡親勳翊五中郎將府及折沖府所隸，皆總制之。

translations.literal: All five Central Commandant offices of the Intimate, Meritorious, and Support guards and the subordinate Strike-and-Smash offices are under their overall control.
translations.idiomatic: They exercise overall control over the five Intimate, Meritorious, and Support Central Commandant offices and their subordinate Strike-and-Smash offices.

sentences.zh: 凡宿衛，內廊閣門外，分為五仗，一供奉仗、二親仗、三勳仗、四翊仗、五散手仗也。

translations.literal: For all night guard duty outside the inner corridor gates, there are five formations: first, the Imperial Service formation; second, the Intimate formation; third, the Meritorious formation; fourth, the Support formation; fifth, the Unarmed formation.
translations.idiomatic: Night guard duty outside the inner corridor gates is divided into five formations: Imperial Service, Intimate, Meritorious, Support, and Unarmed.

sentences.zh: 皆坐於東西廊下。

translations.literal: All sit beneath the east and west corridors.
translations.idiomatic: All are stationed beneath the east and west corridors.

sentences.zh: 若御坐正殿，則為黃旗仗，分立於兩階之次，在正門之內，以挾門隊坐於東西廂。

translations.literal: If the emperor sits in the main hall, it becomes the Yellow Banner formation, standing separately at the foot of the two staircases, inside the main gate, with gate-flanking companies seated in the east and west wings.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor sits in the main hall, the Yellow Banner formation stands at the foot of the two staircases inside the main gate, with gate-flanking companies seated in the east and west wings.

sentences.zh: 皆大將軍守之。

translations.literal: All are guarded by the Grand Generals.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Generals command them all.

sentences.zh: 長史各一人，從六品上。

translations.literal: One Chief Administrator each, upper secondary sixth rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Chief Administrator each, upper secondary sixth rank.

sentences.zh: 錄事參軍事各一人，正八品上。

translations.literal: One Recording Staff Officer each, upper eighth rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Recording Staff Officer each, upper eighth rank.

sentences.zh: 倉曹、兵曹參軍各二人，正八品下。

translations.literal: Two Granary and Military Staff Officers each, lower eighth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Two Granary and Military Staff Officers each, lower eighth rank.

sentences.zh: 騎曹、胄曹參軍各一人，正六品下。

translations.literal: One Cavalry and Armor Staff Officer each, lower sixth rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Cavalry and Armor Staff Officer each, lower sixth rank.

sentences.zh: 司階二人，正六品上。

translations.literal: Two Stairway Masters, upper sixth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Two Stairway Masters, upper sixth rank.

sentences.zh: 中候三人，正七品下。

translations.literal: Three Central Guards, lower seventh rank.
translations.idiomatic: Three Central Guards, lower seventh rank.

sentences.zh: 司戈五人，正八品下。

translations.literal: Five Halberd Masters, lower eighth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Five Halberd Masters, lower eighth rank.

sentences.zh: 執戟五人，正九品下。

translations.literal: Five Halberd Bearers, lower ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Five Halberd Bearers, lower ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 奉車都尉五人。

translations.literal: Five Commandants of Imperial Carriages.
translations.idiomatic: Five Commandants of Imperial Carriages.

sentences.zh: 從五品下。

translations.literal: Lower secondary fifth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Lower secondary fifth rank.

sentences.zh: 長史掌判諸曹、親勳翊五府及武安、武成等五十府之事。

translations.literal: The Chief Administrator manages adjudication of all sections, the five Intimate, Meritorious, and Support offices, and the fifty offices such as Martial Peace and Martial Success.
translations.idiomatic: The Chief Administrator adjudicates matters for all staff sections, the five Intimate, Meritorious, and Support offices, and fifty offices including Martial Peace and Martial Success.

sentences.zh: 諸曹參軍皆掌本曹勾檢之事。

translations.literal: All section staff officers manage audit and inspection affairs of their own section.
translations.idiomatic: Each section staff officer audits and inspects affairs within his own section.

sentences.zh: 隨曹各有府史。

translations.literal: Each section has its own clerks and scribes.
translations.idiomatic: Each section has its own clerks and scribes.

sentences.zh: 親府、勳一府、勳二府、翊一府、翊二府等五府每府中郎一人、中郎將一人，皆四品下。

translations.literal: The five offices — Intimate, Meritorious First, Meritorious Second, Support First, and Support Second — each have one Central Gentleman and one Central Commandant, all lower fourth rank.
translations.idiomatic: The Intimate, Meritorious First, Meritorious Second, Support First, and Support Second offices each have one Central Gentleman and one Central Commandant, all lower fourth rank.

sentences.zh: 左右郎各一人，正五品上。

translations.literal: One Left and one Right Gentleman each, upper fifth rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Left and one Right Gentleman each, upper fifth rank.

sentences.zh: 錄事一人，兵曹參軍事一人，正九品上。

translations.literal: One recording clerk and one military staff officer, upper ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: One recording clerk and one military staff officer, upper ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 校尉五人，旅帥十人，隊正二十人，副隊正二十人。

translations.literal: Five company captains, ten platoon leaders, twenty squad leaders, twenty deputy squad leaders.
translations.idiomatic: Five company captains, ten platoon leaders, twenty squad leaders, and twenty deputy squad leaders.

sentences.zh: 中郎將領本府之屬以宿衛。

translations.literal: The Central Commandant leads the subordinates of his office for night guard duty.
translations.idiomatic: The Central Commandant leads his office's subordinates on night guard duty.

sentences.zh: 左右郎將貳之。

translations.literal: The Left and Right Commandants serve as his deputies.
translations.idiomatic: The Left and Right Commandants serve as his deputies.

sentences.zh: 若大朝會、巡幸，以鹵簿之法以領其儀仗。

translations.literal: At great court assemblies and imperial tours, they lead the ceremonial guard by the methods of the imperial procession.
translations.idiomatic: At great court assemblies and imperial tours, they lead the ceremonial guard according to imperial procession regulations.

sentences.zh: 左、右驍衛古曰驍騎，隋改左、右備身為左右驍衛，所領名豹騎，國家去「騎」字曰驍衛府，龍朔去「府」字，改為左、右武威，神龍復為驍衛。

translations.literal: Left and Right Valiant Guard: anciently called Valiant Cavalry; Sui changed Left and Right Bodyguard to Left and Right Valiant Guard, whose troops were called Leopard Cavalry; the state dropped the character for cavalry, calling it the Valiant Guard Office; Longshuo dropped the character for office, changing it to Left and Right Martial Prestige; Shendlong restored Valiant Guard.
translations.idiomatic: The Left and Right Valiant Guard were anciently called Valiant Cavalry. The Sui renamed the Left and Right Bodyguard as the Left and Right Valiant Guard, whose troops were called Leopard Cavalry. Our dynasty dropped "Cavalry" and called it the Valiant Guard Office; under Longshuo the word "Office" was dropped and the name became Left and Right Martial Prestige; under Shendlong it was restored to Valiant Guard.

sentences.zh: 大將軍各一員，正三品。

translations.literal: One Grand General each, third rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Grand General each, third rank.

sentences.zh: 將軍各二員。

translations.literal: Two Generals each.
translations.idiomatic: Two Generals each.

sentences.zh: 從三品。

translations.literal: Secondary third rank.
translations.idiomatic: Secondary third rank.

sentences.zh: 驍衛將軍之職，掌如左、右衛。

translations.literal: The duty of the Valiant Guard Generals is managed like the Left and Right Guard.
translations.idiomatic: The Valiant Guard Generals' duties match those of the Left and Right Guard.

sentences.zh: 大朝會在正殿之前，則以黃旗隊及胡祿隊坐於東西廊下。

translations.literal: At great court assemblies before the main hall, the Yellow Banner company and Barbarian Horn company sit beneath the east and west corridors.
translations.idiomatic: At great court assemblies before the main hall, the Yellow Banner and Barbarian Horn companies are stationed beneath the east and west corridors.

sentences.zh: 若御坐正殿，則以其隊仗次立左、右衛下。

translations.literal: If the emperor sits in the main hall, their companies and arms stand next below the Left and Right Guard.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor sits in the main hall, their formations stand in rank below the Left and Right Guard.

sentences.zh: 長史、錄事參軍、倉兵騎胄四曹參軍、員數、品秩如左右衛。

translations.literal: Chief Administrators, recording staff officers, and the four staff officers of Granary, Military, Cavalry, and Armor — numbers and ranks like the Left and Right Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Chief Administrators, recording staff officers, and Granary, Military, Cavalry, and Armor staff officers — numbers and ranks as for the Left and Right Guard.

sentences.zh: 司階、中候、司戈、執戟等，四色人數、品秩如左、右衛也。

translations.literal: Stairway Masters, Central Guards, Halberd Masters, Halberd Bearers, and the like — numbers in four colors and ranks like the Left and Right Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Stairway Masters, Central Guards, Halberd Masters, Halberd Bearers, and the like — numbers by category and ranks as for the Left and Right Guard.

sentences.zh: 校尉、旅帥、隊正、副隊、(人數如左右衛。

translations.literal: Company captains, platoon leaders, squad leaders, deputy squad leaders — numbers like the Left and Right Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Company captains, platoon leaders, squad leaders, and deputy squad leaders — numbers as for the Left and Right Guard.

sentences.zh: 翊府中郎、中郎將、左右中郎將、左、右郎將。

translations.literal: Support office Central Gentlemen, Central Commandants, Left and Right Central Commandants, Left and Right Commandants.
translations.idiomatic: Support office Central Gentlemen, Central Commandants, Left and Right Central Commandants, and Left and Right Commandants.

sentences.zh: 職掌如左右衛。

translations.literal: Duties like the Left and Right Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Their duties match those of the Left and Right Guard.

sentences.zh: 左、右武衛魏武為丞相，有武衛營。

translations.literal: Left and Right Martial Guard: when Cao Cao of Wei was Chancellor, there was a Martial Guard camp.
translations.idiomatic: The Left and Right Martial Guard: when Cao Cao of Wei was Chancellor, he maintained a Martial Guard camp.

sentences.zh: 隋采其名，置左右武衛府，有大將軍。

translations.literal: Sui adopted the name, establishing Left and Right Martial Guard offices with Grand Generals.
translations.idiomatic: The Sui adopted the name and established Left and Right Martial Guard offices headed by Grand Generals.

sentences.zh: 光宅改為左右鷹揚衛，神龍復也。

translations.literal: Guangzhai changed them to Left and Right Eagle-Soaring Guard; Shendlong restored them.
translations.idiomatic: Under Guangzhai they became the Left and Right Eagle-Soaring Guard; under Shendlong the former name was restored.

sentences.zh: 大將軍各一員，正三品。

translations.literal: One Grand General each, third rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Grand General each, third rank.

sentences.zh: 將軍各二員。

translations.literal: Two Generals each.
translations.idiomatic: Two Generals each.

sentences.zh: 從三品。

translations.literal: Secondary third rank.
translations.idiomatic: Secondary third rank.

sentences.zh: 其職掌如左、右衛。

translations.literal: Their duties are like the Left and Right Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Their duties match those of the Left and Right Guard.

sentences.zh: 大朝會，被白鎧甲，執器盾及旗等，蹕稱長唱。

translations.literal: At great court assemblies, wearing white armor, bearing weapons, shields, and banners, they call out long announcements at the imperial progress.
translations.idiomatic: At great court assemblies they wear white armor, bear weapons, shields, and banners, and call out long announcements at the imperial progress.

sentences.zh: 警持鈒隊，應蹕為左、右廂儀仗。

translations.literal: Alert halberd companies respond to the imperial progress as left and right wing ceremonial guards.
translations.idiomatic: Alert halberd companies respond to the imperial progress as left- and right-wing ceremonial guards.

sentences.zh: 在正殿前，則以諸隊次立于驍衛之下。

translations.literal: Before the main hall, all companies stand in rank below the Valiant Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Before the main hall, their companies stand in rank below the Valiant Guard.

sentences.zh: 長史、錄事參軍、倉兵騎胄四曹參軍、司階、中候、司戈、執戟、人數、品秩皆如左、右衛也。

translations.literal: Chief Administrators, recording staff officers, the four staff officers of Granary, Military, Cavalry, and Armor, Stairway Masters, Central Guards, Halberd Masters, Halberd Bearers — numbers and ranks all like the Left and Right Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Chief Administrators, recording staff officers, Granary, Military, Cavalry, and Armor staff officers, Stairway Masters, Central Guards, Halberd Masters, and Halberd Bearers — numbers and ranks all as for the Left and Right Guard.

sentences.zh: 翊府中郎將、左右郎將、錄事、兵曹。

translations.literal: Support office Central Commandants, Left and Right Commandants, recording clerks, military section.
translations.idiomatic: Support office Central Commandants, Left and Right Commandants, recording clerks, and military section.

sentences.zh: 人數、品秩如左、右衛。

translations.literal: Numbers and ranks like the Left and Right Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Numbers and ranks as for the Left and Right Guard.

sentences.zh: 左、右威衛隋為左、右屯衛，龍朔改為威衛，光宅改為左、右豹韜衛，神龍復為威衛也。

translations.literal: Left and Right Awesome Guard: Sui called them Left and Right Garrison Guard; Longshuo changed them to Awesome Guard; Guangzhai to Left and Right Leopard-Banner Guard; Shendlong restored Awesome Guard.
translations.idiomatic: The Left and Right Awesome Guard: the Sui called them Left and Right Garrison Guard; under Longshuo they became Awesome Guard; under Guangzhai, Left and Right Leopard-Banner Guard; under Shendlong they were restored to Awesome Guard.

sentences.zh: 大將軍各一員，正三品。

translations.literal: One Grand General each, third rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Grand General each, third rank.

sentences.zh: 將軍各二員。

translations.literal: Two Generals each.
translations.idiomatic: Two Generals each.

sentences.zh: 從三品。

translations.literal: Secondary third rank.
translations.idiomatic: Secondary third rank.

sentences.zh: 其職掌，大朝會則被黑甲鎧，弓箭刀盾旗等，分為左、右廂隊，次武衛之下。

translations.literal: Their duty: at great court assemblies they wear black armor, bear bows, arrows, swords, shields, banners, and the like, divided into left and right wing companies, next below the Martial Guard.
translations.idiomatic: At great court assemblies they wear black armor, bear bows, arrows, swords, shields, and banners, and are divided into left- and right-wing companies standing below the Martial Guard.

sentences.zh: 長史、錄事參軍、倉兵騎胄四曹參軍、職掌、人數、品秩皆如左、右衛也。

translations.literal: Chief Administrators, recording staff officers, the four staff officers of Granary, Military, Cavalry, and Armor — duties, numbers, and ranks all like the Left and Right Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Chief Administrators, recording staff officers, and Granary, Military, Cavalry, and Armor staff officers — duties, numbers, and ranks all as for the Left and Right Guard.

sentences.zh: 司階、中候、司戈、執戟、人數、品秩如左右衛。

translations.literal: Stairway Masters, Central Guards, Halberd Masters, Halberd Bearers — numbers and ranks like the Left and Right Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Stairway Masters, Central Guards, Halberd Masters, and Halberd Bearers — numbers and ranks as for the Left and Right Guard.

sentences.zh: 翊府中郎將、左右郎將、錄事、兵曹、校尉、旅帥、隊正、副隊正。

translations.literal: Support office Central Commandants, Left and Right Commandants, recording clerks, military section, company captains, platoon leaders, squad leaders, deputy squad leaders.
translations.idiomatic: Support office Central Commandants, Left and Right Commandants, recording clerks, military section, company captains, platoon leaders, squad leaders, and deputy squad leaders.

sentences.zh: 人數、品秩皆如左右衛之親府。

translations.literal: Numbers and ranks all like the Intimate office of the Left and Right Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Numbers and ranks all as for the Intimate office of the Left and Right Guard.

sentences.zh: 左、右領軍衛漢建安中，魏武為丞相，始置中領軍，後因之。

translations.literal: Left and Right Army Command Guard: in the Jian'an era of Han, when Cao Cao of Wei was Chancellor, the Central Army Commander was first established; later dynasties followed this.
translations.idiomatic: The Left and Right Army Command Guard: in the Jian'an era of Han, when Cao Cao of Wei was Chancellor, the Central Army Commander was first established; later dynasties kept the title.

sentences.zh: 北齊置領軍府，後因之。

translations.literal: Northern Qi established the Army Command office; later dynasties followed this.
translations.idiomatic: Northern Qi established the Army Command office; later dynasties kept it.

sentences.zh: 煬帝改為屯衛，國家改為領軍衛。

translations.literal: Emperor Yang changed it to Garrison Guard; the state changed it to Army Command Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Yang renamed it Garrison Guard; our dynasty renamed it Army Command Guard.

sentences.zh: 龍朔改為戎衛，光宅改為玉鈐衛，神龍後為領軍衛。

translations.literal: Longshuo changed it to Military Guard; Guangzhai to Jade Seal Guard; after Shendlong it became Army Command Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Under Longshuo it became Military Guard; under Guangzhai, Jade Seal Guard; after Shendlong it was restored to Army Command Guard.

sentences.zh: 大將軍各一員。

translations.literal: One Grand General each.
translations.idiomatic: One Grand General each.

sentences.zh: 正三品。

translations.literal: Third rank.
translations.idiomatic: Third rank.

sentences.zh: 將軍各二員。

translations.literal: Two Generals each.
translations.idiomatic: Two Generals each.

sentences.zh: 從三品。

translations.literal: Secondary third rank.
translations.idiomatic: Secondary third rank.

sentences.zh: 其職掌，大朝會則被青甲鎧，弓箭刀盾旗等，分為左右廂儀仗，次立威衛之下。

translations.literal: Their duty: at great court assemblies they wear green armor, bear bows, arrows, swords, shields, banners, and the like, divided into left and right wing ceremonial guards, standing next below the Awesome Guard.
translations.idiomatic: At great court assemblies they wear green armor, bear bows, arrows, swords, shields, and banners, and are divided into left- and right-wing ceremonial guards standing below the Awesome Guard.

sentences.zh: 長史、錄事參軍、倉兵騎胄四曹參軍、司階、中候、司戈、執戟、人數、品秩如左右衛。

translations.literal: Chief Administrators, recording staff officers, the four staff officers of Granary, Military, Cavalry, and Armor, Stairway Masters, Central Guards, Halberd Masters, Halberd Bearers — numbers and ranks like the Left and Right Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Chief Administrators, recording staff officers, Granary, Military, Cavalry, and Armor staff officers, Stairway Masters, Central Guards, Halberd Masters, and Halberd Bearers — numbers and ranks as for the Left and Right Guard.

sentences.zh: 翊府中郎將、左右郎將、錄事、兵曹、校尉、旅帥、隊正、副隊正。

translations.literal: Support office Central Commandants, Left and Right Commandants, recording clerks, military section, company captains, platoon leaders, squad leaders, deputy squad leaders.
translations.idiomatic: Support office Central Commandants, Left and Right Commandants, recording clerks, military section, company captains, platoon leaders, squad leaders, and deputy squad leaders.

sentences.zh: 人數、品秩、掌如左右衛也。

translations.literal: Numbers, ranks, and duties like the Left and Right Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Numbers, ranks, and duties as for the Left and Right Guard.

sentences.zh: 左、右金吾衛秦曰中尉，掌徼巡，武帝改名執金吾，魏復為中尉。

translations.literal: Left and Right Golden Guard: under Qin called Commandant of the Center, managing patrol; Emperor Wu renamed it Bearer of the Golden Mace; Wei restored Commandant of the Center.
translations.idiomatic: The Left and Right Golden Guard: under Qin called Commandant of the Center, managing patrol; Emperor Wu renamed it Bearer of the Golden Mace; Wei restored Commandant of the Center.

sentences.zh: 南朝不置。

translations.literal: The Southern dynasties did not establish it.
translations.idiomatic: The Southern dynasties did not maintain the office.

sentences.zh: 隋曰候衛。

translations.literal: Sui called it Patrol Guard.
translations.idiomatic: The Sui called it Patrol Guard.

sentences.zh: 龍朔二年改為左、右金吾衛，采古名也。

translations.literal: In the second year of Longshuo it was changed to Left and Right Golden Guard, adopting the ancient name.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Longshuo it was renamed Left and Right Golden Guard, adopting the ancient name.

sentences.zh: 大將軍各一員，正三品。

translations.literal: One Grand General each, third rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Grand General each, third rank.

sentences.zh: 將軍各二員。

translations.literal: Two Generals each.
translations.idiomatic: Two Generals each.

sentences.zh: 從三品。

translations.literal: Secondary third rank.
translations.idiomatic: Secondary third rank.

sentences.zh: 左右金吾衛之職，掌宮中及京城晝夜巡警之法，以執御非違。

translations.literal: The duty of the Left and Right Golden Guard is to manage the methods of day-and-night patrol in the palace and capital, to apprehend violations.
translations.idiomatic: The Left and Right Golden Guard oversee day-and-night patrol in the palace and capital and apprehend violations.

sentences.zh: 凡翊府及同軌等五十府皆屬之。

translations.literal: All Support offices and the fifty offices such as Same Track are subordinate to them.
translations.idiomatic: All Support offices and fifty offices including Same Track are subordinate to them.

sentences.zh: 凡車駕出入，則率其屬以清遊隊，建白澤硃雀等旗隊先驅，如鹵簿之法。

translations.literal: Whenever the imperial carriage enters or exits, they lead their subordinates in the Clearing Procession company, raising the White Marsh and Vermilion Bird banner companies as vanguard, by the methods of the imperial procession.
translations.idiomatic: When the imperial carriage enters or exits, they lead their subordinates in the Clearing Procession, with White Marsh and Vermilion Bird banner companies as vanguard, according to imperial procession regulations.

sentences.zh: 從巡狩畋獵，則執其左、右營衛之禁。

translations.literal: Accompanying imperial hunts and excursions, they enforce the left and right camp guard prohibitions.
translations.idiomatic: On imperial hunts and excursions they enforce left- and right-camp guard prohibitions.

sentences.zh: 凡翊衛、翊府、同軌、寶圖等五十府彍騎衛士應番上者，各領所職焉。

translations.literal: For all Support Guard, Support office, Same Track, Precious Chart, and other fifty offices whose crossbow cavalry guardsmen rotate for duty, each leads his assigned duties.
translations.idiomatic: For the fifty offices including Support Guard, Support office, Same Track, and Precious Chart, whose crossbow cavalry guardsmen rotate for duty, each officer leads his assigned duties.

sentences.zh: 長史、錄事參軍、倉兵騎胄四曹參軍、司階、中候、司戈、執戟、人數、品秩、職掌如左右衛也。

translations.literal: Chief Administrators, recording staff officers, the four staff officers of Granary, Military, Cavalry, and Armor, Stairway Masters, Central Guards, Halberd Masters, Halberd Bearers — numbers, ranks, and duties like the Left and Right Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Chief Administrators, recording staff officers, Granary, Military, Cavalry, and Armor staff officers, Stairway Masters, Central Guards, Halberd Masters, and Halberd Bearers — numbers, ranks, and duties as for the Left and Right Guard.

sentences.zh: 翊府中郎將、左右郎將、兵曹、校尉、旅帥、隊正、副隊正。

translations.literal: Support office Central Commandants, Left and Right Commandants, military section, company captains, platoon leaders, squad leaders, deputy squad leaders.
translations.idiomatic: Support office Central Commandants, Left and Right Commandants, military section, company captains, platoon leaders, squad leaders, and deputy squad leaders.

sentences.zh: 品秩、人數、職掌如左右衛也。

translations.literal: Ranks, numbers, and duties like the Left and Right Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Ranks, numbers, and duties as for the Left and Right Guard.

sentences.zh: 左、右監門衛漢、魏曰城門校尉，始置左右監門府，省將軍、郎將等官，國家因之。

translations.literal: Left and Right Gate Guard: Han and Wei called them Commandants of the City Gates; Left and Right Gate Guard offices were first established, eliminating Generals, Commandants, and other offices; the state followed this.
translations.idiomatic: The Left and Right Gate Guard: Han and Wei called them Commandants of the City Gates. Left and Right Gate Guard offices were first established, eliminating Generals, Commandants, and other posts; our dynasty kept the arrangement.

sentences.zh: 龍朔二年，去府字為衛。

translations.literal: In the second year of Longshuo, the character for office was dropped, making it Guard.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Longshuo the word "Office" was dropped and the name became Guard.

sentences.zh: 大將軍各一員，正三品。

translations.literal: One Grand General each, third rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Grand General each, third rank.

sentences.zh: 將軍各二員，從三品。

translations.literal: Two Generals each, secondary third rank.
translations.idiomatic: Two Generals each, secondary third rank.

sentences.zh: 中郎將四人。

translations.literal: Four Central Commandants.
translations.idiomatic: Four Central Commandants.

sentences.zh: 正四品下。

translations.literal: Lower fourth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Lower fourth rank.

sentences.zh: 監門將軍之職，掌宮禁門籍之法。

translations.literal: The duty of the Gate Guard Generals is to manage the methods of palace gate registration.
translations.idiomatic: The Gate Guard Generals oversee palace gate registration regulations.

sentences.zh: 凡京司應入宮殿門者，皆有籍。

translations.literal: For all capital offices that should enter palace gates, all have registers.
translations.idiomatic: All capital officials authorized to enter palace gates must be registered.

sentences.zh: 左將軍判入，右將軍判出。

translations.literal: The Left General adjudicates entry; the Right General adjudicates exit.
translations.idiomatic: The Left General authorizes entry; the Right General authorizes exit.

sentences.zh: 若大駕行幸，即依鹵簿法，率其屬於牙門之下，以為監守。

translations.literal: If the imperial carriage travels, they follow the imperial procession regulations, leading their subordinates beneath the gate of the encampment as guards.
translations.idiomatic: When the imperial carriage travels, they follow imperial procession regulations and lead their subordinates beneath the encampment gate as guards.

sentences.zh: 中郎將，掌監諸門，檢校出入。

translations.literal: Central Commandants manage supervision of all gates and inspect entry and exit.
translations.idiomatic: Central Commandants supervise all gates and inspect those entering and leaving.

sentences.zh: 長史、錄事參軍、兵曹胄曹二曹參軍。

translations.literal: Chief Administrator, recording staff officer, and the two staff officers of Military and Armor sections.
translations.idiomatic: Chief Administrator, recording staff officer, and Military and Armor staff officers.

sentences.zh: 品秩如諸衛。

translations.literal: Ranks like the various guards.
translations.idiomatic: Ranks as for the various guards.

sentences.zh: 監門校尉，各三百二十人，立長各六百八十人，長人長上二十人，立長長上各二十人。

translations.literal: Gate Guard company captains, three hundred twenty each; squad leaders, six hundred eighty each; senior squad leaders, twenty; senior squad-leader seniors, twenty each.
translations.idiomatic: Gate Guard company captains, three hundred twenty each; squad leaders, six hundred eighty each; twenty senior squad leaders; and twenty senior squad-leader seniors each.

sentences.zh: 左、右千牛衛宋謝綽《拾遣》有千牛刀，即人主防身刀也。

translations.literal: Left and Right Thousand-Ox Guard: in Song, Xie Chuo's 《Collected Remains》 mentions the Thousand-Ox Blade — the sovereign's personal defense blade.
translations.idiomatic: The Left and Right Thousand-Ox Guard: in Song times, Xie Chuo's 《Collected Remains》 mentions the Thousand-Ox Blade, the sovereign's personal defense sword.

sentences.zh: 後魏有千牛備身，取《莊子》庖刀解牛之義，後代因之。

translations.literal: Later Wei had Thousand-Ox Bodyguards, taking the meaning of the butcher's knife dismembering an ox from the 《Zhuangzi》; later dynasties followed this.
translations.idiomatic: Later Wei established Thousand-Ox Bodyguards, taking the butcher's knife dismembering an ox from the 《Zhuangzi》; later dynasties kept the name.

sentences.zh: 隋置左右千牛備身二十人，掌供御弓箭，備身六十人，掌宿衛侍從。

translations.literal: Sui established twenty Left and Right Thousand-Ox Bodyguards, managing supply of imperial bows and arrows; sixty bodyguards managing night guard and attendance.
translations.idiomatic: The Sui established twenty Left and Right Thousand-Ox Bodyguards to supply imperial bows and arrows, and sixty bodyguards for night guard and attendance.

sentences.zh: 煬帝置備身府，皇家改為千牛府。

translations.literal: Emperor Yang established the Bodyguard Office; the imperial house changed it to the Thousand-Ox Office.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Yang established the Bodyguard Office; our dynasty renamed it the Thousand-Ox Office.

sentences.zh: 龍朔為左右奉宸衛，神龍復為千牛衛。

translations.literal: Longshuo made it Left and Right Imperial Attendant Guard; Shendlong restored Thousand-Ox Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Under Longshuo it became the Left and Right Imperial Attendant Guard; under Shendlong it was restored to Thousand-Ox Guard.

sentences.zh: 大將軍各一員，正三品。

translations.literal: One Grand General each, third rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Grand General each, third rank.

sentences.zh: 將軍各二員，從三品。

translations.literal: Two Generals each, secondary third rank.
translations.idiomatic: Two Generals each, secondary third rank.

sentences.zh: 中郎將各二人。

translations.literal: Two Central Commandants each.
translations.idiomatic: Two Central Commandants each.

sentences.zh: 正四品下。

translations.literal: Lower fourth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Lower fourth rank.

sentences.zh: 千牛將軍之職，掌宮殿侍衛及供御之儀仗，而統其曹務。

translations.literal: The duty of the Thousand-Ox Generals is to manage palace attendance and ceremonial guard for imperial supply, and oversee their section affairs.
translations.idiomatic: The Thousand-Ox Generals oversee palace attendance and ceremonial guard for imperial supply and coordinate their staff sections.

sentences.zh: 凡千牛備身左右，執弓箭以宿衛，主仗守戎服器物。

translations.literal: All Thousand-Ox Bodyguards Left and Right bear bows and arrows for night guard, managing arms and guarding military garments and implements.
translations.idiomatic: Thousand-Ox Bodyguards Left and Right bear bows and arrows on night guard duty and manage arms, military garments, and implements.

sentences.zh: 凡受朝之日，則領備身左右升殿，而侍列於御坐之左右。

translations.literal: On days of receiving court, they lead the Bodyguards Left and Right up the hall and attend in ranks to the left and right of the imperial seat.
translations.idiomatic: On court audience days they lead the Bodyguards Left and Right up the hall and stand in attendance to the left and right of the imperial seat.

sentences.zh: 凡親射于射宮，則將軍率其屬以從。

translations.literal: Whenever the emperor personally shoots at the archery hall, the Generals lead their subordinates to follow.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor shoots personally at the archery hall, the Generals lead their subordinates in attendance.

sentences.zh: 凡千牛備身之考課、賜會及祿秩之升降，同京職事官之制。

translations.literal: For all performance review, grant assemblies, and promotion and demotion of salary ranks of Thousand-Ox Bodyguards, the regulations are the same as capital office officials.
translations.idiomatic: Performance review, grant assemblies, and salary promotions and demotions for Thousand-Ox Bodyguards follow the same regulations as capital office officials.

sentences.zh: 中郎將升殿侍奉。

translations.literal: Central Commandants ascend the hall for attendance.
translations.idiomatic: Central Commandants ascend the hall to attend the emperor.

sentences.zh: 凡侍奉，禁橫過座前者，禁對語及傾身與階下人語者，禁搖頭舉手以相招召者。

translations.literal: For all attendance: crossing in front of the seat is forbidden; facing each other in conversation and leaning to speak with people below the steps is forbidden; shaking the head and raising the hand to summon each other is forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: During attendance, crossing in front of the imperial seat is forbidden, as is conversing face to face, leaning to speak with people below the steps, and shaking the head or raising the hand to summon others.

sentences.zh: 若有口敕，通事舍人承受傳聲階下而不聞者，中郎將宣之。

translations.literal: If there is an oral edict, the Interpreter Attendant receives and transmits the voice below the steps; if it is not heard, the Central Commandant announces it.
translations.idiomatic: If there is an oral edict, the Interpreter Attendant receives and transmits it below the steps; if it is not heard, the Central Commandant announces it.

sentences.zh: 長史、錄事參軍、兵胄二曹參軍、人數、品秩同諸衛。

translations.literal: Chief Administrator, recording staff officer, the two staff officers of Military and Armor sections — numbers and ranks like the various guards.
translations.idiomatic: Chief Administrator, recording staff officer, and Military and Armor staff officers — numbers and ranks as for the various guards.

sentences.zh: 司階各二人，正六品上。

translations.literal: Two Stairway Masters each, upper sixth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Two Stairway Masters each, upper sixth rank.

sentences.zh: 中候各三人，司戈各五人，執戟各五人，品秩同諸衛。

translations.literal: Three Central Guards each, five Halberd Masters each, five Halberd Bearers each — ranks like the various guards.
translations.idiomatic: Three Central Guards each, five Halberd Masters each, five Halberd Bearers each — ranks as for the various guards.

sentences.zh: 千牛備身十二人，備身左右各二人。

translations.literal: Twelve Thousand-Ox Bodyguards; two Bodyguards Left and Right each.
translations.idiomatic: Twelve Thousand-Ox Bodyguards and two Bodyguards Left and Right each.

sentences.zh: 左、右羽林軍漢置南北軍，掌衛京師。

translations.literal: Left and Right Forest-of-Feathers Guard: Han established Northern and Southern Armies, managing defense of the capital.
translations.idiomatic: The Left and Right Forest-of-Feathers Guard: Han established Northern and Southern Armies to defend the capital.

sentences.zh: 南軍，若今諸衛也；

translations.literal: The Southern Army was like today's various guards;
translations.idiomatic: The Southern Army corresponded to today's various guards;

sentences.zh: 北軍，若今羽林軍也。

translations.literal: the Northern Army was like today's Forest-of-Feathers Guard.
translations.idiomatic: the Northern Army corresponded to today's Forest-of-Feathers Guard.

sentences.zh: 漢武置羽林，名曰建章營騎，屬光祿勳，後更名羽林騎，取六郡良家子，及死事之孤為之。

translations.literal: Emperor Wu of Han established the Forest of Feathers, called the Jianzhang Camp Cavalry, subordinate to the Director of Imperial Household; later renamed Forest-of-Feathers Cavalry, drawn from sons of good families of the six commanderies and orphans of those who died in service.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wu of Han established the Forest of Feathers, called the Jianzhang Camp Cavalry under the Director of Imperial Household; later renamed Forest-of-Feathers Cavalry, recruited from sons of good families of the six commanderies and orphans of those who died in service.

sentences.zh: 後漢置左右羽林監，南朝因之，後魏、周曰羽林率，隨左右屯衛，所領兵名曰羽林。

translations.literal: Later Han established Left and Right Forest-of-Feathers Supervisors; the Southern dynasties followed this; Later Wei and Zhou called them Forest-of-Feathers Commandants, attached to Left and Right Garrison Guard; the troops they led were called Forest of Feathers.
translations.idiomatic: Later Han established Left and Right Forest-of-Feathers Supervisors; the Southern dynasties kept them; Later Wei and Zhou called them Forest-of-Feathers Commandants under the Left and Right Garrison Guard; their troops were called Forest of Feathers.

sentences.zh: 龍朔二年，置左右羽林軍。

translations.literal: In the second year of Longshuo, Left and Right Forest-of-Feathers Guard were established.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Longshuo the Left and Right Forest-of-Feathers Guard were established.

sentences.zh: 大將軍各一員，正三品下。

translations.literal: One Grand General each, lower third rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Grand General each, lower third rank.

sentences.zh: 將軍各二員。

translations.literal: Two Generals each.
translations.idiomatic: Two Generals each.

sentences.zh: 從三品下。

translations.literal: Lower secondary third rank.
translations.idiomatic: Lower secondary third rank.

sentences.zh: 羽林將軍統領北衛禁兵之法令，而督攝左右廂飛騎之儀仗，以統諸曹之職。

translations.literal: Forest-of-Feathers Generals oversee the regulations of Northern Guard forbidden troops, supervise the ceremonial guard of left and right wing Flying Cavalry, and coordinate the duties of all sections.
translations.idiomatic: Forest-of-Feathers Generals oversee Northern Guard regulations, supervise left- and right-wing Flying Cavalry ceremonial guard, and coordinate all staff sections.

sentences.zh: 若大朝會，率其儀仗以周衛階陛。

translations.literal: At great court assemblies, they lead their ceremonial guard to encircle and guard the steps.
translations.idiomatic: At great court assemblies they lead their ceremonial guard to encircle and guard the steps.

sentences.zh: 大駕行幸，則夾道馳而為內仗。

translations.literal: When the imperial carriage travels, they gallop along both sides of the road as inner guard.
translations.idiomatic: When the imperial carriage travels, they gallop along both sides of the road as the inner guard.

sentences.zh: 凡飛騎每月番上者，皆據其名曆而配於所職。

translations.literal: For all Flying Cavalry who rotate monthly for duty, each is assigned to his post according to his name register.
translations.idiomatic: Flying Cavalry who rotate monthly for duty are assigned to posts according to their name registers.

sentences.zh: 其飛騎仗或有敕上南衙者，則大將軍承墨敕白移于金吾引駕仗，引駕仗官與監門覆奏，又降墨敕，然後得入。

translations.literal: If Flying Cavalry guard is ordered by edict to the Southern Yamen, the Grand General receives the written edict and notifies the Golden Guard Escort Guard in writing; the Escort Guard officer and Gate Guard report back, another written edict is issued, and only then may they enter.
translations.idiomatic: If Flying Cavalry guard is ordered by edict to the Southern Yamen, the Grand General receives the written edict and notifies the Golden Guard Escort Guard in writing; the Escort Guard officer and Gate Guard report back, a second written edict is issued, and only then may they enter.

sentences.zh: 長史、錄事參軍、倉兵胄三曹參軍、品秩如諸衛。

translations.literal: Chief Administrator, recording staff officer, the three staff officers of Granary, Military, and Armor sections — ranks like the various guards.
translations.idiomatic: Chief Administrator, recording staff officer, and Granary, Military, and Armor staff officers — ranks as for the various guards.

sentences.zh: 司階、中候、司戈、執戟，如千衛品秩、人數。

translations.literal: Stairway Masters, Central Guards, Halberd Masters, Halberd Bearers — ranks and numbers like the Thousand Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Stairway Masters, Central Guards, Halberd Masters, and Halberd Bearers — ranks and numbers as for the Thousand Guard.

sentences.zh: 翊府中郎將、左右郎將、錄事、兵曹、校尉、旅帥、隊正、副隊正。

translations.literal: Support office Central Commandants, Left and Right Commandants, recording clerks, military section, company captains, platoon leaders, squad leaders, deputy squad leaders.
translations.idiomatic: Support office Central Commandants, Left and Right Commandants, recording clerks, military section, company captains, platoon leaders, squad leaders, and deputy squad leaders.

sentences.zh: 人數、品秩如諸衛。

translations.literal: Numbers and ranks like the various guards.
translations.idiomatic: Numbers and ranks as for the various guards.

sentences.zh: 左、右龍武軍初，太宗選飛騎之尤驍健者，別署百騎，以為翊衛之備。

translations.literal: Left and Right Dragon Martial Guard: initially, Emperor Taizong selected the most valiant Flying Cavalry and separately assigned one hundred riders as Support Guard reserve.
translations.idiomatic: The Left and Right Dragon Martial Guard: initially Emperor Taizong selected the most valiant Flying Cavalry and separately assigned one hundred riders as Support Guard reserve.

sentences.zh: 天后初，加置千騎，中宗加置萬騎，分為左右營，置使以領之。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Empress Wu's reign, one thousand riders were added; Emperor Zhongzong added ten thousand riders, divided into left and right camps, with commissioners appointed to lead them.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Empress Wu's reign one thousand riders were added; Emperor Zhongzong added ten thousand riders, divided into left and right camps under appointed commissioners.

sentences.zh: 自開元以來，與左右羽林軍名曰北門四軍。

translations.literal: Since the Kaiyuan era, together with the Left and Right Forest-of-Feathers Guard they were called the Four Northern Gate Armies.
translations.idiomatic: Since the Kaiyuan era, together with the Left and Right Forest-of-Feathers Guard they were called the Four Northern Gate Armies.

sentences.zh: 開元二十七年，改為左右龍武軍，官員同羽林軍也。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year of Kaiyuan, they were changed to Left and Right Dragon Martial Guard; officials the same as Forest-of-Feathers Guard.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year of Kaiyuan they were renamed Left and Right Dragon Martial Guard, with the same officials as the Forest-of-Feathers Guard.

sentences.zh: 大將軍一員，正三品。

translations.literal: One Grand General, third rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Grand General, third rank.

sentences.zh: 將軍二員。

translations.literal: Two Generals.
translations.idiomatic: Two Generals.

sentences.zh: 從三品。

translations.literal: Secondary third rank.
translations.idiomatic: Secondary third rank.

sentences.zh: 長史一人，錄事參軍事一人，錄事一人，史二人，倉兵胄三曹參軍事各一人。

translations.literal: One Chief Administrator, one recording staff officer, one recording clerk, two scribes, one staff officer each for Granary, Military, and Armor sections.
translations.idiomatic: One Chief Administrator, one recording staff officer, one recording clerk, two scribes, and one staff officer each for Granary, Military, and Armor sections.

sentences.zh: 隨曹有府、史、掌固人數。

translations.literal: Each section has numbers of clerks, scribes, and gatekeepers.
translations.idiomatic: Each section has its allotted clerks, scribes, and gatekeepers.

sentences.zh: 司階二人，中候三人，司戈、執戟各五人，長上各十人。

translations.literal: Two Stairway Masters, three Central Guards, five Halberd Masters each, five Halberd Bearers each, ten seniors each.
translations.idiomatic: Two Stairway Masters, three Central Guards, five Halberd Masters each, five Halberd Bearers each, and ten seniors each.

sentences.zh: 右件官員階品、人數、職掌，如羽林軍也。

translations.literal: The above officials' ranks, numbers, and duties are like the Forest-of-Feathers Guard.
translations.idiomatic: The above officials' ranks, numbers, and duties match those of the Forest-of-Feathers Guard.

sentences.zh: 左、右神武軍至德二年，肅宗在鳳翔置。

translations.literal: Left and Right Divine Martial Guard: in the second year of Zhide, Emperor Suzong established them at Fengxiang.
translations.idiomatic: The Left and Right Divine Martial Guard were established by Emperor Suzong at Fengxiang in the second year of Zhide.

sentences.zh: 初，貞觀中置北衛七營，後改為左右羽林軍。

translations.literal: Initially, in the Zhenguan era seven Northern Guard camps were established; later changed to Left and Right Forest-of-Feathers Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Initially, in the Zhenguan era seven Northern Guard camps were established; later they became the Left and Right Forest-of-Feathers Guard.

sentences.zh: 皆選才力驍勇者充，每月一營十人為番當上。

translations.literal: All were filled with men of talent, strength, and valor; each month one camp of ten men rotated for duty.
translations.idiomatic: All were filled with men of talent, strength, and valor; each month one camp of ten men rotated for duty.

sentences.zh: 又置左右龍武軍，皆唐元功臣子弟並外州人。

translations.literal: Left and Right Dragon Martial Guard were also established, all sons and younger brothers of Tang founding meritorious officials and men from outer prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Left and Right Dragon Martial Guard were also established, recruited from sons and younger brothers of Tang founding meritorious officials and men from outer prefectures.

sentences.zh: 如宿衛兵，分日上下。

translations.literal: Like night guard troops, they rotated day by day on and off duty.
translations.idiomatic: Like night guard troops, they rotated on and off duty day by day.

sentences.zh: 肅宗在鳳翔，方收京城，以羽林軍減耗，寇難未息，乃別置神武軍，同羽林制度官吏，謂之北衙六軍。

translations.literal: Emperor Suzong was at Fengxiang, just recovering the capital; because the Forest-of-Feathers Guard was depleted and bandit troubles had not ceased, he separately established the Divine Martial Guard with the same officials and regulations as the Forest-of-Feathers Guard — called the Six Northern Yamen Armies.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Suzong was at Fengxiang, just recovering the capital; because the Forest-of-Feathers Guard was depleted and bandit troubles had not ceased, he separately established the Divine Martial Guard with the same officials and regulations as the Forest-of-Feathers Guard — called the Six Northern Yamen Armies.

sentences.zh: 又置衙前射生手千餘人，謂之左右英武軍。

translations.literal: He also established more than one thousand archer guards before the yamen, called the Left and Right Heroic Martial Guard.
translations.idiomatic: He also established more than one thousand archer guards before the yamen, called the Left and Right Heroic Martial Guard.

sentences.zh: 非六軍之例也。

translations.literal: This was not the precedent of the Six Armies.
translations.idiomatic: This was outside the Six Armies precedent.

sentences.zh: 乾元二年十月敕，左右羽林、左右龍武、左右神武官員並升同金吾四衛，置大將軍二人，將軍二人也。

translations.literal: An edict of the tenth month of the second year of Qianyuan: officials of Left and Right Forest-of-Feathers, Left and Right Dragon Martial, and Left and Right Divine Martial guards were all promoted to match the four Golden Guard offices, establishing two Grand Generals and two Generals.
translations.idiomatic: An edict of the tenth month of the second year of Qianyuan promoted officials of the Left and Right Forest-of-Feathers, Left and Right Dragon Martial, and Left and Right Divine Martial guards to match the four Golden Guard offices, establishing two Grand Generals and two Generals.

sentences.zh: 左、右神策軍上元中，以北衙軍使衛伯玉為神策軍節度使，鎮陝州，以拒東寇，以中使魚朝恩為觀軍容使，監伯玉軍。

translations.literal: Left and Right Divine Strategy Guard: in the Shangyuan era, Northern Yamen Army Commissioner Wei Boyu was made Military Commissioner of the Divine Strategy Army, stationed at Shaanzhou to resist eastern invaders; the palace envoy Yu Chao'en was made Army Supervising Commissioner to supervise Boyu's army.
translations.idiomatic: The Left and Right Divine Strategy Guard: in the Shangyuan era, Northern Yamen Army Commissioner Wei Boyu was made Military Commissioner of the Divine Strategy Army at Shaanzhou to resist eastern invaders; palace envoy Yu Chao'en was made Army Supervising Commissioner to supervise Boyu's army.

sentences.zh: 及伯玉入為羽林帥，出為荊南節度使，朝恩專統神策軍，鎮陝。

translations.literal: When Boyu entered the capital as Forest-of-Feathers commander and went out as Military Commissioner of Jingnan, Chao'en alone commanded the Divine Strategy Army, stationed at Shaan.
translations.idiomatic: When Boyu entered the capital as Forest-of-Feathers commander and went out as Military Commissioner of Jingnan, Chao'en alone commanded the Divine Strategy Army at Shaan.

sentences.zh: 廣德元年，吐蕃犯京師，代宗避狄幸陝，朝恩以神策軍迎扈。

translations.literal: In the first year of Guangde, Tibetans invaded the capital; Emperor Daizong fled the barbarians to Shaan; Chao'en welcomed and escorted him with the Divine Strategy Army.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Guangde, Tibetans invaded the capital; Emperor Daizong fled to Shaan; Chao'en welcomed and escorted him with the Divine Strategy Army.

sentences.zh: 及永泰元年，吐蕃犯京畿，朝恩以神策兵屯于苑中。

translations.literal: By the first year of Yongtai, when Tibetans invaded the capital region, Chao'en stationed Divine Strategy troops in the imperial park.
translations.idiomatic: By the first year of Yongtai, when Tibetans invaded the capital region, Chao'en stationed Divine Strategy troops in the imperial park.

sentences.zh: 自是，神策軍恆以中官為帥。

translations.literal: From this time, the Divine Strategy Army was always commanded by palace eunuchs.
translations.idiomatic: From this time the Divine Strategy Army was always commanded by palace eunuchs.

sentences.zh: 建中末，盜發京師，竇文場以神策軍扈蹕山南。

translations.literal: At the end of Jianzhong, when bandits broke out in the capital, Dou Wenchang escorted the imperial progress to the south of the mountains with the Divine Strategy Army.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of Jianzhong, when bandits broke out in the capital, Dou Wenchang escorted the emperor to the south of the mountains with the Divine Strategy Army.

sentences.zh: 及還京師，賞勞無比。

translations.literal: When they returned to the capital, rewards and compensation were beyond compare.
translations.idiomatic: When they returned to the capital, rewards and compensation were beyond compare.

sentences.zh: 貞元中，特置神策軍護軍中尉，以中官為之，時號兩軍中尉。

translations.literal: In the Zhenyuan era, the Army-Protecting Commandant of the Divine Strategy Army was specially established, filled by palace eunuchs; at the time they were called the Two Army Commandants.
translations.idiomatic: In the Zhenyuan era the Army-Protecting Commandant of the Divine Strategy Army was specially established, filled by palace eunuchs; at the time they were called the Two Army Commandants.

sentences.zh: 貞元已後，中尉之權傾於天下，人主廢立，皆出其可否，事見《宦者傳》也。

translations.literal: After Zhenyuan, the Commandants' power dominated the realm; the enthronement and deposition of rulers all depended on their approval — the matter is recorded in the 《Biographies of Eunuchs》.
translations.idiomatic: After Zhenyuan the Commandants' power dominated the realm; enthronement and deposition of rulers all depended on their approval — as recorded in the 《Biographies of Eunuchs》.

sentences.zh: 大將軍各二員，正三品。

translations.literal: Two Grand Generals each, third rank.
translations.idiomatic: Two Grand Generals each, third rank.

sentences.zh: 貞元二年九月敕，改神策左右廂為左右軍，置大將軍各二人，正三品。

translations.literal: An edict of the ninth month of the second year of Zhenyuan changed the left and right wings of the Divine Strategy Army to left and right armies, establishing two Grand Generals each, third rank.
translations.idiomatic: An edict of the ninth month of the second year of Zhenyuan changed the left and right wings of the Divine Strategy Army to left and right armies, establishing two Grand Generals each of third rank.

sentences.zh: 將軍各二員。

translations.literal: Two Generals each.
translations.idiomatic: Two Generals each.

sentences.zh: 從三品。

translations.literal: Secondary third rank.
translations.idiomatic: Secondary third rank.

sentences.zh: 至貞元三年五月，敕左、右神策將軍各加二員，左、右神武將軍各加一員也。

translations.literal: By the fifth month of the third year of Zhenyuan, an edict added two Generals each to Left and Right Divine Strategy and one General each to Left and Right Divine Martial.
translations.idiomatic: By the fifth month of the third year of Zhenyuan an edict added two Generals each to Left and Right Divine Strategy and one General each to Left and Right Divine Martial.

sentences.zh: 神威軍本號殿前射生左右廂，貞元二年九月改殿前左右射生軍，三年四月改為左右神威軍，非六軍之例也。

translations.literal: Heroic Prestige Guard was originally called the Left and Right Archers Before the Hall; in the ninth month of the second year of Zhenyuan changed to Left and Right Archers Before the Hall Army; in the fourth month of the third year changed to Left and Right Heroic Prestige Guard — not the precedent of the Six Armies.
translations.idiomatic: Heroic Prestige Guard was originally called the Left and Right Archers Before the Hall; in the ninth month of the second year of Zhenyuan it became the Left and Right Archers Before the Hall Army; in the fourth month of the third year it became the Left and Right Heroic Prestige Guard — outside the Six Armies precedent.

sentences.zh: 大將軍二員，正三品。

translations.literal: Two Grand Generals, third rank.
translations.idiomatic: Two Grand Generals, third rank.

sentences.zh: 將軍二員。

translations.literal: Two Generals.
translations.idiomatic: Two Generals.

sentences.zh: 從三品。

translations.literal: Secondary third rank.
translations.idiomatic: Secondary third rank.

sentences.zh: 職田、俸錢、手力、糧料等，同六軍諸衛。

translations.literal: Official fields, salary cash, laborers, grain rations, and the like are the same as the Six Armies and various guards.
translations.idiomatic: Official fields, salary cash, laborers, grain rations, and the like match those of the Six Armies and various guards.

sentences.zh: 六軍統軍興元元年正月二十九日敕，左右羽林、左右龍武、左右神武各置統軍一人，秩從二品。

translations.literal: Army Commanders of the Six Armies: an edict of the twenty-ninth day of the first month of the first year of Xingyuan established one Army Commander each for Left and Right Forest-of-Feathers, Left and Right Dragon Martial, and Left and Right Divine Martial, rank secondary second.
translations.idiomatic: Army Commanders of the Six Armies: an edict of the twenty-ninth day of the first month of the first year of Xingyuan established one Army Commander each for the Left and Right Forest-of-Feathers, Left and Right Dragon Martial, and Left and Right Divine Martial, rank secondary second.

sentences.zh: 十六衛上將軍舊無此官。

translations.literal: Senior Generals of the Sixteen Guards — formerly there was no such office.
translations.idiomatic: Senior Generals of the Sixteen Guards — formerly there was no such office.

sentences.zh: 貞元二年九月一日敕：「六軍先有敕，各置統軍一人，十六衛宜各置上將軍一員，秩從二品。

translations.literal: An edict of the first day of the ninth month of the second year of Zhenyuan: "The Six Armies already had an edict establishing one Army Commander each; the Sixteen Guards should each establish one Senior General, rank secondary second.
translations.idiomatic: An edict of the first day of the ninth month of the second year of Zhenyuan stated: "The Six Armies already had an edict establishing one Army Commander each; the Sixteen Guards should each establish one Senior General of secondary second rank.

sentences.zh: 其左右衛及左右金吾衛上將軍俸料、隨軍人馬等，並同六軍統軍。

translations.literal: For Senior Generals of the Left and Right Guard and Left and Right Golden Guard, salary provisions, accompanying army personnel and horses, and the like are all the same as Six Armies Army Commanders.
translations.idiomatic: Senior Generals of the Left and Right Guard and Left and Right Golden Guard receive salary provisions, accompanying army personnel and horses, and the like on the same terms as Six Armies Army Commanders.

sentences.zh: 其諸衛上將軍，次統軍例支給。

translations.literal: Senior Generals of the various guards are paid according to the precedent next below Army Commanders.
translations.idiomatic: Senior Generals of the various guards are paid according to the precedent next below Army Commanders.

sentences.zh: 」貞元二年九月十三日，六軍十二衛上將軍，並放入宿，已後為例也。

translations.literal: " On the thirteenth day of the ninth month of the second year of Zhenyuan, Senior Generals of the Six Armies and Twelve Guards were all admitted to night residence; this became the precedent thereafter.
translations.idiomatic: " On the thirteenth day of the ninth month of the second year of Zhenyuan, Senior Generals of the Six Armies and Twelve Guards were all admitted to night residence; this became the precedent thereafter.

sentences.zh: 諸府隋置驃騎、鷹揚等府，凡天下守戍兵，不成軍曰牙，府有上中下也。
