translations.literal: Various offices: Sui established Swift Cavalry, Eagle-Soaring, and other offices; for all garrison troops throughout the realm, those not forming an army were called yamen; offices had upper, middle, and lower grades.
translations.idiomatic: Various offices: the Sui established Swift Cavalry, Eagle-Soaring, and other offices; garrison troops throughout the realm that did not form an army were called yamen; offices had upper, middle, and lower grades.

sentences.zh: 折沖都尉各一人，上府，都尉正四品上。

translations.literal: One Strike-and-Smash Commandant each; upper office — Commandant upper fourth rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Strike-and-Smash Commandant each; upper office — Commandant, upper fourth rank.

sentences.zh: 中府，從四品下。

translations.literal: Middle office, lower secondary fourth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Middle office — lower secondary fourth rank.

sentences.zh: 下府，正五品下。

translations.literal: Lower office, lower fifth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Lower office — lower fifth rank.

sentences.zh: 武德中，采隋折沖、果毅郎將之名，改統軍為折沖都尉，別將為果毅都尉。

translations.literal: In the Wude era, adopting Sui names Strike-and-Smash and Resolute General, Army Commander was changed to Strike-and-Smash Commandant and Vice General to Resolute Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: In the Wude era, adopting Sui names Strike-and-Smash and Resolute General, Army Commander was renamed Strike-and-Smash Commandant and Vice General Resolute Commandant.

sentences.zh: 左右果毅都尉各一人，上府，果毅從五品下。

translations.literal: One Left and one Right Resolute Commandant each; upper office — Resolute lower secondary fifth rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Left and one Right Resolute Commandant each; upper office — Resolute, lower secondary fifth rank.

sentences.zh: 中府，正六品上。

translations.literal: Middle office, upper sixth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Middle office — upper sixth rank.

sentences.zh: 下府從六品下。

translations.literal: Lower office, lower secondary sixth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Lower office — lower secondary sixth rank.

sentences.zh: 隋煬帝置果毅郎將，國家置折沖都尉。

translations.literal: Emperor Yang of Sui established Resolute Generals; the state established Strike-and-Smash Commandants.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Yang of Sui established Resolute Generals; our dynasty established Strike-and-Smash Commandants.

sentences.zh: 別將各一人，上府，別將正七品下。

translations.literal: One Vice General each; upper office — Vice General lower seventh rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Vice General each; upper office — Vice General, lower seventh rank.

sentences.zh: 中府，從七品上。

translations.literal: Middle office, upper secondary seventh rank.
translations.idiomatic: Middle office — upper secondary seventh rank.

sentences.zh: 下府，從七品下。

translations.literal: Lower office, lower secondary seventh rank.
translations.idiomatic: Lower office — lower secondary seventh rank.

sentences.zh: 長史一人，上府，正七品下。

translations.literal: One Chief Administrator; upper office, lower seventh rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Chief Administrator; upper office — lower seventh rank.

sentences.zh: 中府，從七品上。

translations.literal: Middle office, upper secondary seventh rank.
translations.idiomatic: Middle office — upper secondary seventh rank.

sentences.zh: 下府，從七品下。

translations.literal: Lower office, lower secondary seventh rank.
translations.idiomatic: Lower office — lower secondary seventh rank.

sentences.zh: 兵曹參軍一人，上府，從八品下。

translations.literal: One Military Staff Officer; upper office, lower secondary eighth rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Military Staff Officer; upper office — lower secondary eighth rank.

sentences.zh: 中府，正九品上。

translations.literal: Middle office, upper ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Middle office — upper ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 下府，從九品下也。

translations.literal: Lower office, lower secondary ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Lower office — lower secondary ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 錄事一人，校尉五人。

translations.literal: One recording clerk, five company captains.
translations.idiomatic: One recording clerk and five company captains.

sentences.zh: 每校尉，旅帥二人，每旅帥，隊正、副隊正各二人。

translations.literal: For each company captain, two platoon leaders; for each platoon leader, two squad leaders and two deputy squad leaders each.
translations.idiomatic: Each company captain has two platoon leaders; each platoon leader has two squad leaders and two deputy squad leaders.

sentences.zh: 諸府折沖都尉掌領五校之屬，以備宿衛，以從師役，總其戎具、資糧、差點、教習之法令。

translations.literal: Strike-and-Smash Commandants of various offices command the subordinates of five companies, for night guard reserve and campaign service, overseeing regulations for military equipment, supplies, assignment, and training.
translations.idiomatic: Strike-and-Smash Commandants of various offices command five companies for night guard reserve and campaign service, overseeing regulations for military equipment, supplies, assignment, and training.

sentences.zh: 凡衛士，三百人為一團，以校尉領之，以便習騎射者為越騎，餘為步兵。

translations.literal: For all guardsmen, three hundred form one regiment, led by a company captain; those skilled in mounted archery become Flying Cavalry; the rest become infantry.
translations.idiomatic: Guardsmen form regiments of three hundred under a company captain; those skilled in mounted archery become Flying Cavalry; the rest become infantry.

sentences.zh: 其團，十人為火，火備六馱之馬。

translations.literal: In each regiment, ten form a squad; each squad is equipped with six pack horses.
translations.idiomatic: In each regiment ten men form a squad; each squad is equipped with six pack horses.

sentences.zh: 每歲十一月，以衛士帳上尚書省天下兵馬之數以聞。

translations.literal: Every year in the eleventh month, guardsmen registers are submitted to the Department of State Affairs reporting the numbers of troops and horses throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: Every year in the eleventh month, guardsmen registers are submitted to the Department of State Affairs reporting troop and horse numbers throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 凡兵馬在府，每歲季冬，折沖都尉率五校之屬以教其軍陣、戰鬥之法也。

translations.literal: For all troops and horses in the offices, each year at the end of winter, the Strike-and-Smash Commandant leads the subordinates of five companies to teach army formations and battle methods.
translations.idiomatic: Each year at the end of winter, Strike-and-Smash Commandants lead five companies to teach army formations and battle methods.

sentences.zh: 具有教習簿籍。

translations.literal: Training registers are kept.
translations.idiomatic: Training registers are maintained.

sentences.zh: 東宮官屬太子太師、太傅、太保各一員。

translations.literal: Eastern Palace officials: one Grand Preceptor, one Grand Tutor, and one Grand Protector of the Heir Apparent each.
translations.idiomatic: Eastern Palace officials: one Grand Preceptor, one Grand Tutor, and one Grand Protector of the Heir Apparent each.

sentences.zh: 並從一品。

translations.literal: All secondary first rank.
translations.idiomatic: All secondary first rank.

sentences.zh: 師傅，宮官，南朝不置。

translations.literal: Preceptors and tutors are palace officials; the Southern dynasties did not establish them.
translations.idiomatic: Preceptors and tutors are palace officials; the Southern dynasties did not maintain them.

sentences.zh: 後魏、北齊，師傅品第二，號東宮三太。

translations.literal: Later Wei and Northern Qi: preceptors and tutors rank second, called the Three Grandees of the Eastern Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Later Wei and Northern Qi ranked preceptors and tutors second, calling them the Three Grandees of the Eastern Palace.

sentences.zh: 隋品亦第二。

translations.literal: Sui rank was also second.
translations.idiomatic: The Sui also ranked them second.

sentences.zh: 武德定令，加從一品也。

translations.literal: The Wude statutes raised them to secondary first rank.
translations.idiomatic: The Wude statutes raised them to secondary first rank.

sentences.zh: 太子少師、少傅、少保各一員。

translations.literal: One Junior Preceptor, one Junior Tutor, and one Junior Protector of the Heir Apparent each.
translations.idiomatic: One Junior Preceptor, one Junior Tutor, and one Junior Protector of the Heir Apparent each.

sentences.zh: 並正二品。

translations.literal: All second rank.
translations.idiomatic: All second rank.

sentences.zh: 三少，亦古官，歷代或置或省。

translations.literal: The Three Juniors are also ancient offices; through the ages they were sometimes established and sometimes abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The Three Juniors are also ancient offices; through the ages they were sometimes established and sometimes abolished.

sentences.zh: 南朝並不置。

translations.literal: The Southern dynasties did not establish them at all.
translations.idiomatic: The Southern dynasties did not maintain them at all.

sentences.zh: 後魏、北齊置之，品第三，號東宮三少。

translations.literal: Later Wei and Northern Qi established them, rank third, called the Three Juniors of the Eastern Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Later Wei and Northern Qi established them at third rank, calling them the Three Juniors of the Eastern Palace.

sentences.zh: 皇家定令，正二品。

translations.literal: The imperial statutes fixed them at second rank.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial statutes fixed them at second rank.

sentences.zh: 三師三少之職，掌教諭太子。

translations.literal: The duty of the Three Preceptors and Three Juniors is to instruct and admonish the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: The Three Preceptors and Three Juniors instruct and admonish the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 無其人，則闕之。

translations.literal: If there is no suitable person, the post is left vacant.
translations.idiomatic: If no suitable person is available, the post is left vacant.

sentences.zh: 太子賓客四員。

translations.literal: Four Guests of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: Four Guests of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 正三品。

translations.literal: Third rank.
translations.idiomatic: Third rank.

sentences.zh: 古無此官，皇家顯慶元年春始置四員也。

translations.literal: Anciently there was no such office; the imperial house first established four posts in the spring of the first year of Xianqing.
translations.idiomatic: Anciently there was no such office; our dynasty first established four posts in the spring of the first year of Xianqing.

sentences.zh: 掌侍從規諫，贊相禮儀。

translations.literal: They manage attendance and remonstrance, assisting in ceremonial etiquette.
translations.idiomatic: They attend the Heir Apparent, offer remonstrance, and assist in ceremonial etiquette.

sentences.zh: 太子詹事一員，正三品。

translations.literal: One Chief Steward of the Heir Apparent, third rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Chief Steward of the Heir Apparent, third rank.

sentences.zh: 少詹事一員。

translations.literal: One Vice Steward.
translations.idiomatic: One Vice Steward.

sentences.zh: 正四品上。

translations.literal: Upper fourth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Upper fourth rank.

sentences.zh: 詹事，秦官，掌皇太子宮。

translations.literal: Chief Steward is a Qin office, managing the Heir Apparent's palace.
translations.idiomatic: Chief Steward is a Qin office managing the Heir Apparent's palace.

sentences.zh: 龍朔二年改為端尹，天授為宮尹，神龍復也。

translations.literal: In the second year of Longshuo changed to Rectifying Administrator; Tianshou to Palace Administrator; Shendlong restored the former name.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Longshuo it became Rectifying Administrator; under Tianshou, Palace Administrator; under Shendlong the former name was restored.

sentences.zh: 詹事統東宮三寺十率府之政令。

translations.literal: The Chief Steward oversees the orders of the Eastern Palace's three directorates and ten commandant offices.
translations.idiomatic: The Chief Steward oversees orders for the Eastern Palace's three directorates and ten commandant offices.

sentences.zh: 少詹為之貳。

translations.literal: The Vice Steward serves as his deputy.
translations.idiomatic: The Vice Steward serves as his deputy.

sentences.zh: 凡天子六官之典制，皆視其事而承受之。

translations.literal: For all the Son of Heaven's six offices' canonical regulations, each receives them according to its affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Each receives the Son of Heaven's six offices' canonical regulations according to its affairs.

sentences.zh: 丞二人，正六品上。

translations.literal: Two Assistant Directors, upper sixth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Two Assistant Directors, upper sixth rank.

sentences.zh: 主簿一人，從七品上。

translations.literal: One Chief Clerk, upper secondary seventh rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Chief Clerk, upper secondary seventh rank.

sentences.zh: 錄事二人，正九品下。

translations.literal: Two Recording Clerks, lower ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Two Recording Clerks, lower ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 令史九人，書令史十八人。

translations.literal: Nine clerks, eighteen writing clerks.
translations.idiomatic: Nine clerks and eighteen writing clerks.

sentences.zh: 丞掌判府事。

translations.literal: Assistant Directors manage adjudication of office affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Assistant Directors adjudicate office affairs.

sentences.zh: 主簿掌印，檢勾稽。

translations.literal: The Chief Clerk manages seals and audit inspection.
translations.idiomatic: The Chief Clerk manages seals and audit inspection.

sentences.zh: 錄事掌受事發辰。

translations.literal: Recording Clerks manage receiving documents and dispatching correspondence.
translations.idiomatic: Recording Clerks receive documents and dispatch correspondence.

sentences.zh: 司直一人，正七品上，令史一人，書令史二人，亭長四人，掌固六人。

translations.literal: One Rectifier, upper seventh rank; one clerk, two writing clerks, four ward chiefs, six gatekeepers.
translations.idiomatic: One Rectifier of upper seventh rank; one clerk, two writing clerks, four ward chiefs, and six gatekeepers.

translations.literal: Heir Apparent's Household Directorate: one Director, upper secondary fourth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Heir Apparent's Household Directorate — one Director, upper secondary fourth rank.

sentences.zh: 丞二人，從七品上。

translations.literal: Two Assistant Directors, upper secondary seventh rank.
translations.idiomatic: Two Assistant Directors, upper secondary seventh rank.

sentences.zh: 主簿一人，正九品下。

translations.literal: One Chief Clerk, lower ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Chief Clerk, lower ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 錄事一人。

translations.literal: One recording clerk.
translations.idiomatic: One recording clerk.

sentences.zh: 家令掌太子飲膳、倉儲、庫藏之政令，總食官、典倉、司藏三署之官屬。

translations.literal: The Household Director manages orders for the Heir Apparent's food and drink, granaries, and treasuries, overseeing the subordinates of the three bureaus of Food, Granary, and Treasury.
translations.idiomatic: The Household Director oversees orders for the Heir Apparent's food and drink, granaries, and treasuries and supervises the Food, Granary, and Treasury bureaus.

sentences.zh: 食官署：令一人，從八品下。

translations.literal: Food Bureau: one Director, lower secondary eighth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Food Bureau — one Director, lower secondary eighth rank.

sentences.zh: 丞二人，從九品下。

translations.literal: Two Assistant Directors, lower secondary ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Two Assistant Directors, lower secondary ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 掌膳十二人，奉觶三十人。

translations.literal: Twelve food attendants, thirty cup bearers.
translations.idiomatic: Twelve food attendants and thirty cup bearers.

sentences.zh: 食官令掌飲膳之事。

translations.literal: The Food Director manages food and drink affairs.
translations.idiomatic: The Food Director manages food and drink affairs.

sentences.zh: 典倉署：令一人，從八品下。

translations.literal: Granary Bureau: one Director, lower secondary eighth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Granary Bureau — one Director, lower secondary eighth rank.

sentences.zh: 丞二人，從九品下。

translations.literal: Two Assistant Directors, lower secondary ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Two Assistant Directors, lower secondary ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 園丞二人，典事六人。

translations.literal: Two garden Assistant Directors, six record keepers.
translations.idiomatic: Two garden Assistant Directors and six record keepers.

sentences.zh: 典倉令掌九谷入藏，及醯醢、庶羞、器皿、燈燭之事。

translations.literal: The Granary Director manages storing the nine grains, and pickled sauces, various dishes, utensils, and lamps and candles.
translations.idiomatic: The Granary Director manages storing the nine grains, pickled sauces, various dishes, utensils, and lamps and candles.

sentences.zh: 司藏署：令一人，從八品下。

translations.literal: Treasury Bureau: one Director, lower secondary eighth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Treasury Bureau — one Director, lower secondary eighth rank.

sentences.zh: 丞二人。

translations.literal: Two Assistant Directors.
translations.idiomatic: Two Assistant Directors.

sentences.zh: 從九品下。

translations.literal: Lower secondary ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Lower secondary ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 司藏令掌庫藏財貨、出納、營繕之事。

translations.literal: The Treasury Director manages treasury goods, receipts and disbursements, and construction and repair.
translations.idiomatic: The Treasury Director manages treasury goods, receipts and disbursements, and construction and repair.

sentences.zh: 太子率更寺：令一人，從四品上。

translations.literal: Heir Apparent's Commandant of Watch Changes Directorate: one Director, upper secondary fourth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Heir Apparent's Commandant of Watch Changes Directorate — one Director, upper secondary fourth rank.

sentences.zh: 丞二人，從七品上。

translations.literal: Two Assistant Directors, upper secondary seventh rank.
translations.idiomatic: Two Assistant Directors, upper secondary seventh rank.

sentences.zh: 主簿一人，正九品下。

translations.literal: One Chief Clerk, lower ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Chief Clerk, lower ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 錄事一人，伶官師二人，漏刻博士二人，掌漏六人，漏童六十人，典鼓二十四人。

translations.literal: One recording clerk, two music-master instructors, two water-clock doctors, six clock keepers, sixty clock apprentices, twenty-four drum keepers.
translations.idiomatic: One recording clerk, two music-master instructors, two water-clock doctors, six clock keepers, sixty clock apprentices, and twenty-four drum keepers.

sentences.zh: 率更令掌宗族次序、禮樂、刑罰及漏刻之政令。

translations.literal: The Commandant of Watch Changes manages orders for clan precedence, ritual and music, punishments, and water clocks.
translations.idiomatic: The Commandant of Watch Changes oversees orders for clan precedence, ritual and music, punishments, and water clocks.

sentences.zh: 太子僕寺：僕一人，從四品下。

translations.literal: Heir Apparent's Master of Carriages Directorate: one Master, lower secondary fourth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Heir Apparent's Master of Carriages Directorate — one Master, lower secondary fourth rank.

sentences.zh: 丞一人，從七品上。

translations.literal: One Assistant Director, upper secondary seventh rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Assistant Director, upper secondary seventh rank.

sentences.zh: 主簿一人，正九品下。

translations.literal: One Chief Clerk, lower ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Chief Clerk, lower ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 錄事一人，太子僕掌車輿、乘騎、儀仗之政令及喪葬之禮物，辨其次序。

translations.literal: One recording clerk; the Master of Carriages manages orders for carriages, riding horses, and ceremonial guard, and funeral gifts, distinguishing their order.
translations.idiomatic: One recording clerk; the Master of Carriages oversees orders for carriages, riding horses, ceremonial guard, and funeral gifts and determines their order.

sentences.zh: 廄牧署：令一人，從八品下。

translations.literal: Stable and Pasture Bureau: one Director, lower secondary eighth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Stable and Pasture Bureau — one Director, lower secondary eighth rank.

sentences.zh: 丞二人，從九品下。

translations.literal: Two Assistant Directors, lower secondary ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Two Assistant Directors, lower secondary ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 典乘四人，牧長四人，翼馭十五人，駕士三十人，獸醫二十人。

translations.literal: Four carriage keepers, four pasture chiefs, fifteen wing grooms, thirty grooms, twenty veterinarians.
translations.idiomatic: Four carriage keepers, four pasture chiefs, fifteen wing grooms, thirty grooms, and twenty veterinarians.

sentences.zh: 廄牧令掌車馬、閑廄、牧畜之事。

translations.literal: The Stable and Pasture Director manages carriages and horses, idle stables, and livestock pasturing.
translations.idiomatic: The Stable and Pasture Director manages carriages and horses, idle stables, and livestock pasturing.

sentences.zh: 東宮武官太子左、右衛率府：秦、漢有太子衛率，主門衛。

translations.literal: Eastern Palace military offices — Heir Apparent's Left and Right Guard Commandant offices: Qin and Han had the Heir Apparent's Guard Commandant, managing gate security.
translations.idiomatic: Eastern Palace military offices — Heir Apparent's Left and Right Guard Commandant offices: Qin and Han had the Heir Apparent's Guard Commandant managing gate security.

sentences.zh: 晉分左、右、中、前四衛率，後代因置左、右率。

translations.literal: Jin divided into Left, Right, Central, and Front Guard Commandants; later dynasties accordingly established Left and Right Commandants.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin divided into Left, Right, Central, and Front Guard Commandants; later dynasties established Left and Right Commandants accordingly.

sentences.zh: 北齊為衛率坊。

translations.literal: Northern Qi made it the Guard Commandant Office.
translations.idiomatic: Northern Qi called it the Guard Commandant Office.

sentences.zh: 隋初始分置左右衛率府、左右宗衛率、左右虞候、左右內率、左右監門率十府，以備儲闈武衛之職。

translations.literal: Early Sui first separately established ten offices: Left and Right Guard Commandant, Left and Right Clan Guard Commandant, Left and Right Patrol, Left and Right Inner Commandant, and Left and Right Gate Guard Commandant — to serve as reserve inner-palace martial guard.
translations.idiomatic: Early Sui first established ten offices — Left and Right Guard Commandant, Left and Right Clan Guard Commandant, Left and Right Patrol, Left and Right Inner Commandant, and Left and Right Gate Guard Commandant — as reserve inner-palace martial guard.

sentences.zh: 煬帝改為左、右侍率，國家復為衛率。

translations.literal: Emperor Yang changed them to Left and Right Attendant Commandants; the state restored Guard Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Yang renamed them Left and Right Attendant Commandants; our dynasty restored Guard Commandant.

sentences.zh: 龍朔改為左、右典戎衛，咸亨復。

translations.literal: Longshuo changed them to Left and Right Martial Guard Supervisors; Xianheng restored the former name.
translations.idiomatic: Under Longshuo they became Left and Right Martial Guard Supervisors; under Xianheng the former name was restored.

sentences.zh: 率各一員，正四品上。

translations.literal: One Commandant each, upper fourth rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Commandant each, upper fourth rank.

sentences.zh: 副率各一人，從四品上。

translations.literal: One Vice Commandant each, upper secondary fourth rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Vice Commandant each, upper secondary fourth rank.

sentences.zh: 左右衛率掌東宮兵仗羽衛之政令，總諸曹之事。

translations.literal: Left and Right Guard Commandants manage orders for the Eastern Palace's arms, weapons, and feathered guard, overseeing all section affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Left and Right Guard Commandants oversee Eastern Palace arms, weapons, and feathered guard regulations and coordinate all staff sections.

sentences.zh: 凡親勳翊府及廣濟等五府屬焉。

translations.literal: All Intimate, Meritorious, and Support offices and the five offices such as Broad Relief are subordinate to them.
translations.idiomatic: The Intimate, Meritorious, and Support offices and five offices including Broad Relief are subordinate to them.

sentences.zh: 凡正、至太子朝，宮臣率其屬儀仗，為左右廂之周衛，出入如鹵簿之法。

translations.literal: At the winter solstice and summer solstice when the Heir Apparent holds court, palace officials lead their subordinates' ceremonial guard as left and right wing encircling guard, entering and exiting by imperial procession regulations.
translations.idiomatic: At the winter solstice and summer solstice court assemblies, palace officials lead their subordinates' ceremonial guard as left- and right-wing encircling guard, entering and exiting by imperial procession regulations.

sentences.zh: 長史各一人，正七品上。

translations.literal: One Chief Administrator each, upper seventh rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Chief Administrator each, upper seventh rank.

sentences.zh: 錄事參軍事各一人。

translations.literal: One recording staff officer each.
translations.idiomatic: One recording staff officer each.

sentences.zh: 從八品上。

translations.literal: Upper secondary eighth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Upper secondary eighth rank.

sentences.zh: 倉曹參軍一人，從八品下，兵曹參軍一人，從八品下。

translations.literal: One Granary Staff Officer, lower secondary eighth rank; one Military Staff Officer, lower secondary eighth rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Granary Staff Officer and one Military Staff Officer, both lower secondary eighth rank.

sentences.zh: 胄曹參軍一人，從八品下。

translations.literal: One Armor Staff Officer, lower secondary eighth rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Armor Staff Officer, lower secondary eighth rank.

sentences.zh: 司階一人，從六品上。

translations.literal: One Stairway Master, upper secondary sixth rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Stairway Master, upper secondary sixth rank.

sentences.zh: 中候二人，從七品下。

translations.literal: Two Central Guards, lower secondary seventh rank.
translations.idiomatic: Two Central Guards, lower secondary seventh rank.

sentences.zh: 司戈二人，從八品下。

translations.literal: Two Halberd Masters, lower secondary eighth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Two Halberd Masters, lower secondary eighth rank.

sentences.zh: 執戟三人。

translations.literal: Three Halberd Bearers.
translations.idiomatic: Three Halberd Bearers.

sentences.zh: 從九品下。

translations.literal: Lower secondary ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Lower secondary ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 長史掌判諸曹及三府五府之貳。

translations.literal: The Chief Administrator manages adjudication of all sections and serves as deputy for the three and five offices.
translations.idiomatic: The Chief Administrator adjudicates all sections and serves as deputy for the three and five offices.

sentences.zh: 錄事掌監印勾稽。

translations.literal: The recording clerk manages seal supervision and audit.
translations.idiomatic: The recording clerk supervises seals and audits records.

sentences.zh: 官掌本曹簿籍。

translations.literal: Officials manage their own section registers.
translations.idiomatic: Officials manage their own section registers.

sentences.zh: 職事皆視上臺。

translations.literal: All duties follow the upper platform.
translations.idiomatic: All duties follow the upper platform precedent.

sentences.zh: 親府勳翊府中郎將各一人，從四品上。

translations.literal: One Central Commandant each for the Intimate, Meritorious, and Support offices, upper secondary fourth rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Central Commandant each for the Intimate, Meritorious, and Support offices, upper secondary fourth rank.

sentences.zh: 左、右郎將各一人，正五品下。

translations.literal: One Left and one Right Commandant each, lower fifth rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Left and one Right Commandant each, lower fifth rank.

sentences.zh: 錄事一人，兵曹參軍一人，校尉五人，旅帥十人，隊正二十人，副隊正二十人。

translations.literal: One recording clerk, one military staff officer, five company captains, ten platoon leaders, twenty squad leaders, twenty deputy squad leaders.
translations.idiomatic: One recording clerk, one military staff officer, five company captains, ten platoon leaders, twenty squad leaders, and twenty deputy squad leaders.

sentences.zh: 郎將掌其府之屬以宿衛，而總其事。

translations.literal: Commandants manage their office's subordinates for night guard and oversee their affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Commandants lead their office's subordinates on night guard duty and oversee their affairs.

sentences.zh: 職掌一視上臺親府。

translations.literal: Duties all follow the upper platform Intimate office.
translations.idiomatic: Duties all follow the upper platform Intimate office precedent.

sentences.zh: 太子左、右司御率府：本號左、右宗衛府，龍朔改為司御率府。

translations.literal: Heir Apparent's Left and Right Imperial Attendant Commandant offices: originally called Left and Right Clan Guard offices; Longshuo changed them to Imperial Attendant Commandant offices.
translations.idiomatic: Heir Apparent's Left and Right Imperial Attendant Commandant offices were originally Left and Right Clan Guard offices; under Longshuo they became Imperial Attendant Commandant offices.

sentences.zh: 率各一人，正四品上。

translations.literal: One Commandant each, upper fourth rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Commandant each, upper fourth rank.

sentences.zh: 副率各二人，從四品上。

translations.literal: Two Vice Commandants each, upper secondary fourth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Two Vice Commandants each, upper secondary fourth rank.

sentences.zh: 衛御率掌同左右率。

translations.literal: Imperial Attendant Commandants manage the same as the Left and Right Commandants.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial Attendant Commandants' duties match those of the Left and Right Commandants.

sentences.zh: 長史、錄事參軍事、倉兵胄三曹參軍、司階、中候、司戈、執戟。

translations.literal: Chief Administrator, recording staff officer, the three staff officers of Granary, Military, and Armor sections, Stairway Master, Central Guard, Halberd Master, Halberd Bearer.
translations.idiomatic: Chief Administrator, recording staff officer, Granary, Military, and Armor staff officers, Stairway Master, Central Guard, Halberd Master, and Halberd Bearer.

sentences.zh: 人數、品秩、職掌如左右衛府也。

translations.literal: Numbers, ranks, and duties like the Left and Right Guard offices.
translations.idiomatic: Numbers, ranks, and duties as for the Left and Right Guard offices.

sentences.zh: 太子左、右清道率府：隋文置左右虞候府，各開府一人，掌斥候。

translations.literal: Heir Apparent's Left and Right Clearing-the-Way Commandant offices: Emperor Wen of Sui established Left and Right Patrol offices, one office opener each, managing reconnaissance.
translations.idiomatic: Heir Apparent's Left and Right Clearing-the-Way Commandant offices: Emperor Wen of Sui established Left and Right Patrol offices with one office opener each to manage reconnaissance.

sentences.zh: 國初亦為左、右虞候，龍朔改為清道率府，神龍又為虞候，開元復為清道也。

translations.literal: At the founding of the state they were also Left and Right Patrol; Longshuo changed them to Clearing-the-Way Commandant offices; Shendlong restored Patrol; Kaiyuan restored Clearing-the-Way.
translations.idiomatic: At the founding of the state they were Left and Right Patrol; under Longshuo they became Clearing-the-Way Commandant offices; under Shendlong Patrol was restored; under Kaiyuan Clearing-the-Way was restored.

sentences.zh: 率各一人，正四品上。

translations.literal: One Commandant each, upper fourth rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Commandant each, upper fourth rank.

sentences.zh: 副率各二人。

translations.literal: Two Vice Commandants each.
translations.idiomatic: Two Vice Commandants each.

sentences.zh: 從四品上。

translations.literal: Upper secondary fourth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Upper secondary fourth rank.

sentences.zh: 清道率掌東宮內外晝夜巡警之法。

translations.literal: Clearing-the-Way Commandants manage the methods of day-and-night patrol inside and outside the Eastern Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Clearing-the-Way Commandants oversee day-and-night patrol regulations inside and outside the Eastern Palace.

sentences.zh: 長史、錄事參軍事、倉兵胄三曹參軍、司階、中候、司戈、執戟。

translations.literal: Chief Administrator, recording staff officer, the three staff officers of Granary, Military, and Armor sections, Stairway Master, Central Guard, Halberd Master, Halberd Bearer.
translations.idiomatic: Chief Administrator, recording staff officer, Granary, Military, and Armor staff officers, Stairway Master, Central Guard, Halberd Master, and Halberd Bearer.

sentences.zh: 人數、品秩如左右衛率府。

translations.literal: Numbers and ranks like the Left and Right Guard Commandant offices.
translations.idiomatic: Numbers and ranks as for the Left and Right Guard Commandant offices.

sentences.zh: 太子左右監門率府：隋置此官，國家因之。

translations.literal: Heir Apparent's Left and Right Gate Guard Commandant offices: Sui established these offices; the state followed this.
translations.idiomatic: Heir Apparent's Left and Right Gate Guard Commandant offices: the Sui established them; our dynasty kept the arrangement.

sentences.zh: 率各一人，正四品上。

translations.literal: One Commandant each, upper fourth rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Commandant each, upper fourth rank.

sentences.zh: 副率各一人。

translations.literal: One Vice Commandant each.
translations.idiomatic: One Vice Commandant each.

sentences.zh: 從四品上。

translations.literal: Upper secondary fourth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Upper secondary fourth rank.

sentences.zh: 左右監門率掌東宮禁衛之法，應以籍入宮殿門者，二率司其出入，如上臺之法。

translations.literal: Left and Right Gate Guard Commandants manage Eastern Palace security regulations; for those who should enter palace gates by register, the two Commandants control their entry and exit, by the upper platform regulations.
translations.idiomatic: Left and Right Gate Guard Commandants oversee Eastern Palace security regulations; for those authorized by register to enter palace gates, the two Commandants control entry and exit by upper platform regulations.

sentences.zh: 長史、錄事參軍事、兵胄二曹參軍。

translations.literal: Chief Administrator, recording staff officer, the two staff officers of Military and Armor sections.
translations.idiomatic: Chief Administrator, recording staff officer, and Military and Armor staff officers.

sentences.zh: 監門直長七十八人。

translations.literal: Seventy-eight Gate Guard squad leaders.
translations.idiomatic: Seventy-eight Gate Guard squad leaders.

sentences.zh: 人數、品秩同諸率府。

translations.literal: Numbers and ranks the same as the various Commandant offices.
translations.idiomatic: Numbers and ranks the same as the various Commandant offices.

sentences.zh: 太子左、右內率府：隋初置內率府，擬上臺千牛衛。

translations.literal: Heir Apparent's Left and Right Inner Commandant offices: early Sui established Inner Commandant offices, modeled on the upper platform Thousand-Ox Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Heir Apparent's Left and Right Inner Commandant offices: early Sui established Inner Commandant offices modeled on the upper platform Thousand-Ox Guard.

sentences.zh: 龍朔初，為奉裕率，咸亨復。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Longshuo, became Attendant Commandant; Xianheng restored the former name.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Longshuo it became Attendant Commandant; under Xianheng the former name was restored.

sentences.zh: 率各一人，正四品上。

translations.literal: One Commandant each, upper fourth rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Commandant each, upper fourth rank.

sentences.zh: 副率各一人。

translations.literal: One Vice Commandant each.
translations.idiomatic: One Vice Commandant each.

sentences.zh: 從四品上。

translations.literal: Upper secondary fourth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Upper secondary fourth rank.

sentences.zh: 左、右內率之職，掌東宮千牛備身侍奉之事，而立其兵仗，總其府事。

translations.literal: The duty of the Left and Right Inner Commandants is to manage Eastern Palace Thousand-Ox Bodyguard attendance affairs, maintain their arms, and oversee their office affairs.
translations.idiomatic: The Left and Right Inner Commandants oversee Eastern Palace Thousand-Ox Bodyguard attendance, maintain their arms, and coordinate office affairs.

sentences.zh: 長史、錄事參軍事、兵胄二曹參軍，人數、品秩如諸率。

translations.literal: Chief Administrator, recording staff officer, the two staff officers of Military and Armor sections — numbers and ranks like the various Commandants.
translations.idiomatic: Chief Administrator, recording staff officer, and Military and Armor staff officers — numbers and ranks as for the various Commandants.

sentences.zh: 千牛十六人，備身二十八人，主仗六十人。

translations.literal: Sixteen Thousand-Ox guards, twenty-eight bodyguards, sixty arms keepers.
translations.idiomatic: Sixteen Thousand-Ox guards, twenty-eight bodyguards, and sixty arms keepers.

sentences.zh: 王府官屬公主邑司親王府：傅一人，從三品。

translations.literal: Princely residence officials, princess fief offices: Princely Residence — one Tutor, secondary third rank.
translations.idiomatic: Princely residence officials and princess fief offices — Princely Residence: one Tutor, secondary third rank.

sentences.zh: 漢官有王傅、太傅，魏、晉後唯置師，國家因之，開元改為傅。

translations.literal: Han offices had Princely Tutor and Grand Tutor; after Wei and Jin only Tutor was established; the state followed this; Kaiyuan changed it to Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: Han offices had Princely Tutor and Grand Tutor; after Wei and Jin only Tutor was maintained; our dynasty kept this; under Kaiyuan it was renamed Tutor.

sentences.zh: 諮議參軍一人，正五品上。

translations.literal: One Advisory Staff Officer, upper fifth rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Advisory Staff Officer, upper fifth rank.

sentences.zh: 友一人，從五品下。

translations.literal: One Companion, lower secondary fifth rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Companion, lower secondary fifth rank.

sentences.zh: 文學二人，從六品上。

translations.literal: Two Literary Attendants, upper secondary sixth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Two Literary Attendants, upper secondary sixth rank.

sentences.zh: 東閣、西閣祭酒各一人。

translations.literal: One Libationer each for the East and West Pavilions.
translations.idiomatic: One Libationer each for the East and West Pavilions.

sentences.zh: 從七品上。

translations.literal: Upper secondary seventh rank.
translations.idiomatic: Upper secondary seventh rank.

sentences.zh: 傅掌傅相贊導，而匡其過失。

translations.literal: The Tutor manages tutoring, assistance, and guidance, correcting errors.
translations.idiomatic: The Tutor instructs, assists, and guides the prince and corrects his errors.

sentences.zh: 諮議訏謀左右。

translations.literal: The Advisory Staff Officer offers counsel at the prince's side.
translations.idiomatic: The Advisory Staff Officer offers counsel at the prince's side.

sentences.zh: 友陪侍規諷。

translations.literal: The Companion attends and offers remonstrance.
translations.idiomatic: The Companion attends the prince and offers remonstrance.

sentences.zh: 文學讎校典籍，侍從文章。

translations.literal: Literary Attendants collate classics and attend on literary composition.
translations.idiomatic: Literary Attendants collate classics and assist with literary composition.

sentences.zh: 祭酒接對賓客。

translations.literal: Libationers receive and entertain guests.
translations.idiomatic: Libationers receive and entertain guests.

sentences.zh: 長史一人，從四品上。

translations.literal: One Chief Administrator, upper secondary fourth rank.

translations.idiomatic: The secretarial section manages memorials, reports, and correspondence.

translations.idiomatic: Document keepers proclaim and transmit orders.

translations.idiomatic: Two Vice Army Supervisors, upper secondary fifth rank.

translations.idiomatic: Established according to the number of people within the department.

translations.idiomatic: Imperial Prince's Inner Tent Office — two Army Supervisors and two Vice Army Supervisors, ranks as for the Personal Service Office.

sentences.zh: 帳內六百六十七人，校尉、旅帥、隊正、隊副。

translations.idiomatic: Six hundred sixty-seven inner tent attendants, with company captains, platoon leaders, squad leaders, and deputy squad leaders.

sentences.zh: 看人數置。

translations.idiomatic: Established according to numbers of people.

translations.idiomatic: Army Supervisors and Vice Army Supervisors lead company captains and below in guard and attendance affairs.

translations.idiomatic: Two Grand Agriculturists, lower secondary eighth rank.

translations.idiomatic: Two Captains, lower ninth rank.

translations.idiomatic: One Assistant Director, lower secondary ninth rank.

translations.idiomatic: The Fief Magistrate and Grand Agriculturists overall adjudicate fief affairs.

translations.idiomatic: Two chief clerks, two ushers, two attendants, and two household clerks.

sentences.zh: 其制度，皆隸宗正寺。

translations.idiomatic: Prefectural and county officials — Jingzhao, Henan, Taiyuan, and other prefectures: since Qin and Han they have been Yong, Luo, and Bing prefectures.

sentences.zh: 周、隋或置總管都督，通名為府。

translations.literal: Under Zhou and Sui, area commanders or governors were sometimes established; they were uniformly called prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Under Zhou and Sui, area commanders or governors were sometimes established; they were uniformly called prefectures.

translations.idiomatic: Prefect is an ancient office — Shun established twelve prefects.

sentences.zh: 或不出閣，長史知府事。

translations.idiomatic: Capital guardian: Qin called it Inner Administrator, Han Intendant; later dynasties kept the title.

translations.literal: Sui called it Inner Administrator.
translations.idiomatic: The Sui called it Inner Administrator.

translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Kaiyuan Yong, Luo, and Bing became prefectures; the Chief Administrator was promoted to Intendant of secondary third rank to exclusively manage prefectural affairs.

translations.idiomatic: Two Vice Intendants each, lower secondary fourth rank.

translations.literal: From Wei and Jin downward, prefectures had a Chief Administrator; Emperor Wen of Sui changed it to Vice Director; Emperor Yang to Assistant Administrator; again to Assistant Director; Wude changed it to Chief Administrator; Yonghui avoided Emperor Gaozong's name and changed it to Vice Director; at the beginning of Kaiyuan, to Vice Intendant.

translations.literal: Two Assistant Directors, one aide, two scribes, two squad leaders, two granary supervisors.
translations.idiomatic: Two Assistant Directors, one aide, two scribes, two squad leaders, and two granary supervisors.

sentences.zh: 經學博士一人，從八品下。

translations.literal: One Classicist Doctor, lower secondary eighth rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Classicist Doctor, lower secondary eighth rank.

sentences.zh: 助教一人，學生五十人。

translations.literal: One assistant instructor, fifty students.
translations.idiomatic: One assistant instructor and fifty students.

sentences.zh: 醫學博士一人，助教一人，學生十二人。

translations.literal: One Medicine Doctor, one assistant instructor, twelve students.
translations.idiomatic: One Medicine Doctor, one assistant instructor, and twelve students.

sentences.zh: 上州：州之名，古也。

translations.literal: Superior Prefecture: the name prefecture is ancient.
translations.idiomatic: Superior Prefecture — the name prefecture is ancient.

sentences.zh: 舜置十二州，《禹貢》九州，漢置十三州。

translations.literal: Shun established twelve prefectures; the 《Tribute of Yu》 has nine prefectures; Han established thirteen prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Shun established twelve prefectures; the 《Tribute of Yu》 has nine prefectures; Han established thirteen prefectures.

sentences.zh: 秦並六國，置三十六郡。

translations.literal: Qin united the six states and established thirty-six commanderies.
translations.idiomatic: Qin united the six states and established thirty-six commanderies.

sentences.zh: 漢則以州統郡。

translations.literal: Han used prefectures to govern commanderies.
translations.idiomatic: Han used prefectures to govern commanderies.

sentences.zh: 其後武德改郡為州，改州為郡，事見諸卷。

translations.literal: Later Wude changed commanderies to prefectures and prefectures to commanderies — the matter is recorded in various chapters.
translations.idiomatic: Later Wude changed commanderies to prefectures and prefectures to commanderies — as recorded in various chapters.

sentences.zh: 國家制，戶滿四萬以上為上州。

translations.literal: Under state regulations, households numbering forty thousand or more make a superior prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Under state regulations, prefectures with forty thousand or more households are superior prefectures.

sentences.zh: 刺史一員，從三品。

translations.literal: One Prefectural Governor, secondary third rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Prefectural Governor, secondary third rank.

sentences.zh: 秦分天下為三十六郡，郡置守、都尉各一人，仍以御史一人監郡。

translations.literal: Qin divided the realm into thirty-six commanderies, each with one Administrator and one Commandant, and still one Censor to supervise the commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Qin divided the realm into thirty-six commanderies, each with one Administrator and one Commandant, and one Censor to supervise the commandery.

sentences.zh: 漢廢監郡御史，丞相遣掾吏分察諸郡。

translations.literal: Han abolished commandery-supervising Censors; the Chancellor sent staff officers to inspect various commanderies.
translations.idiomatic: Han abolished commandery-supervising Censors; the Chancellor sent staff officers to inspect various commanderies.

sentences.zh: 漢武元光五年，分天下置十三州，分統諸郡。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Yuanguang of Emperor Wu of Han, the realm was divided and thirteen prefectures established to govern various commanderies.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Yuanguang of Emperor Wu of Han, the realm was divided into thirteen prefectures governing various commanderies.

sentences.zh: 每州遣使者一人，督察官吏清濁，謂之十三州刺史。

translations.literal: Each prefecture sent one envoy to inspect officials' integrity and corruption — called the Thirteen Prefectural Governors.
translations.idiomatic: Each prefecture sent one envoy to inspect officials' integrity and corruption — called the Thirteen Prefectural Governors.

sentences.zh: 後漢遂以名臣為刺史，專州郡之政，仍置別駕、治中、諸曹掾屬，號曰外置刺史。

translations.literal: Later Han then appointed renowned ministers as Prefectural Governors, exclusively managing prefectural and commandery affairs, still establishing Vice Prefect, Chief Administrator, and various section chiefs and aides — called externally stationed Prefectural Governors.
translations.idiomatic: Later Han appointed renowned ministers as Prefectural Governors to exclusively manage prefectural and commandery affairs, with Vice Prefect, Chief Administrator, and various section chiefs and aides — called externally stationed Prefectural Governors.

sentences.zh: 天寶改州為郡，置太守。

translations.literal: Tianbao changed prefectures to commanderies and established Grand Administrators.
translations.idiomatic: Under Tianbao prefectures became commanderies and Grand Administrators were established.

sentences.zh: 乾元元年，改郡為州，州置刺史。

translations.literal: In the first year of Qianyuan, commanderies were changed to prefectures and Prefectural Governors established.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Qianyuan commanderies became prefectures and Prefectural Governors were established.

sentences.zh: 初，漢代奉使者皆持節，故刺史臨部，皆持節。

translations.literal: Initially, Han envoys all bore credentials; thus Prefectural Governors on taking up their posts all bore credentials.
translations.idiomatic: Initially Han envoys all bore credentials; thus Prefectural Governors on taking up their posts all bore credentials.

sentences.zh: 至魏、晉，刺史任重者，為使持節都督，輕者為持節。

translations.literal: By Wei and Jin, Prefectural Governors with heavy responsibilities became Credential-Bearing Area Commanders; lighter ones Credential Bearers.
translations.idiomatic: By Wei and Jin, Prefectural Governors with heavy responsibilities became Credential-Bearing Area Commanders; lighter ones Credential Bearers.

sentences.zh: 後魏、北齊，總官、刺史，則加使持節諸軍事，以此為常。

translations.literal: Later Wei and Northern Qi, for area commanders and Prefectural Governors, added Credential-Bearing Commander of Military Affairs — this became the norm.
translations.idiomatic: Later Wei and Northern Qi added Credential-Bearing Commander of Military Affairs for area commanders and Prefectural Governors — this became the norm.

sentences.zh: 隋開皇三年罷郡，以州統縣，刺史之名存而職廢。

translations.literal: In the third year of Kaihuang of Sui commanderies were abolished; prefectures governed counties; the name Prefectural Governor remained but the office was defunct.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Kaihuang of Sui commanderies were abolished and prefectures governed counties; the name Prefectural Governor remained but the office was defunct.

sentences.zh: 而于刺史太守官位中，不落持節之名，至今不改，有名無實也。

translations.literal: Yet in the rank of Prefectural Governor and Grand Administrator, the name Credential Bearer was not dropped; to the present it has not changed — name without reality.
translations.idiomatic: Yet in the rank of Prefectural Governor and Grand Administrator the name Credential Bearer was not dropped; to the present it has not changed — a name without reality.

sentences.zh: 至德之後，中原用兵，大將為刺史者，兼治軍旅，遂依天寶邊將故事，加節度使之號，連制數郡。

translations.literal: After Zhide, with warfare in the Central Plains, great generals serving as Prefectural Governors also managed military affairs; following the Tianbao frontier general precedent, the title Military Commissioner was added, controlling several commanderies in succession.
translations.idiomatic: After Zhide, with warfare in the Central Plains, great generals serving as Prefectural Governors also managed military affairs; following the Tianbao frontier general precedent, the title Military Commissioner was added, controlling several commanderies.

sentences.zh: 奉辭之日，賜雙旌雙節，如後魏、北齊故事。

translations.literal: On the day of receiving commission, double banners and double credentials were granted, like the Later Wei and Northern Qi precedent.
translations.idiomatic: On the day of receiving commission, double banners and double credentials were granted, as under Later Wei and Northern Qi.

sentences.zh: 名目雖殊，得古刺史督郡之制也。

translations.literal: Though the titles differ, they obtained the ancient system of Prefectural Governors supervising commanderies.
translations.idiomatic: Though the titles differ, they restored the ancient system of Prefectural Governors supervising commanderies.

sentences.zh: 別駕一人，從四品下。

translations.literal: One Vice Prefect, lower secondary fourth rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Vice Prefect, lower secondary fourth rank.

sentences.zh: 長史一人，從五品上。

translations.literal: One Chief Administrator, upper secondary fifth rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Chief Administrator, upper secondary fifth rank.

sentences.zh: 司馬一人，從五品下。

translations.literal: One Vice Director, lower secondary fifth rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Vice Director, lower secondary fifth rank.

sentences.zh: 錄事參軍事一人，從七品上。

translations.literal: One recording staff officer, upper secondary seventh rank.
translations.idiomatic: One recording staff officer, upper secondary seventh rank.

sentences.zh: 錄事三人，從九品上。

translations.literal: Three recording clerks, upper secondary ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Three recording clerks, upper secondary ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 司功、司倉、司戶、司兵、司法、司士六曹參軍事各一人，並從七品下。

translations.literal: One staff officer each for Merit, Granary, Household, Military, Law, and Scholar sections — all lower secondary seventh rank.
translations.idiomatic: One staff officer each for Merit, Granary, Household, Military, Law, and Scholar sections — all lower secondary seventh rank.

sentences.zh: 參軍事四人，典獄十四人，問事八人，白直二十四人，市令一人，從九品上。

translations.literal: Four staff officers, fourteen prison keepers, eight inquiry clerks, twenty-four day-duty attendants, one market director, upper secondary ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Four staff officers, fourteen prison keepers, eight inquiry clerks, twenty-four day-duty attendants, and one market director of upper secondary ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 丞一人，佐一人，史二人，帥三人，倉督二人。

translations.literal: One Assistant Director, one aide, two scribes, three squad leaders, two granary supervisors.
translations.idiomatic: One Assistant Director, one aide, two scribes, three squad leaders, and two granary supervisors.

sentences.zh: 經學博士一人，從八品下。

translations.literal: One Classicist Doctor, lower secondary eighth rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Classicist Doctor, lower secondary eighth rank.

sentences.zh: 助教二人，學生六十人，醫學博士一人，正九品下。

translations.literal: Two assistant instructors, sixty students, one Medicine Doctor, lower ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Two assistant instructors, sixty students, and one Medicine Doctor of lower ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 助教一人，學生十五人。

translations.literal: One assistant instructor, fifteen students.
translations.idiomatic: One assistant instructor and fifteen students.

sentences.zh: 中州：戶滿二萬戶已上，為中州。

translations.literal: Middle Prefecture: households numbering twenty thousand or more make a middle prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Middle Prefecture — prefectures with twenty thousand or more households are middle prefectures.

sentences.zh: 刺史一員，正四品上。

translations.literal: One Prefectural Governor, upper fourth rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Prefectural Governor, upper fourth rank.

sentences.zh: 別駕一人，正五品下。

translations.literal: One Vice Prefect, lower fifth rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Vice Prefect, lower fifth rank.

sentences.zh: 長史一人，正六品上。

translations.literal: One Chief Administrator, upper sixth rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Chief Administrator, upper sixth rank.

sentences.zh: 司馬一人，六品上。

translations.literal: One Vice Director, upper sixth rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Vice Director, upper sixth rank.

sentences.zh: 錄事參軍事一人，正八品上。

translations.literal: One recording staff officer, upper eighth rank.
translations.idiomatic: One recording staff officer, upper eighth rank.

sentences.zh: 錄事一人，從九品上。

translations.literal: One recording clerk, upper secondary ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: One recording clerk, upper secondary ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 司功、司倉、司戶、司法、司士六曹參軍事各一人，並正八品下。

translations.literal: One staff officer each for Merit, Granary, Household, Law, and Scholar sections — all lower eighth rank.
translations.idiomatic: One staff officer each for Merit, Granary, Household, Law, and Scholar sections — all lower eighth rank.

sentences.zh: 隨曹有佐史人數。

translations.literal: Each section has allotted numbers of aides and scribes.
translations.idiomatic: Each section has its allotted aides and scribes.

sentences.zh: 參軍事三人，正九品上。

translations.literal: Three staff officers, upper ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Three staff officers, upper ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 執刀十人，典獄十二人，問事六人，白直十六人，市令一人，丞、佐各一人，史、帥、倉督各二人。

translations.literal: Ten sword bearers, twelve prison keepers, six inquiry clerks, sixteen day-duty attendants, one market director, one Assistant Director and one aide each, two scribes, squad leaders, and granary supervisors each.
translations.idiomatic: Ten sword bearers, twelve prison keepers, six inquiry clerks, sixteen day-duty attendants, one market director, one Assistant Director and one aide each, and two scribes, squad leaders, and granary supervisors each.

sentences.zh: 經學博士一人，正九品上。

translations.literal: One Classicist Doctor, upper ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Classicist Doctor, upper ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 助教一人，學生五十人。

translations.literal: One assistant instructor, fifty students.
translations.idiomatic: One assistant instructor and fifty students.

sentences.zh: 醫藥博士一人，從九品下。

translations.literal: One Medicine Doctor, lower secondary ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Medicine Doctor, lower secondary ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 助教一人，學生十二人。

translations.literal: One assistant instructor, twelve students.
translations.idiomatic: One assistant instructor and twelve students.

sentences.zh: 下州：戶不滿二萬，為下州也。

translations.literal: Inferior Prefecture: households not reaching twenty thousand make an inferior prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Inferior Prefecture — prefectures with fewer than twenty thousand households are inferior prefectures.

sentences.zh: 刺史一員，正四品下。

translations.literal: One Prefectural Governor, lower fourth rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Prefectural Governor, lower fourth rank.

sentences.zh: 別駕一人，從五品上。

translations.literal: One Vice Prefect, upper secondary fifth rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Vice Prefect, upper secondary fifth rank.

sentences.zh: 司馬一人，從六品下。

translations.literal: One Vice Director, lower secondary sixth rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Vice Director, lower secondary sixth rank.

sentences.zh: 錄事參軍事一人，從八品上。

translations.literal: One recording staff officer, upper secondary eighth rank.
translations.idiomatic: One recording staff officer, upper secondary eighth rank.

sentences.zh: 錄事一人，從九品下。

translations.literal: One recording clerk, lower secondary ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: One recording clerk, lower secondary ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 司倉、司戶、司法三曹參軍事各一人，從八品下。

translations.literal: One staff officer each for Granary, Household, and Law sections — lower secondary eighth rank.
translations.idiomatic: One staff officer each for Granary, Household, and Law sections — lower secondary eighth rank.

sentences.zh: 隨曹有佐史人數。

translations.literal: Each section has allotted numbers of aides and scribes.
translations.idiomatic: Each section has its allotted aides and scribes.

sentences.zh: 參軍事一人，從九品下。

translations.literal: One staff officer, lower secondary ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: One staff officer, lower secondary ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 典獄八人，問事四人，白直十六人，市令一人，佐、史各一人，帥二人，倉督一人。

translations.literal: Eight prison keepers, four inquiry clerks, sixteen day-duty attendants, one market director, one aide and one scribe each, two squad leaders, one granary supervisor.
translations.idiomatic: Eight prison keepers, four inquiry clerks, sixteen day-duty attendants, one market director, one aide and one scribe each, two squad leaders, and one granary supervisor.

sentences.zh: 經學博士一人，正九品下。

translations.literal: One Classicist Doctor, lower ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Classicist Doctor, lower ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 助教一人，學生四十人。

translations.literal: One assistant instructor, forty students.
translations.idiomatic: One assistant instructor and forty students.

sentences.zh: 醫學博士一人，從九品下。

translations.literal: One Medicine Doctor, lower secondary ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Medicine Doctor, lower secondary ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 學生十人。

translations.literal: Ten students.
translations.idiomatic: Ten students.

sentences.zh: 京兆、河南、太原牧及都督、刺史掌清肅邦畿，考核官吏，宣佈德化，撫和齊人，勸課農桑，敦敷五教。

translations.literal: Prefects of Jingzhao, Henan, and Taiyuan and Area Commanders and Prefectural Governors manage purifying and securing the capital region, evaluating officials, proclaiming moral transformation, comforting and harmonizing the people, encouraging agriculture and sericulture, and earnestly spreading the five teachings.
translations.idiomatic: Prefects of Jingzhao, Henan, and Taiyuan and Area Commanders and Prefectural Governors purify and secure the capital region, evaluate officials, proclaim moral transformation, comfort and harmonize the people, encourage agriculture and sericulture, and spread the five teachings.

sentences.zh: 每歲一巡屬縣，觀風俗，問百年，錄囚徒，恤鰥寡，閱丁口，務知百姓之疾苦。

translations.literal: Each year they tour subordinate counties once, observe customs, inquire about centenarians, record prisoners, care for widowers and widows, review population registers, striving to know the people's hardships.
translations.idiomatic: Each year they tour subordinate counties once, observe customs, inquire about centenarians, record prisoners, care for widowers and widows, review population registers, and learn the people's hardships.

sentences.zh: 部內有篤學異能聞於鄉閭者，舉而進之。

translations.literal: Within their jurisdiction, those of devoted learning and unusual talent known in villages are recommended and promoted.
translations.idiomatic: Within their jurisdiction they recommend and promote those of devoted learning and unusual talent known in villages.

sentences.zh: 有不孝悌，悖禮亂常，不率法令者，糾而繩之。

translations.literal: Those lacking filial piety and brotherly respect, violating ritual and disrupting norms, not following laws and orders — investigate and punish them.
translations.idiomatic: Those lacking filial piety and brotherly respect, violating ritual and disrupting norms, or not following laws and orders are investigated and punished.

sentences.zh: 其吏在官公廉下己，清直守節者，必謹而察之。

translations.literal: Officials who in office are public-spirited and incorruptible, humble and self-restrained, upright and preserving integrity — carefully observe them.
translations.idiomatic: Officials who are public-spirited and incorruptible, humble and self-restrained, upright and preserving integrity are carefully observed.

sentences.zh: 其貪穢諂諛，求名狥私者，亦謹而察之。

translations.literal: Those who are greedy and corrupt, flatter and fawn, seek fame and pursue private gain — also carefully observe them.
translations.idiomatic: Those who are greedy and corrupt, flatter and fawn, or seek fame and pursue private gain are also carefully observed.

sentences.zh: 皆附於考課，以為褒貶。

translations.literal: All are attached to performance review for praise and censure.
translations.idiomatic: All are attached to performance review for praise and censure.

sentences.zh: 若善惡殊尤者，隨即奏聞。

translations.literal: If good or evil is exceptionally outstanding, immediately report to the throne.
translations.idiomatic: If good or evil is exceptionally outstanding, it is immediately reported to the throne.

sentences.zh: 若獄訟疑議，兵甲興造便宜，符瑞尤異，亦以上聞。

translations.literal: If prison cases are disputed, military equipment construction requires expedient action, or auspicious omens are exceptionally unusual — also report upward.
translations.idiomatic: Disputed prison cases, expedient military equipment construction, and exceptionally unusual auspicious omens are also reported upward.

sentences.zh: 其常則申於尚書省而已。

translations.literal: Routine matters are reported only to the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Routine matters are reported only to the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 若孝子順孫，義夫節婦，精誠感通，志行聞於鄉閭者，亦具以申奏，表其門閭。

translations.literal: If filial sons and obedient grandsons, righteous husbands and chaste wives, whose sincerity moves heaven and whose conduct is known in villages — also fully report and memorialize, honoring their gates and lanes.
translations.idiomatic: Filial sons and obedient grandsons, righteous husbands and chaste wives whose sincerity moves heaven and whose conduct is known in villages are fully reported and memorialized, and their gates and lanes are honored.

sentences.zh: 其孝悌力田，頗有詞學者，率與計偕。

translations.literal: Those filial, brotherly, and diligent in farming with considerable literary learning are generally sent with annual tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Those filial, brotherly, and diligent in farming with considerable literary learning are generally sent with annual tribute.

sentences.zh: 其所部有須改更，得以便宜從事。

translations.literal: Within their jurisdiction, if changes are needed, they may act expediently.
translations.idiomatic: Within their jurisdiction they may act expediently when changes are needed.

sentences.zh: 若親王典州，及邊州都督刺史不可離州局者，應巡屬縣，皆委上佐行焉。

translations.literal: If an imperial prince governs a prefecture, or a frontier Area Commander or Prefectural Governor cannot leave the prefectural office, for required tours of subordinate counties, all are entrusted to senior aides to conduct.
translations.idiomatic: If an imperial prince governs a prefecture, or a frontier Area Commander or Prefectural Governor cannot leave the prefectural office, required tours of subordinate counties are entrusted to senior aides.

sentences.zh: 尹、少尹、別駕、長史、司馬掌貳府州之事，以綱紀眾務，通判列曹。

translations.literal: Intendants, Vice Intendants, Vice Prefects, Chief Administrators, and Vice Directors manage deputy prefectural affairs, maintaining discipline of all duties and overall adjudicating all sections.
translations.idiomatic: Intendants, Vice Intendants, Vice Prefects, Chief Administrators, and Vice Directors manage deputy prefectural affairs, maintain discipline of all duties, and overall adjudicate all sections.

sentences.zh: 歲終則更入奏計。

translations.literal: At year's end they enter the capital to report accounts.
translations.idiomatic: At year's end they enter the capital to report accounts.

sentences.zh: 司錄、錄事參軍掌勾稽，省署鈔目，監符印。

translations.literal: Recording staff officers manage audit, office records and copies, and seal supervision.
translations.idiomatic: Recording staff officers manage audit, office records and copies, and seal supervision.

sentences.zh: 功曹、司功掌官吏考課、祭祀、禎祥、道佛、學校、表疏、醫藥、陳設之事。

translations.literal: Merit section manages official performance review, sacrifices, auspicious signs, Daoism and Buddhism, schools, memorials and reports, medicine, and furnishings.
translations.idiomatic: The Merit section manages official performance review, sacrifices, auspicious signs, Daoism and Buddhism, schools, memorials and reports, medicine, and furnishings.

sentences.zh: 倉曹、司倉掌公廨、度量、庖廚、倉庫、租賦、徵收、田園、市肆之事。

translations.literal: Granary section manages government offices, weights and measures, kitchens, storehouses, rents and taxes, collection, fields and gardens, and markets.
translations.idiomatic: The Granary section manages government offices, weights and measures, kitchens, storehouses, rents and taxes, collection, fields and gardens, and markets.

sentences.zh: 戶曹、司戶掌戶籍、計帳、道路、逆旅、婚田之事。

translations.literal: Household section manages household registers, account books, roads, inns, and marriage fields.
translations.idiomatic: The Household section manages household registers, account books, roads, inns, and marriage fields.

sentences.zh: 兵曹、司兵掌武官選舉、兵甲器仗、門戶管鑰、烽候傳驛之事。

translations.literal: Military section manages military official selection, armor and weapons, gate keys, beacon fires, and courier stations.
translations.idiomatic: The Military section manages military official selection, armor and weapons, gate keys, beacon fires, and courier stations.

sentences.zh: 法曹、司法掌刑法。

translations.literal: Law section manages penal law.
translations.idiomatic: The Law section manages penal law.

sentences.zh: 士曹、司士掌津梁、舟車、舍宅、百工眾藝之事。

translations.literal: Scholar section manages ferries and bridges, boats and carriages, dwellings, and various crafts and arts.
translations.idiomatic: The Scholar section manages ferries and bridges, boats and carriages, dwellings, and various crafts and arts.

sentences.zh: 市令掌市厘交易、禁斥非違之事。

translations.literal: Market directors manage market transactions and prohibiting violations.
translations.idiomatic: Market directors manage market transactions and prohibit violations.

sentences.zh: 經學博士掌《五經》，教授諸生。

translations.literal: Classicist Doctors manage the 《Five Classics》 and instruct students.
translations.idiomatic: Classicist Doctors teach the 《Five Classics》 and instruct students.

sentences.zh: 醫藥博士以百藥救民疾病。

translations.literal: Medicine Doctors use various medicines to treat the people's illnesses.
translations.idiomatic: Medicine Doctors use various medicines to treat the people's illnesses.

translations.literal: Established at the end of Zhenyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Established at the end of Zhenyuan.

sentences.zh: 自後隨用兵權置，兵罷則停。

translations.literal: After this it was established as military needs required; when campaigns ended it was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: After this it was established as military needs required; when campaigns ended it was abolished.

sentences.zh: 防禦團練使。

translations.literal: Defense and Training Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Defense and Training Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 至德後，中原置節度使。

translations.literal: After Zhide, Military Commissioners were established in the Central Plains.
translations.idiomatic: After Zhide, Military Commissioners were established in the Central Plains.

sentences.zh: 又大郡要害之地，置防禦使，以治軍事，刺史兼之，不賜旌節。

translations.literal: Also at great commanderies in strategic places, Defense Commissioners were established to manage military affairs, concurrently held by Prefectural Governors, without granting banners and credentials.
translations.idiomatic: Also at great commanderies in strategic places, Defense Commissioners were established to manage military affairs, concurrently held by Prefectural Governors, without granting banners and credentials.

sentences.zh: 上元後，改防禦使為團練守捉使，又與團練兼置防禦使，名前使，各有副使、判官，皆天寶後置，未見品秩。

translations.literal: After Shangyuan, Defense Commissioner was changed to Training and Garrison Commissioner; Defense Commissioner was also concurrently established with Training Commissioner, the former commissioner; each had Vice Commissioners and Adjudicators — all established after Tianbao; ranks not found.
translations.idiomatic: After Shangyuan, Defense Commissioner became Training and Garrison Commissioner; Defense Commissioner was also concurrently established with Training Commissioner; each had Vice Commissioners and Adjudicators — all established after Tianbao; ranks not found.

sentences.zh: 諸鎮魏有鎮東、鎮西、鎮南、鎮北四將軍，後代因之。

translations.literal: Various garrisons: Wei had East, West, South, and North Garrison Generals; later dynasties followed this.
translations.idiomatic: Various garrisons — Wei had East, West, South, and North Garrison Generals; later dynasties kept them.

sentences.zh: 隋因始置鎮將、鎮副之名也

translations.literal: Sui accordingly first established the names Garrison General and Garrison Vice General.
translations.idiomatic: The Sui accordingly first established the names Garrison General and Garrison Vice General.

sentences.zh: 上鎮：將一人，正六品下。

translations.literal: Superior garrison: one General, lower sixth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Superior garrison — one General, lower sixth rank.

sentences.zh: 鎮副一人，正七品下。

translations.literal: One Garrison Vice General, lower seventh rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Garrison Vice General, lower seventh rank.

sentences.zh: 錄事一人，倉曹、兵曹二參軍。

translations.literal: One recording clerk, two staff officers for Granary and Military sections.
translations.idiomatic: One recording clerk and two Granary and Military staff officers.

sentences.zh: 從八品下。

translations.literal: Lower secondary eighth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Lower secondary eighth rank.

sentences.zh: 各有佐史。

translations.literal: Each has aides and scribes.
translations.idiomatic: Each has aides and scribes.

sentences.zh: 中鎮：將一人，正七品上。

translations.literal: Middle garrison: one General, upper seventh rank.
translations.idiomatic: Middle garrison — one General, upper seventh rank.

sentences.zh: 鎮副一人，從七品上。

translations.literal: One Garrison Vice General, upper secondary seventh rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Garrison Vice General, upper secondary seventh rank.

sentences.zh: 錄事一人，兵曹參軍一人。

translations.literal: One recording clerk, one Military Staff Officer.
translations.idiomatic: One recording clerk and one Military Staff Officer.

sentences.zh: 正九品下。

translations.literal: Lower ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Lower ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 下鎮：將一人，正七品下。

translations.literal: Inferior garrison: one General, lower seventh rank.
translations.idiomatic: Inferior garrison — one General, lower seventh rank.

sentences.zh: 鎮副一人，從七品下。

translations.literal: One Garrison Vice General, lower secondary seventh rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Garrison Vice General, lower secondary seventh rank.

sentences.zh: 錄事一人，兵曹參軍一人。

translations.literal: One recording clerk, one Military Staff Officer.
translations.idiomatic: One recording clerk and one Military Staff Officer.

sentences.zh: 從九品下。

translations.literal: Lower secondary ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Lower secondary ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 諸戍春秋有戍，葵丘之義。

translations.literal: Various garrison posts: in Spring and Autumn there were garrisons — the meaning of the Covenant of Kuiqiu.
translations.idiomatic: Various garrison posts — in Spring and Autumn there were garrisons, in the spirit of the Covenant of Kuiqiu.

sentences.zh: 東晉、後魏以屯兵守境處為戍，隋因之。

translations.literal: Eastern Jin and Later Wei used stationed troops guarding borders as garrison posts; Sui followed this.
translations.idiomatic: Eastern Jin and Later Wei used stationed troops guarding borders as garrison posts; the Sui kept the arrangement.

sentences.zh: 上戍：主一人，正八品下。

translations.literal: Superior garrison post: one Commander, lower eighth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Superior garrison post — one Commander, lower eighth rank.

sentences.zh: 戍副一人。

translations.literal: One Garrison Vice Commander.
translations.idiomatic: One Garrison Vice Commander.

sentences.zh: 從八品下。

translations.literal: Lower secondary eighth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Lower secondary eighth rank.

sentences.zh: 佐一人，史二人。

translations.literal: One aide, two scribes.
translations.idiomatic: One aide and two scribes.

sentences.zh: 中戍：主一人。

translations.literal: Middle garrison post: one Commander.
translations.idiomatic: Middle garrison post — one Commander.

sentences.zh: 從八品下。

translations.literal: Lower secondary eighth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Lower secondary eighth rank.

sentences.zh: 下戍：主一人。

translations.literal: Inferior garrison post: one Commander.
translations.idiomatic: Inferior garrison post — one Commander.

sentences.zh: 正九品下。

translations.literal: Lower ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Lower ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 五嶽四瀆廟：令各一人，正九品上。

translations.literal: Shrines of the Five Sacred Mountains and Four Rivers: one Director each, upper ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Shrines of the Five Sacred Mountains and Four Rivers — one Director each, upper ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 齋郎三十人，祝史三人。

translations.literal: Thirty fasting officers, three sacrificial scribes.
translations.idiomatic: Thirty fasting officers and three sacrificial scribes.

sentences.zh: 上關：令一人，從八品下。

translations.literal: Superior pass: one Director, lower secondary eighth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Superior pass — one Director, lower secondary eighth rank.

sentences.zh: 丞二人。

translations.literal: Two Assistant Directors.
translations.idiomatic: Two Assistant Directors.

sentences.zh: 正九品下。

translations.literal: Lower ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Lower ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 錄事一人，有府、史、典事。

translations.literal: One recording clerk; there are clerks, scribes, and record keepers.
translations.idiomatic: One recording clerk, with clerks, scribes, and record keepers.

sentences.zh: 津吏八人。

translations.literal: Eight ferry clerks.
translations.idiomatic: Eight ferry clerks.

sentences.zh: 中關：令一人，正九品下。

translations.literal: Middle pass: one Director, lower ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Middle pass — one Director, lower ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 丞一人。

translations.literal: One Assistant Director.
translations.idiomatic: One Assistant Director.

sentences.zh: 從九品下。

translations.literal: Lower secondary ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Lower secondary ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 錄事一人，津吏六人。

translations.literal: One recording clerk, six ferry clerks.
translations.idiomatic: One recording clerk and six ferry clerks.

sentences.zh: 下關：令一人，從九品下。

translations.literal: Inferior pass: one Director, lower secondary ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Inferior pass — one Director, lower secondary ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 津吏四人。

translations.literal: Four ferry clerks.
translations.idiomatic: Four ferry clerks.

sentences.zh: 關令各有府、史。

translations.literal: Pass Directors each have clerks and scribes.
translations.idiomatic: Pass Directors each have clerks and scribes.

sentences.zh: 關令掌禁末遊，伺奸慝。

translations.literal: Pass Directors manage prohibiting idle wandering and detecting treachery.
translations.idiomatic: Pass Directors prohibit idle wandering and detect treachery.

sentences.zh: 凡行人車馬出入往來，必據過所以勘之。

translations.literal: For all travelers, carriages, and horses entering, exiting, and passing through, they must be inspected according to travel permits.
translations.idiomatic: All travelers, carriages, and horses entering, exiting, and passing through must be inspected according to travel permits.
